likewise the affirmation came in detail. for god, glorified and exalted, says in his book: {god — there is no god but he, the living, the self-subsisting. neither drowsiness takes him nor sleep. to him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. who is there that can intercede with him except by his leave? he knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of his knowledge except as he wills. his seat extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation does not weary him; and he is the most high, the magnificent} (sūrat al-baqarah 2:255).

and he says, exalted: {and he is the forgiving, the loving, lord of the throne, the glorious, doer of whatever he wills} (sūrat al-burūj 85:14–16). and there is other detail besides this, such as what came in the hadith of abu hurayra, that the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'god has ninety-nine names — a hundred less one. whoever enumerates them enters the garden.' and in some of its lines of transmission there came an addition: he is god, other than whom there is no god; the most merciful (al-raḥmān), the compassionate (al-raḥīm), the king (al-malik), the holy (al-quddūs), the source of peace (al-salām), the granter of security (al-muʾmin), the watchful (al-muhaymin), the mighty (al-ʿazīz), the compeller (al-jabbār), the supremely great (al-mutakabbir), the creator (al-khāliq), the originator (al-bāriʾ), the fashioner (al-muṣawwir), the ever-forgiving (al-ghaffār), the subduer (al-qahhār), the bestower (al-wahhāb), the provider (al-razzāq), the opener (al-fattāḥ), the all-knowing (al-ʿalīm), the withholder (al-qābiḍ), the expander (al-bāsiṭ), the abaser (al-khāfiḍ), the exalter (al-rāfiʿ), the giver of honour (al-muʿizz), the giver of abasement (al-mudhill), the all-hearing (al-samīʿ), the all-seeing (al-baṣīr), the judge (al-ḥakam), the just (al-ʿadl), the subtle (al-laṭīf), the all-aware (al-khabīr), the forbearing (al-ḥalīm), the magnificent (al-ʿaẓīm), the forgiving (al-ghafūr), the appreciative (al-shakūr), the most high (al-ʿalī), the great (al-kabīr), the preserver (al-ḥafīẓ), the sustainer (al-muqīt) — and in one transmission, the helper (al-mughīth) — the reckoner (al-ḥasīb), the majestic (al-jalīl), the generous (al-karīm), the watcher (al-raqīb) — and in one transmission, the near (al-qarīb) — the responsive (al-mujīb), the all-encompassing (al-wāsiʿ), the wise (al-ḥakīm), the loving (al-wadūd), the glorious (al-majīd), the raiser of the dead (al-bāʿith), the witness (al-shahīd), the truth (al-ḥaqq), the trustee (al-wakīl), the strong (al-qawī), the firm (al-matīn) — and in one transmission, the manifest (al-mubīn) — the protector (al-walī), the praiseworthy (al-ḥamīd), the enumerator (al-muḥṣī), the initiator (al-mubdiʾ), the restorer (al-muʿīd), the giver of life (al-muḥyī), the giver of death (al-mumīt), the living (al-ḥayy), the self-subsisting (al-qayyūm), the noble (al-mājid), the finder (al-wājid), the one (al-wāḥid), the unique (al-aḥad), the eternal refuge (al-ṣamad), the able (al-qādir), the omnipotent (al-muqtadir), the advancer (al-muqaddim), the delayer (al-muʾakhkhir), the first (al-awwal), the last (al-ākhir), the manifest (al-ẓāhir), the hidden (al-bāṭin), the governor (al-wālī), the exalted (al-mutaʿālī), the source of all goodness (al-barr), the ever-relenting (al-tawwāb), the avenger (al-muntaqim), the pardoner (al-ʿafū), the kind (al-raʾūf), the owner of all sovereignty (mālik al-mulk), the possessor of majesty and honour (dhū al-jalāl wa-l-ikrām), the equitable (al-muqsiṭ), the gatherer (al-jāmiʿ), the self-sufficient (al-ghanī), the enricher (al-mughnī), the preventer (al-māniʿ), the bringer of harm (al-ḍārr), the bringer of benefit (al-nāfiʿ), the light (al-nūr), the guide (al-hādī), the incomparable originator (al-badīʿ), the everlasting (al-bāqī), the inheritor (al-wārith), the guide to the right way (al-rashīd), the patient (al-ṣabūr).

all of these are names entailing attributes, and that came by way of detail and not by way of the unelaborated. so this is detailed affirmation and unelaborated negation.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------

the fate of one whom no prophet's call has reached

one who was brought up in the lands of unbelief and never heard of islam at all, and whom the call did not reach, and who died upon that — what does the revealed law say about him?

god, exalted, says: {and we were not to punish until we had sent a messenger} (sūrat al-isrāʾ 17:15). so whoever this call did not reach is raised on the day of resurrection, and a prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, is sent to him and he is tested by him: if he believes him, he enters the garden; and if he denies him, he enters the fire.
r:
ما معنى النفي المجمل والإثبات المفصل الذي يرد دائما في كتب أهل السنة؟

أن النفي المجمل هو أن ينفي الله تعالى عن نفسه بعض الأمور على سبيل الإجمال ولا يفصل فيها، مثل قوله تعالى: {لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ (3) وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ (4)} [الإخلاص] فهذا نفي إجمالي ومثل قوله: {لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِ شَيْءٌ} [الشورى 11] فهذا نفي إجمالي لكن لم يرد تفصيله، فلم يرد مثلا في آية ولا في حديث: ليس بجوهر ولا بجسم ولا عرض كاللون والطعم إلى غير ذلك من النفي المفصل، كذلك الإثبات جاء مفصلا، فالله سبحانه وتعالى يقول في كتابه: {اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ (255)} [البقرة]

ويقول تعالى: {وَهُوَ الْغَفُورُ الْوَدُودُ (14) ذُو الْعَرْشِ الْمَجِيدُ (15) فَعَّالٌ لِمَا يُرِيدُ (16)} [البروج] وغير هذا من التفصيل مثل ما جاء في حديث أبي هريرة أن النبي (ص) قال: (إن لله تسعة وتسعين اسما مائة إلا واحدا من أحصاها دخل الجنة)، وجاء في بعض طرقه زيادة هو الله الذي لا إله إلا هو الرحمن الرحيم الملك القدوس السلام المؤمن المهيمن العزيز الجبار المتكبر الخالق البارئ المصور الغفار القهار الوهاب الرزاق، الفتاح العليم القابض الباسط الخافض الرافع المعز المذل السميع البصير الحكم العدل اللطيف الخبير الحليم العظيم الغفور الشكور العلي الكبير الحفيظ المقيت وفي رواية المغيث الحسيب الجليل الكريم الرقيب وفي رواية القريب، المجيب الواسع الحكيم الودود المجيد الباعث الشهيد الحق الوكيل القوي المتين وفي رواية المبين الولي الحميد المحصي المبدئ المعيد المحيي المميت الحي القيوم الماجد الواجد الواحد الأحد الصمد القادر المقتدر المقدم المؤخر الأول الآخر الظاهر الباطن الوالي المتعالي البر التواب المنتقم العفو الرؤوف مالك الملك ذو الجلال والإكرام المقسط الجامع الغني المغني المانع الضار النافع النور الهادي البديع الباقي الوارث الرشيد الصبور. فكل هذه أسماء مقتضية لصفات وجاء ذلك على سبيل التفصيل لا على سبيل الإجمال، فهذا إثبات مفصل ونفي مجمل.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------

مصير من لم تبلغه دعوة نبي

من تربى في بلاد الكفر ولم يسمع قط بالإسلام ولم تبلغه الدعوة فمات على ذلك فما قول الشرع فيه؟

أن الله تعالى يقول: {وما كنا معذبين حتى نبعث رسولا} فمن لم تبلغه هذه الدعوة يبعث يوم القيامة فيبعث إليه النبي (ص) يمتحن به، فإن صدقه دخل الجنة وإن كذبه دخل النار.

t: Whoever Trails His Garment out of Pride, God Will Not Look at Him on the Day of Resurrection
a: من جر ثوبه خيلاء لم ينظر الله إليه يوم القيامة
b:
a question about his words, peace and blessings be upon him: 'whoever trails his garment out of pride, god will not look at him on the day of resurrection.' is this restricted to pride or not?

the legal theorists differed over what comes from the lawgiver unqualified (muṭlaq) and then comes qualified (muqayyad): whether the unqualified is to be carried to the qualified, or whether the unqualified remains in its unqualified state and the qualified in its qualification. an example of this is the words of god, exalted, concerning the expiation for the oath of separation: {then the freeing of a slave, before the two of them touch one another} (sūrat al-mujādilah 58:3) — where he did not stipulate islam in it, so he left it unqualified. and concerning the expiation for killing he said: {then the freeing of a believing slave} (sūrat al-nisāʾ 4:92) — where he did stipulate islam in it. so is the unqualified to be carried to the qualified, so that every slave must be a muslim; or does the unqualified remain in its unqualified state, so that the expiation for the oath of separation may be a non-muslim, while the expiation for killing must be a muslim? this is a place of disagreement among the legal theorists.

it is soundly established from the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, that in what concerns the letting down of the garment (isbāl) there is both an unqualified text and a qualified one. as for the unqualified: his words, peace and blessings be upon him, 'what is below the ankles is in the fire.' and as for the qualified: his words, 'whoever trails his garment out of pride' — he qualified that with pride. some of the people of knowledge carried the matter to the qualification, and held that one who lets down his garment without pride is not threatened with this threat. they adduced as evidence the words of abu bakr, god be pleased with him: 'my lower garment slips down' — and he said: 'you are not one of them.' so abu bakr's lower garment did slip down, but along with that he did not do it out of pride, and the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said to him: 'you are not one of them.' it is understood from this that one who does it without pride is not threatened with this threat.

but the precautionary course is that a person should not let his garment down at all. for the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, saw a man praying in the sacred precinct with his garment let down, and commanded him to repeat the prayer and the purification, making that a nullifier of the ablution and an invalidator of the prayer. for that reason a person must be careful to avoid letting the garment down. and the person who knows that his shroud is narrow, and that it suffices him, and that it is his portion of this lower life, ought to know that letting the garments down and adding to them — going beyond the wrist, for instance, in the dirrāʿah, or going beyond the thumb; and likewise going beyond the ankle in them — has no good in it in any respect whatever. here is the commander of the faithful ʿumar, god be pleased with him: when he had been stabbed, at his death, a young man of the ansar passed before him with his garment let down, and he called him, and said: 'bring him back to me.' and he said: 'raise your garment, for it is more god-fearing, and cleaner, and longer-lasting' — that is, more god-fearing towards god, and cleaner for the garment and purer for it, and also longer-lasting for it, so that it is not exposed to ruin. and it is soundly established in the hadith of ibn ʿumar, god be pleased with them both, that he passed in front of the chamber of hafsah and the messenger of god, peace and blessings be upon him, saw him and called him and said: 'raise your lower garment.' he said: so i raised it. then he said: 'more.' so i did more. then he said: 'more.' so i did more. and when he fell silent, ibn ʿumar made a mark on his shin at that place, so that he would know the place up to which the messenger of god, peace and blessings be upon him, had permitted the lower garment to reach.

-----------------------------------------------------------------

the criterion for distinguishing truth from falsehood

the sects that claim to be upon the truth and that others are upon falsehood have become many. what is to be done about them?

god, exalted, says: {o you who believe, if you are conscious of god, he will give you a criterion and will efface your bad deeds from you} (sūrat al-anfāl 8:29). and the criterion, plainly, is that the standard we have is what muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, brought. whatever agrees with what muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, brought is the truth in which there is no doubt; and whatever contradicts it is thrown back on the one who does it: 'whoever performs an act that our affair is not in accordance with, it is rejected'; 'whoever introduces into this affair of ours something that is not of it, it is rejected.'
r:
سؤال عن قوله صلى الله عليه وسلم«من جر ثوبه خيلاء لم ينظر الله إليه يوم القيامة» فهل هذا مختص بالخيلاء أم لا؟ إن الأصوليين اختلفوا في ما جاء مطلقا من الشارع ثم جاء مقيدا هل يحمل المطلق على المقيد أو يبقى المطلق على إطلاقه و المقيد على قيده فمن أمثلة ذلك قول الله تعالى في كفارة الظهار﴿فتحرير رقبة من قبل أن يتماسا﴾ فلم يشرط فيها الإسلام فجعلها مطلقة وفي كفارة القتل قال﴿فتحرير رقبة مؤمنة﴾ فشرط فيها الإسلام فهل يحمل المطلق على المقيد فكل رقبة لا بد فيها من الإسلام أو يبقى المطلق على إطلاقه فكفارة الظهار يمكن أن تكون غير مسلمة و كفارة القتل لا بد فيها من الإسلام هذا محل خلاف بين الأصوليين

وقد صح عن النبي صلى الله عليه و سلم فيما يتعلق بالإسبال إطلاق و تقييد أما الإطلاق فقوله صلى الله عليه وسلم«ما أسفل من الكعبين في النار» و أما التقييد فقوله «من جر ثوبه خيلاء» فقد قيد ذلك بالخيلاء فحمل ذلك بعض أهل العلم على التقييد فرأوا أن الإسبال من غير خيلاء لا يتوعد صاحبه بهذا الوعيد و استدلوا بقول أبي بكر رضي الله عنه إن إزاري يسترخي فقال«لست منهم» فأبو بكر يسترخي إزاره لكنه مع ذلك لم يفعل ذلك خيلاء فقال له النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم«لست منهم» ويفهم من هذا أن من فعل ذلك من غير خيلاء لا يكون متوعدا بهذا الوعيد لكن الإحتياط أن لا يسبل الإنسان مطلقا فقد رأي النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم رجلا يصلي في الحرم مسبلا فأمره أن يعيد الصلاة والطهارة فجعل ذلك ناقضا للوضوء ومبطلا للصلاة فلذلك لا بد أن يحرص الإنسان على عدم الإسبال و الإنسان الذي يعرف أن أكفانه ضيقة و أنها تكفيه و هي نصيبه من هذه الحياة الدنيا عليه أن يعلم أن الإسبال في الثياب والزيادة فيها تجاوز الرصغ مثلا في (الدراعة) أو تجاوز الإبهام ومثل ذلك تجاوز الكعب فيها لا خير فيه بوجه من الوجوه فهذا أمير المؤمنين عمر رضي الله عنه و وقد طعن عند موته مر بين يديه شاب من الأنصار قد أسبل ثوبه فدعاه فقال ردوه علي فقال إرفع ثوبك فإنه أتقى و أنقى و أبقى فهو أتقى لله و أنقى للثوب وأطهر له وأبقى له أيضا حتى لا يتعرض للتلف وقد صح في حديث بن عمر رضي الله عنهما أنه مر أمام حجرة حفصة فرآه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فدعاه فقال«إرفع إزارك قال فرفعته ثم قال زد فزدت ثم قال زد فزدت» فلما سكت جرح بن عمر ساقه من ذلك المكان حتى يعرف المكان الذي أذن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في بلوغ الإزار إليه.

-----------------------------------------------------------------

معيار تمييز الحق من الباطل

لقد كثرت الفرق التي تدعي أنها على الحق وأن غيرها على الباطل فما العمل بالنسبة لها؟

أن الله تعالى يقول: {يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آَمَنُوا إِنْ تَتَّقُوا اللَّهَ يَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ فُرْقَانًا وَيُكَفِّرْ عَنْكُمْ سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ} [الأنفال 29] والفرقان الواضح أن المعيار الذي لدينا هو ما جاء به محمد (ص)، فما كان موافقا لما جاء به محمد (ص) فهو الحق الذي لا مرية فيه، وما كان مخالفا له فهو مردود على صاحبه «من عمل عملا ليس عليه أمرنا فهو رد»، «من أحدث في أمرنا هذا ما ليس منه فهو رد».

t: Is Someone Who Is Not Salafi in Creed an Associator of Partners with God?
a: هل الذي ليس سلفي العقيدة مشرك؟
b: no. because what is meant here in the matter of belief is that a person believe in god, his angels, his books, his messengers, the last day, and the divine decree (al-qadar), its good and its evil. whoever believes in these is a muslim, and whoever disbelieves in any one of them is not a muslim. so this is the difference between the muslim and the disbeliever: these six matters. and whoever knows nothing of creed (ʿaqīdah) beyond these six matters is saved on the day of resurrection. someone who knew nothing whatever except that he believes in god, and believes in the angels, and believes in the revealed books, and believes in the messengers in a general way and not in detail, and likewise believes in the last day in a general way and not in detail, and believes in the divine decree, its good and its evil — this person is a believer beyond question. if he died upon this, he would enter the garden.
r: لا لأن المقصود هنا في الاعتقاد أن يكون الإنسان مؤمنا بالله وملائكته و كتبه و رسله و اليوم الآخر و القدر خيره و شره فمن كان مؤمنا بهذه فهو المسلم و من كان كافرا بأحد هذه فليس بمسلم فإذا هذا هو الفرق بين المسلم و الكافر هو هذه الأمور الستة و من لا يعلم من العقيدة إلا هذه الأمور الستة ناج يوم القيامة من لم يكن يعلم أي شيء إلا أنه يؤمن بالله و يؤمن بالملائكة و يؤمن بالكتب المنزلة و يؤمن بالرسل إجمالا لا تفصيلا و يؤمن كذلك باليوم الآخر إجمالا لا تفصيلا و يؤمن بالقدر خيره و شره هذا مؤمن قطعا لو مات على هذا دخل الجنة.

t: The Descent of the Messiah, Son of Mary, Peace Be upon Him, and the Signs of the Hour
a: نزول المسيح ابن مريم عليه السلام وعلامات الساعة
b:
this person asks about the descent of the messiah, son of mary, peace be upon him, and about the signs of the hour.

the messiah, son of mary, peace be upon him, was raised up by god, mighty and majestic, to himself, when the jews attempted to kill him; and it was made to appear so to them, and they supposed that they had killed him: {they did not kill him and they did not crucify him, but it was made to appear so to them} (sūrat al-nisāʾ 4:157). god raised him to himself and settled him in the lowest heaven and honoured him there, where old age does not come upon him, nor the affairs of this lower life. he will descend at the end of time as a just judge, at the white minaret east of damascus, renewing the religion of muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, following him, and judging by the mighty qur'an. he will break the cross and kill the swine and fight the jews, until the stone and the tree say: 'muslim! servant of god! this is a jew behind me, so come and kill him' — except the gharqad, for it is one of the trees of the jews.

and the signs of the descent of the messiah, son of mary, are that the rightly guided caliphate will arise at the end of time. this community passes, in the matter of governance, through stages which the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, set out in his words: 'prophethood will be among you as long as god wills it to be, then he will lift it away when he wills to lift it away. then there will be a caliphate upon the way of prophethood as long as god wills it to be' — and he made clear that this is thirty years — 'then he will lift it away when he wills to lift it away. then there will be a biting kingship as long as god wills it to be, then he will lift it away when he wills to lift it away. then there will be a coercive kingship as long as god wills it to be, then he will lift it away when he wills to lift it away. then there will be a caliphate upon the way of prophethood' — and he fell silent.

the caliphate that comes at the end of time has in it twelve caliphs, all of them from quraysh; twelve caliphs arise in it, all of them from quraysh. and at the death of the last of them a trial occurs, and people give the pledge of allegiance to the mahdi. he is a man from the household of the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, whom god sets right in a single night. the muslims agree upon him at the death of the caliph and pledge allegiance to him, and that comes after jerusalem has been conquered. for the caliphate that arises at the end of time conquers jerusalem, and conquers rome, and wages a world war in which it conquers many lands. it remains in conquest for eight years — after the conquest of rome, eight years. you know that in a single day many countries can be conquered; it remains eight years and gains mastery over most of the world. but for all that, it does not finish off the jews; rather their remnants scatter in the earth.

so after the eighth year the antichrist (al-dajjāl) comes out. he comes out from a tract between syria and iraq, and he wreaked havoc to the right and wreaked havoc to the left, working great corruption in the earth. he remains in this earth forty days: a day like a year, and a day like a month, and a day like a week, and the rest of his days — that is, what remains of them — like your days (thirty-seven days like ordinary days). and the other three days: the first a day like a year, because of how many events pass in it and how many things occur in it; and a day like a month; and a day like a week. the remnants of the jews gather to him, and many people are put to trial by him.

then when the messiah, son of mary, descends at the white minaret east of damascus at the time of the dawn prayer, he descends as though he had come out of a dīmās — that is, as though he had come out of a bath — intensely white. when he raises his head, drops like pearls run down from him; and when he lowers it, they trickle down. his hands are upon two angels, between two mathrūdatayn, and his garments are white. he enters the mosque and no one doubts him. they say: 'come forward, prophet of god, and lead the prayer.' he says: 'it was not called for me; your imam that day is from among you.' it is not lawful for any disbeliever to catch the scent of his breath but that he melts as salt melts in water; and his breath reaches as far as his sight reaches. then he overtakes the antichrist at the gate of lydda — the gate of lydda is now tel aviv airport — and kills him there.
r:
هذا يسأل عن نزول المسيح ابن مريم عليه السلام وعن علامات الساعة؟ إن المسيح ابن مريم عليه السلام قد رفعه الله عز و جل إليه عندما حاول اليهود قتله فشبه لهم و ظنوا أنهم قتلوه ﴿و ما قتلوه و ما صلبوه و لكن شبه لهم﴾ و قد رفعه الله إليه و أسكنه في السماء الدنيا و أكرمه هنالك لا يعروه المشيب و لا أمور هذه الحياة الدنيا و سينزل في آخر الزمان حكما عدلا عند المنارة البيضاء شرقي دمشق مجددا لملة محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم متبعا له حاكما بالقرآن العظيم وسيكسر الصليب ويقتل الخنزير و يقاتل اليهود حتى يقول الحجر والشجر يا مسلم يا عبد الله هذا يهودي خلفي فتعال فاقتله إلا الغرقد فإنه من شجر اليهود

وعلامات نزول المسيح ابن مريم هي أن تقوم الخلافة الراشدة في آخر الزمان فهذه الأمة تمر في السياسة بأطوار بينها النبي صلى الله عليه و سلم بقوله: «تكون فيكم النبوة ما شاء الله لها أن تكون ثم يرفعها إذا شاء أن يرفعها ثم تكون خلافة على منهج النبوة ما شاء الله لها أن تكون و قد بين ذلك أنه ثلاثون سنة ثم يرفعها إذا شاء أن يرفعها ثم تكون ملكا عاضا ما شاء الله لها أن تكون ثم يرفعها إذا شاء أن يرفعها ثم تكون ملكا جبرية ما شاء الله لها أن تكون ثم يرفعها إذا شاء أن يرفعها ثم تكون خلافة على منهج النبوة و سكت» و الخلافة التي تكون في آخر الزمان فيها اثنى عشر خليفة كلهم من قريش يقوم فيها اثنى عشر خليفة كلهم من قريش و عند موت الخليفة الأخير منهم تقع فتنة فيبايع الناس المهدي و هو رجل من آل بيت النبي صلى الله عليه و سلم يصلحه الله في ليلة واحدة فيتفق عليه المسلمون عند موت الخليفة فيبايعونه و يكون ذلك بعد أن فتح بيت المقدس فالخلافة التي تقوم في آخر الزمان تفتح بيت المقدس و تفتح روما و تقيم حربا دولية تفتح فيها كثيرا من البلدان فتمكث في الفتح ثماني سنوات بعد فتح روما ثماني سنوات أنتم تعلمون أن اليوم الواحد يمكن أن يفتح فيه كثير من الدول تمكث ثمان سنوات فتسيطر على أغلب العالم و لكن مع ذلك لا تقضي على اليهود بل يتفرق فلولهم في الأرض فبعد السنة الثامنة يخرج الدجال يخرج خلة بين الشام و العراق فعاث يمينا و عاث شمالا يفسد في الأرض فسادا عظيما و يمكث في هذه الأرض أربعين يوما يوم كسنة و يوم كشهر و يوم كجمعة و سائر أيامه أي بقيتها كأيامكم (سبعة و ثلاثون يوما مثل الأيام العادية) و الأيام الأخرى الثلاث الأول يوم كسنة لكثرة ما يمر فيه من الأحداث و يحصل فيه من الأمور و يوم كشهر و يوم كأسبوع و يجتمع عليه فلول اليهود و يفتن به كثير من الناس فإذا نزل المسيح ابن مريم عند المنارة البيضاء شرقي دمشق في وقت صلاة الفجر ينزل كأنما خرج من ديماس أي كأنما خرج من حمام شديد البياض إذا رفع رأسه تحدر منه مثل الجمان و إذا طأطأه تقاطر و يداه على ملكين بين مثرودتين و ملابسه بيضاء فيدخل المسجد فلا يرتاب فيه أحد يقولون تقدم يا نبي الله فصل فيقول: ما أقيمت لي و إمامكم يومئذ منكم لا يحل لكافر أن يجد ريح نفسه إلا ذاب كما يذوب الملح في الماء و إن نفسه ليبلغ ما يبلغ بصره فيدرك المسيح الدجال عند باب اللد باب اللد الآن هو مطار تلابيب فيقتله هنالك.

t: Is al-Khidr Alive or Dead?
a: هل الخضر حي أو ميت؟
b:
the preponderant view concerning al-khidr is that he was a prophet from among the prophets of the children of israel; and that the prophets of god were sealed with muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him; and that none of them remained alive after the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him — definitively — except jesus son of mary, who will descend as a renewer of the religion of muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, and as one of his followers. he will not descend in the capacity of messengership; rather he will break the cross and kill the swine and make war on the christians. therefore al-khidr is nothing but like the rest of the prophets of the children of israel: he has died, just as moses died, and aaron, and others of the prophets of the children of israel, peace be upon them all.

among the evidences for that is what al-bukhari adduced in the sahih for this, with the hadith of ibn ʿumar, that the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, looked at them one night and said: 'do you see this night of yours? at the end of a hundred years from it, there will not remain upon the face of the earth a single breathing soul of those who are upon it.'

all those who lived in the lifetime of the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, died before the completion of a hundred years, and the last of them to die was abu al-tufayl ʿamir ibn wathilah, god be pleased with him, who died in the year one hundred of the hijra. and that night was not at the beginning of the hijra, so it means that years remained after that night in which not one of the companions was left, and in which not one was left of those who had been upon the face of the earth at that time. for this reason many of the hadith scholars have adduced this as evidence for the falsehood of those who claim great longevity — those who claimed that they had lived three hundred years or more; the hadith scholars adduced this hadith as evidence of their lying. likewise the hafiz ibn hajar, god have mercy on him, said, in his notice on salih ibn kaysan, god have mercy on him — and salih ibn kaysan is among the senior companions of al-zuhri, of the generation of malik and maʿmar ibn rashid and ʿubayd allah ibn ʿumar al-ʿumari and others — he said: people claim that salih ibn kaysan lived a hundred and sixty years; and if that were so he would have met the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him; and if that were so he would have died before a hundred years from that night.

-----------------------------------------------------------

has the appearance of the antichrist drawn near?

as for its drawing near, there is no doubt of it. this community, the community of muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, is the last of the communities of this world, and the antichrist will inevitably come out among it; and we too are in the last of the generations of this community. for that reason we are awaiting the antichrist. but the antichrist will not come out until after the rightly guided caliphate arises, and after jerusalem is conquered and rome is conquered. when rome is conquered, the antichrist will come out. he comes out from a tract between syria and iraq, and he wreaked havoc to the right and wreaked havoc to the left.

is someone who is not salafi in creed an associator of partners with god?

no. because what is meant here in the matter of belief is that a person believe in god, his angels, his books, his messengers, the last day, and the divine decree (al-qadar), its good and its evil. whoever believes in these is a muslim, and whoever disbelieves in any one of them is not a muslim. so this is the difference between the muslim and the disbeliever: these six matters. and whoever knows nothing of creed (ʿaqīdah) beyond these six matters is saved on the day of resurrection. someone who knew nothing whatever except that he believes in god, and believes in the angels, and believes in the revealed books, and believes in the messengers in a general way and not in detail, and likewise believes in the last day in a general way and not in detail, and believes in the divine decree, its good and its evil — this person is a believer beyond question. if he died upon this, he would enter the garden.
r:
الخضر الراجح فيه أنه نبي من أنبياء بني إسرائيل و أن أنبياء الله قد ختموا بمحمد صلى الله عليه وسلم و لم يبق أحد منهم حيا بعد النبي صلى الله عليه و سلم قطعا إلا عيسى بن مريم الذي سينزل مجددا لملة محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم و من أتباعه و لن ينزل بصفة الرسالة بل سيكسر الصليب و يقتل الخنزير و يحارب النصارى و لذلك فالخضر ما هو إلا مثل غيره من أنبياء بني إسرائيل قد مات مثل ما مات موسى و هارون و غيرهما من أنبياء بني إسرائيل عليهم السلام أجمعين و من أدلة ذلك ما استدل به البخاري في الصحيح على هذا بحديث بن عمر أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم نظر إليهم ذات ليلة فقال:« أرأيتكم ليلتكم هذه فإنه لا يبقى على وجه الأرض ذو نفس منفوسة ممن هو عليها بعد مائة سنة منها»

فكل الذين عاشوا في حياة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ماتوا قبل تمام مائة سنة و آخرهم موتا أبو الطفيل عامر ابن واثلة رضي الله عنه و قد مات سنة مائة من الهجرة و تلك الليلة ليست أول الهجرة فمعناه أنه بقي بعد تلك الليلة سنوات لم يبق فيها أحد من الصحابة و لم يبق فيها أحد من الذين كانوا على وجه الأرض إذ ذاك و لهذا استدل كثير من المحدثين على كذب الذين يدعون التعمير الذين ادعوا أنهم عمروا ثلاث مائة سنة أو أكثر استدل المحدثون على كذبهم بهذا الحديث و كذلك قال الحافظ بن حجر رحمه الله في ترجمة صالح بن كيسان رحمه الله و صالح بن كيسان من كبار أصحاب الزهري من طبقة مالك و معمر بن راشد و عبيد الله بن عمر العمري و غيرهما قال: إن الناس يزعمون أن صالح بن كيسان عاش مائة و ستين سنة و لو كان كذلك لكان قد أدرك النبي صلى الله عليه و سلم و لو كان كذلك لمات قبل مائة سنة من تلك الليلة.

-----------------------------------------------------------

هل اقترب ظهور الدجال؟

بالنسبة للاقتراب لا يشك فيه فهذه الأمة وهي أمة محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم آخر أمم الدنيا، والدجال خارج فيها لا محالة، ونحن أيضا في آخر قرون هذه الأمة، فلذلك نحن ننتظر الدجال، ولكن لا يخرج الدجال إلا بعد أن تقوم الخلافة الراشدة، وبعد أن يفتح بيت المقدس وتفتح روما، وإذا فتحت روما فسيخرج الدجال، فيخرج خلة بين الشام والعراق فعاث يمينا وعاث شمالا.

-----------------------------------------------------------

هل الذي ليس سلفي العقيدة مشرك؟

لا لأن المقصود هنا في الاعتقاد أن يكون الإنسان مؤمنا بالله وملائكته و كتبه و رسله و اليوم الآخر و القدر خيره و شره فمن كان مؤمنا بهذه فهو المسلم و من كان كافرا بأحد هذه فليس بمسلم فإذا هذا هو الفرق بين المسلم و الكافر هو هذه الأمور الستة و من لا يعلم من العقيدة إلا هذه الأمور الستة ناج يوم القيامة من لم يكن يعلم أي شيء إلا أنه يؤمن بالله و يؤمن بالملائكة و يؤمن بالكتب المنزلة و يؤمن بالرسل إجمالا لا تفصيلا و يؤمن كذلك باليوم الآخر إجمالا لا تفصيلا و يؤمن بالقدر خيره و شره هذا مؤمن قطعا لو مات على هذا دخل الجنة.

t: Is the Bridge Set over Hell Horizontally or Vertically?
a: هل الصراط منصوب على متن جهنم أفقيا أم عموديا؟
b:
the bridge passes above hell, set crosswise over it. hell is brought near, below the garden, and people pass above it upon the bridge. whoever is of its people falls into it, dropping straight down from above it; and whoever is saved from it praises god when he sees it, for it belongs to the completeness of the favour shown him that he should see what he has been saved from. this is part of god's wisdom in the bridge. for all its thinness and its sharpness, and the hooks that are on it, and the watch-posts and the severity upon it, god saves from it whoever is saved.

for that reason people vary upon it enormously. among them is one who passes like the sent wind; among them one who passes like the flashing lightning; among them one who passes like the finest of horses and camels; among them one who passes like a man running hard; among them one who crawls on his backside; and among them one who crawls on his belly only. then within that they fall into three classes. either one who is saved and delivered, whom no harm at all has touched and to whom nothing has clung; or one who is scratched and let go — 'scratched', that is, wounded — or whose belly is split open, or whose eyes have fallen out, or his hand, or his foot, by the hooks of the bridge, and who is then saved after that, so that when he enters the garden what he lost returns to him and his form is made whole. and the third class is one flung headlong on his face into the fire of hell, falling from this towering distance — the distance above hell is exceedingly high.

it is enough on this head that the righteous who pass above it are kept far from the fire and do not hear its faint sound, even though its faint sound is heard from a journey of thousands of years: {indeed, those for whom the best has already gone forth from us — those are kept far from it. they do not hear its faint sound, and they abide in what their souls desire} (sūrat al-anbiyāʾ 21:101–102). and yet they do see it; and here lies the difference between seeing and hearing the faint sound. hearing the faint sound has the more penetrating effect: hearing its sounds has a more penetrating effect, and more terror in it, than mere seeing from afar. that is why the seeing was a bestowal of favour — they see the fire so that they may know that god has favoured them and saved them from it — but they do not hear its faint sound, lest their hearts be shaken by the intensity of the horror and the dread.
r:
إن الصراط يمر فوق جهنم باعتراض فوقها فجهنم تقرب دون الجنة و يمر فوقها الناس على الصراط فمن كان من أهلها يسقط فيها بتمكن من فوقها و من كان ناجيا منها حمد الله حين رآها فإنه من تمام النعمة عليه أن يرى ما نجا منه فهذا من حكمة الله في الصراط و على رقته و حدته و ما فيه من الكلاليب و عليه ومن المراقب و الشدة ينجى الله منه ما نجا و لذلك فإن الناس يتفاوتون عليه تفاوتا عظيما فمنهم من يمر كالريح المرسلة و منهم من يمر البرق الخاطف

و منهم من يمر كأجاويد الخيل و الإبل و منهم من يمر كالرجل يشتد عدوا و منهم من يزحف على مقعدته و منهم من يزحف على بطنه فقط ثم هم في ذلك ثلاثة أقسام إما ناج مسلم لم يمسسه أي أذى و لم يلصق به شيء و إما مخدوش مرسل( خدش أي جرح)أو شق بطنه أو سقطت عينيه أو يده أو رجله بكلاليب الصراط ثم نجا بعد ذلك فإذا دخل الجنة عاد إليه ما فقد و تمت خلقته و القسم الثالث مكردس على وجهه في نار جهنم يسقط من هذه المسافة الشاهفة مسافة فوق جهنم شاهقة جدا و لذلك يكفي منها أن الأبرار الذين يمرون فوقه مبعدون عن النار لا يسمعون حسيسها مع أن حسيسها يسمع من مسيرة ألاف السنين ﴿إن الذين سبقت لهم منا الحسنى أولائك عنها مبعدون لا يسمعون حسيسها و هم فيما اشتهت أنفسهم خالدون﴾ و مع ذلك يرونها وهنا الفرق بين الرؤية و سماع الحسيس فسماع الحسيس أبلغ تأثيرا فسماع أصواتها أبلغ تأثيرا و رعبا من مجرد الرؤية من بعد و لذلك كانت الرؤية امتنانا لأنهم يرون النار حتى يعلموا أن الله قد أنعم عليهم و نجاهم منها و لكن لا يسمعون حسيسها ليلا تتأثر قلوبهم من شدة الهول و الفزع.

t: Do the Souls of the Dead Visit One Another?
a: هل تتزاور أرواح الموتى
b:
someone claims to transport the souls of the dead to a place where their relatives, and those among the dead whom they loved, are. what is your comment on that?

as for these matters that have to do with souls, our share of knowledge of them is what god, exalted, has set out in his words: {and they ask you about the spirit. say: the spirit is from the command of my lord, and you have been given only a little knowledge} (sūrat al-isrāʾ 17:85). so we know that souls are from the command of god, and we have no knowledge of them beyond that; and whether they move or remain in one place is a matter referred back to revelation. it has come in revelation that the souls of the felicitous are in the crops of green birds that take shade among the shades of the garden and eat of its fruits, and that the souls of the wretched are imprisoned in sijjīn, which is in the seventh earth. so whoever is of the people of felicity, his soul is in the crops of those birds in the garden; and whoever is of the people of wretchedness, his soul is imprisoned in sijjīn. we ask god for safety and well-being.
r:
من يدعي نقل أرواح الموتى إلى مكان فيه أقاربهم وأهل مودتهم من الأموات، ما تعليقكم على ذلك ؟

أن هذه الأمور المتعلقة بالأرواح حظنا منها من العلم هو ما بينه الله تعالى بقوله: {وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الرُّوحِ قُلِ الرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّي وَمَا أُوتِيتُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا (85)}[الإسراء] فنحن نعلم أن الأرواح من أمر الله وليس لنا من علمها أكثر من ذلك، وانتقالها أو استقرارها المرجع فيه إلى الوحي، وقد جاء في الوحي أن أرواح السعداء في حواصل طير خضر تتفيأ من ظلال الجنة وتأكل من ثمارها، وأرواح أهل الشقاء مسجونة في سجين وهو في الأرض السابعة، فمن كان من أهل السعادة فروحه في حواصل تلك الطير في الجنة، ومن كان من أهل الشقاء فروحه مسجونة في سجين نسأل الله السلامة والعافية.

t: Did the Messenger, Peace and Blessings Be upon Him, See His Lord?
a: هل رأى الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم ربه ؟
b: the answer: the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, was asked this very question — abu dharr asked him about it — and he said: 'light; how should i see him?' the messenger of god, peace and blessings be upon him, did see the greatest sign on his night ascent (miʿrāj), and he saw gabriel, and saw him in his own form, having six hundred wings, the span between two of his wings reaching from the east to the west: {and he certainly saw him at another descent, by the lote tree of the furthest boundary, near which is the garden of refuge} (sūrat al-najm 53:13–15). but god, glorified and exalted, spoke to him, and he heard his speech, mighty and majestic.
r: الجواب: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم سئل عن هذا السؤال فسأله أبو ذر عنه فقال «نور أنى أراه»، و قد رأى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم الآية الكبرى في معراجه و رأى جبريل و رآه على صورته له ستمائة جناح ما بين جناحيه بين المشرق و المغرب،﴿و لقد رآه نزلة أخرى عند سدرة المنتهى عندها جنة المأوى﴾، و لكنه كلمه الله سبحانه و تعالى فسمع كلامه عز و جل.

t: Is Visiting Graves Forbidden?
a: هل زيارة القبور حرام؟
b: no. visiting graves, when it is done in the manner the revealed law allows, is recommended (mandūb): it brings the hereafter to mind. this is on account of the words of the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him: 'i had forbidden you from visiting graves; now visit them, for they remind you of the hereafter.' and he said, peace and blessings be upon him: 'i had forbidden you from visiting graves; now visit them, but do not speak hujr.' and hujr is foul speech — that is, speech not permitted in the revealed law. the proprieties of the lawful visit have already been given in a number of lessons, which can be reviewed on the recordings, together with the explanation of the difference between the visit that accords with the sunnah and the visit that is an innovation.
r: لا زيارة القبور إذا كانت على الوجه الشرعي فهي مندوبة تذكر الآخرة لقول النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم:«كنت نهيتكم عن زيارة القبور فزوروها فإنها تذكركم الآخرة » و قال صلى الله عليه وسلم: « كنت نهيتكم عن زيارة القبور فزوروها و لا تقولوا هجرا » و الهجر الكلام القبيح أي غير المأذون به شرعا و قد سبقت آداب الزيارة الشرعية في عدد من الدروس بالإمكان أن تراجع في الأشرطة و بيان الفرق بين الزيارة السنية و الزيارة المبتدعة.

t: May Whatever Could Be a Miracle for a Prophet Also Be a Wonder for a Friend of God?
a: هل ما جاز أن يكون معجزة لنبي جاز أن يكون كرامة لولي؟
b:
no. that cannot occur under any circumstance. if it were so, it would be possible for revelation to come down upon friends of god (awliyāʾ) who are not prophets — for the miracle of the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, is the revelation sent down to him. if everything that could be a miracle for a prophet could be a wonder (karāmah) for a friend of god, then many people would claim that a qur'an to be recited had been sent down to them; and this cannot occur at all, and no believer can conceive of it.

but the point of inquiry in the question is how far the wonders of the friends of god extend. the wonders of the friends of god are real, and affirming them is part of the creed of the people of the sunnah and the community: namely that god honours those who obey him. for god is the most generous of the generous and the most merciful of the merciful, and it is not possible that the people of faith and the people of unbelief should be equal in his sight — he who says in his book: {shall we then treat those who submit like the criminals? what is the matter with you? how do you judge?} (sūrat al-qalam 68:35–36).

so one who is of the people of god-consciousness, scrupulousness, worship and uprightness cannot ever be the equal of the open transgressor; they cannot be equal in the sight of god, exalted. for that reason he honours his friends with what helps them to obey him, and ennobles them with kinds of ennoblement, among which are beneficial knowledge and righteous action. the greatest of these wonders is steadfastness upon the religion: the greatest wonder with which god honours a friend of his is his steadfastness in the matter of religion, such that he has mastery over his own limbs where god has made something forbidden to him. the wonders are real, but there is disagreement over their extent — how far they reach. they agreed that they do not reach the descent of revelation, nor the coming to be of a child without a father, nor the raising of the dead; but they do reach what is below that, such as knowledge without learning, and help towards obedience, such as the folding up of distances, and the appearing of money without any means being taken to it, and the like. this does occur.

ʿumar ibn al-khattab, god be pleased with him, had his voice folded across a vast distance between medina and persia, when he called out to sariyah ibn zunaym and said: 'sariyah, the mountain! the mountain!' this report was brought out by ahmad in faḍāʾil al-ṣaḥābah by several chains of transmission, one of them a sound chain; and ibn wahb brought it out in al-jāmiʿ, and a number of authors in the collections of hadith; and it is a sound report. likewise ʿuthman, god be pleased with him, used to see the trace of a sin on the face of the one who had committed it. anas ibn malik was with him, and a man came in upon him, and he said: 'what is the matter with one of you, that he comes in upon me with the trace of fornication in his eyes?' and the man confessed. so anas said to him: 'is there revelation after the messenger of god, peace and blessings be upon him?' he said: 'no — but it is the discernment of the believer.'

it is the same in the case of a number of the companions of the messenger of god, peace and blessings be upon him: great wonders occurred for them. al-ʿala ibn al-hadrami, god be pleased with him, waded into the sea and it dried before him until he crossed it. and likewise the emigrant woman, for whom a bucket was let down from heaven so that she drank from it, when her own people left her thirsty. likewise those below them among the successors — much of this occurred for them too. indeed the shaykh al-islam ibn taymiyyah, god have mercy on him, said that the more faith and worship are diminished among people, and the more knowledge is diminished, the more the wonders increase — because when people are people of faith and scrupulousness and god-consciousness, they have no need of these wonders that increase their faith in the unseen; and when their faith in the unseen is diminished, these wonders become frequent among them, for the friends of god who are the people of steadfastness and of holding fast to the truth. and even so, many people confuse a wonder with what is no wonder at all.
r:
لا ولا يمكن أن يقع ذلك بحال من الأحوال لو كان كذلك لجاز أن ينزل الوحي على الأولياء الذين ليسوا بأنبياء فمعجزة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم الوحي المنزل إليه فلو كان كلما جاز أن يكون معجزة لنبي يجوز أن يكون كرامة لولي لادعى كثير من الناس أنهم أنزل إليهم قرءان يتلى وهذا لا يمكن أن يقع أصلا و لا يمكن أن يتصوره مؤمن لكن البحث في المسألة هو ما تصل إليه كرامات الأولياء فكرامات الأولياء حق ومن عقيدة أهل السنة والجماعة إثباتها وهي أن الله يكرم من أطاعه فالله أكرم الأكرمين وأرحم الراحمين ولا يمكن أن يتساوى لديه أهل الإيمان وأهل الكفر وهو الذي يقول في كتابه﴿أفنجعل المسلمين كالمجرمين ما لكم كيف تحكمون﴾

فمن كان من أهل التقوى والورع و العبادة والصلاح لا يمكن أن يستوي مع الفاسق المجاهر أبدا لا يمكن أن يستويا عند الله تعالى فلذلك يكرم أولياءه بما يعينهم عليه من طاعته و يشرفهم بأنواع التشريف الذي منه العلم النافع والعمل الصالح وهذه الكرامات أعظمها الاستقامة على الدين أعظم كرامة يكرم الله بها الولي استقامته على أمر الدين بحيث يملك جوارحه عما حرم الله عليه والكرامات حق لكن اختلف في مبلغها إلى أي شيء تبلغ واتفقوا على أنها لا تبلغ نزول الوحي أو وجود ولد من غير والد أو إحياء الموتى لكنها تبلغ ما دون ذلك كالعلم من غير تعلم وكالعون على الطاعة كطي المسافات ووجود الأموال من غير تسبب ونحو ذلك فهذا حاصل فعمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه طوي صوته مسافة شاسعة ما بين المدينة و بين فارس حين نادى سارية ابن زنيم فقال يا سارية الجبل الجبل وهذا الحديث أخرجه أحمد في فضائل الصحابة بعدة أسانيد أحدها إسناد صحيح وقد أخرجه ابن وهب في الجامع و عدد من المؤلفين في دواوين الحديث وهو حديث صحيح وكذلك فإن عثمان رضي الله عنه كان يرى أثر المعصية في وجه صاحبها فقد كان عنده أنس ابن مالك فدخل عليه رجل فقال: ما بال أحدكم يدخل علي وفي عينيه أثر الزنا فأقر الرجل فقال له أنس أوحي بعد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال لا ولكنها فراسة المؤمن وكذلك الحال بالنسبة لعدد من أصحاب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم حصلت لهم كرامات عظيمة فالعلاء ابن الحضرمي رضي الله عنه خاض البحر فيبس أمامه حتى قطعه وكذلك فإن المرأة المهاجرة تدلى لها دلو من السماء حتى شربت منه حين ظمأها أهلها، وكذلك فإن من دونهم من التابعين حصل لهم أيضا شيء كثير من هذا بل قد قال شيخ الإسلام ابن تيمية رحمه الله إن الكرامات كلما انتقص الإيمان والعبادة في الناس وكلما انتقص العلم كلما ازدادت هي لأن الناس إذا كانوا أهل إيمان و ورع وتقوى لا يحتاجون إلى هذه الكرامات التي تزيد إيمانهم بالغيب وإذا نقص لديهم الإيمان بالغيب كثرت فيهم هذه الكرامات لأولياء الله أصحاب الإستقامة و الإلتزام بالحق ومع هذا فإن كثيرا من الناس تلتبس عليهم الكرامة بما ليس بكرامة.

t: Is This the Time of al-Khuwayṣṣah?
a: هل هذا زمان الخويصة ؟
b:
no. the time of al-khuwayṣṣah is the time in which a person is not obeyed when he commands: when he forbids a wrong he is not obeyed, and when he enjoins a right he is not obeyed. in this time of ours people still — praise be to god — have much good in them, so that time has not yet come. nor is that time continuous for a long period, as some people imagine: they suppose that the time of al-khuwayṣṣah is the end of this community, or a continuous stretch of it, and this is not correct. the time of al-khuwayṣṣah is a period that passes over towns when god wills to destroy them; for god, exalted, has undertaken the destruction of every town before the coming of the hour, saying, exalted: {and there is no town but that we shall destroy it before the day of resurrection, or punish it with a severe punishment; that is written in the book} (sūrat al-isrāʾ 17:58).

and god has set out the sign of that destruction: that he gives power over the town to the luxurious among its people, so that they command in it and multiply corruption in it, and no one is able to change what they do or to denounce them — because they make people afraid, so that everyone submits to them and praises them to their faces and blames them behind their backs, and denounces nothing of what they do. so when that appears, and there is no one to denounce the wrong, that is the time of al-khuwayṣṣah: the people of good withdraw, until the punishment comes and destroys that town. that is why god, exalted, said: {and when we will to destroy a town, we command its luxurious ones} (sūrat al-isrāʾ 17:16) — 'we command' meaning we made them commanders, which is why in the other canonical reading it is {we appointed as commanders}; {so they transgress in it, and the word comes due against it, and we destroy it utterly}. these things follow closely on one another, because the connective fa indicates sequence and immediate succession, so when the linkage comes with fa it implies closeness: {we command its luxurious ones, so they transgress in it, so the word comes due against it, so we destroy it utterly}. they are matters very different from one another. these things — their time is the time of al-khuwayṣṣah, if that happens.

but this community is still in a good state, and there are in it many of the people of steadfastness and uprightness, and many who love good and love its people. so let no one be deluded into thinking that withdrawal is better in this time of ours; that is not correct. the believer who mixes with people and bears their harm patiently is better than the believer who does not mix with people and does not bear their harm patiently.
r:
لا فزمان الخويصة هو الزمان الذي لا يطاع فيه الإنسان إذا أمر، إذا نهى عن منكر لم يطع و إذا أمر بمعروف لم يطع و هذا الزمان ما زال الناس و لله الحمد فيهم خير كثير فلم يأت ذلك الزمان بعد و ذلك الزمان لا يكون أيضا مستمرا لوقت طويل كما يتوهمه بعض الناس يظن أن زمان الخويصة هو آخر هذه الأمة أو زمان مستمر منها وهذا غير صحيح زمان الخويصة فترة تمر بالقرى إذا أراد الله إهلاكها فإن الله تعالى تعهد بإهلاك كل قرية قبل قيام الساعة فقال تعالى:﴿و إن من قرية إلا نحن مهلكوها قبل يوم القيامة أو معذبوها عذابا شديدا كان ذلك في الكتاب مسطورا﴾

و قد بين الله علامة ذلك الإهلاك و هو أن يسلط عليها مترفي أهلها فيأمرهم فيها فيكثروا فيها الفساد فلا يستطيع أحد التغيير عليهم و لا الإنكار عليهم لأنهم يخوفون الناس فيستسلم لهم الجميع فيمدحونهم في وجوههم و يذمونهم في قفاهم و لا ينكرون عليهم شيئا مما يفعلونه فإذا ظهر ذلك و لم يوجد منكر للمنكر فذلك وقت الخويصة يعتزل أهل الخير حتى يأتي العذاب فيهلك تلك القرية و لذلك قال الله تعالى: ﴿و إذا أردنا أن نهلك قرية أمرنا مترفيها﴾، أمرنا بمعنى جعلناهم أمراء و لذلك في القراءة الأخرى ﴿أمَّرنا﴾ ﴿ففسقوا فيها فحق عليها القول فدمرناها تدميرا﴾ وهذه الأمور متقاربة لأن الفاء للترتيب و التعقيب فإذا جاء العطف بالفاء فإنه يقتضي القرب: ﴿أمرنا مترفيها ففسقوا فيها فحق عليها القول فدمرناها تدميرا﴾ أمور متفاوتة جدا و هذه الأمور وقتها هو وقت الخويصة إذا حصل ذلك لكن هذه الأمة ما زالت بخير و فيها كثير من أهل الاستقامة و الصلاح وفيها كثير من الذين يحبون الخير و يحبون أهله و لذلك لا يغتر أحد بأن العزلة أفضل في هذا الزمان فهذا غير صحيح فالمؤمن الذي يخالط الناس ويصبر على أذاهم خير من المؤمن الذي لا يخالط الناس و لا يصبر على أذاهم.

t: The Means of Strengthening Faith
a: وسائل تقوية الإيمان
b:
what is the best way to develop faith?

there is no doubt that faith increases through righteous deeds and through the means that lead to god, glorified and exalted. in some deeds their increasing of faith can be observed — such as the voluntary prayers, and especially standing in prayer at night: prayer in the night while people are asleep. and likewise hidden acts of charity; and likewise pondering the qur'an; and likewise admonition, with a person alone, until his tears flow; and likewise visiting graves, and visiting the sick, and beholding the wonders of god's creation; and likewise pondering the signs of this vast, wondrous, governed universe. all of this is among the things that increase faith in god, glorified and exalted, and increase love of him and reliance upon him.

and among the most effective of that is avoiding acts of disobedience, for it is these acts of disobedience that sap faith and weaken it. when a person falls into an act of disobedience, his faith is diminished by the measure of that act: if it was a small one, his faith is diminished by a small amount; and if it was a great one, his faith is diminished by a great amount, and so on. so let a person safeguard his faith first by avoiding acts of disobedience, and then let him increase it and adorn it by increasing righteous deeds, as far as he is able to find a way to it. the best of that is the obligatory acts, and then what is added to them of voluntary acts — as is soundly established in the noble divine report, in which the messenger of god, peace and blessings be upon him, said, relating from his lord, mighty and majestic: 'my servant draws near to me with nothing more beloved to me than what i have made obligatory upon him. and my servant continues to draw near to me with voluntary acts until i love him; and when i love him i am his hearing with which he hears, and his sight with which he sees, and his hand with which he grasps, and his foot with which he walks. and if he asks me, i shall surely give him; and if he seeks refuge with me, i shall surely grant him refuge.'

and there is no doubt that among the things that diminish faith is occupying oneself with the adornments of this world and turning towards it, for this world is a distraction from the hereafter; whereas the hereafter — pondering it, and reflecting on it, and remembering the destroyer of pleasures, which is death — is among the things that increase faith. but to be immersed in preoccupation with the world's pleasures and its appetites, and in looking at what its people have, is among the things that diminish faith. that is why god, exalted, said to his messenger, peace and blessings be upon him: {and do not strain your eyes towards what we have given certain groups of them to enjoy, the splendour of the life of this world, that we may try them thereby; and the provision of your lord is better and more lasting. and command your family to pray, and be steadfast in it. we ask no provision of you; it is we who provide for you. and the final outcome belongs to god-consciousness} (sūrat ṭā hā 20:131–132). so a person should look less at what he has not been given of this world, and should look, in worldly matters, to one who is below him, and look, in religion, to one who is above him — for that is more fitting to keep him from making light of god's favour upon him, as the messenger of god, peace and blessings be upon him, directed.
r:
ما هي أفضل طريقة لتنمية الإيمان؟

لا شك أن الإيمان يزداد بالأعمال الصالحة وبالوسائل إلى الله سبحانه وتعالى فبعض الأعمال تشاهد زيادتها للإيمان، وذلك مثل نوافل الصلوات وبالأخص قيام الليل، فصلاة الليل والناس نيام، وكذلك الصدقات الخفية وكذلك تدبر القرآن وكذلك الموعظة والإنسان خال حتى تسيل دمعتاه، وكذلك زيارة القبور وعيادة المرضى ومشاهدة عجائب خلق الله، وكذلك التدبر في آيات هذا الكون الفسيح العجيب المدبر، كل هذا مما يزيد الإيمان بالله سبحانه وتعالى ويزيد محبته والتوكل عليه،

وإن من أبلغ ذلك اجتناب المعاصي، فهذه المعاصي هي التي توهن الإيمان وتضعفه، وإذا وقع الشخص في معصية انتقص من إيمانه قدر تلك المعصية، إذا كانت صغيرة انتقص من إيمانه صغير وإذا كانت كبيرة انتقص من إيمانه كبير وهكذا، فليحافظ الإنسان على إيمانه باجتناب المعاصي أولا، ثم يزيده ويحليه بزيادة الأعمال الصالحة ما استطاع إلى ذلك سبيلا، وأفضل ذلك الفرائض ثم ما تزاد به من النوافل كما صح في الحديث القدسي الشريف أن رسول الله (ص) قال فيما يرويه عن ربه عز وجل: «وما تقرب إلي عبدي بشيء أحب إلي مما افترضته عليه، ولا يزال عبدي يتقرب إلي بالنوافل حتى أحبه، فإذا أحببته كنت سمعه الذي يسمع به وبصره الذي يبصر به ويده التي يبطش بها ورجله التي يمشي بها، ولئن سألني لأعطينه ولئن استعاذ بي لأعيذنه، ولا شك أن مما ينقص الإيمان الاشتغال بزخارف هذه الدنيا والإقبال عليها، فهذه الدنيا ملهاة عن الآخرة، والآخرة التدبر فيها والتفكر فيها وتذكر هاذم اللذات الذي هو الموت مما يزيد الإيمان، أما الإغراق في الانشغال بملذات الدنيا وشهواتها والنظر إلى ما فيه أهلها فهو مما ينقص الإيمان ولهذا قال الله تعالى لرسوله (ص): {وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَى مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِ أَزْوَاجًا مِنْهُمْ زَهْرَةَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ وَرِزْقُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَى (131) وَأْمُرْ أَهْلَكَ بِالصَّلَاةِ وَاصْطَبِرْ عَلَيْهَا لَا نَسْأَلُكَ رِزْقًا نَحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَ وَالْعَاقِبَةُ لِلتَّقْوَى (132)} [طه] فعلى الإنسان أن يتقلل من النظر إلى ما لم يعطه من هذه الدنيا، وأن ينظر في الدنيا إلى من هو دونه، وأن ينظر في الدين إلى من هو فوقه فإن ذلك أجدر به أن لا يزدري نعمة الله عليه، كما أرشد إلى ذلك رسول الله (ص).

t: The Means of Increasing Faith
a: وسائل زيادة الإيمان
b:
what are the means of increasing faith?

in the name of god, the merciful, the compassionate. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds. i pray for blessing and peace upon the one who was sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions and all who are guided by his guidance and follow his practice until the day of judgement. to proceed: this faith (īmān) is what marks off the people of felicity from the people of wretchedness. it is that for which god chooses those whom he marks off and makes ready for his good pleasure and for entry into his gardens. a person needs to tend to it constantly, because within souls it wears out and is made new again.

it is faith that carries a person to acts of obedience and carries him to leaving off acts of disobedience. our need of it is so intense that no need of anything else is its equal. for that reason there must be constant reminding of one another about its increase and its decrease and the causes of these. faith is utterance with the tongue, belief with the heart, and action with the limbs; it increases with acts of obedience and decreases with disobedience. so it is belief with the janān — that is, with the heart; and utterance with the tongue, affirming that; and action with the arkān — that is, with the bodily members, by compliance and by avoidance,
r:
ما هي وسائل زيادة الإيمان?

بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم، الحمد لله رب العالمين وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين، أما بعد فإن هذا الإيمان هو الذي يميز أهل السعادة عن أهل الشقاء، وهو الذي يختار الله له من يميزهم ويهيئهم لمرضاته ولدخول جناته، والإنسان محتاج إلى تعاهده دائما لأنه يبلى ويجد في النفوس.

فهو الذي يحمل على الطاعات ويحمل على ترك المعاصي، ونحن محتاجون إليه حاجة شديدة لا تعدلها حاجة إلى أي شيء آخر، فلذلك لا بد من تذاكر زيادته ونقصه وأسباب ذلك دائما، فالإيمان نطق باللسان واعتقاد بالجنان وعمل بالأركان يزيد بالطاعات وينقص بالعصيان، فهو اعتقاد بالجنان أي بالقلب، ونطق باللسان بتصديق ذلك، وعمل بالأركان أي بالجوارح بالامتثال والاجتناب،

t: The Presence of the Devils at the Deathbed
a: حضور الشياطين للميت
b:
it is said that the devils are present with a dying person at his death and take on for him the form of his parents. is that true?

the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, commanded us to seek refuge with god from the trial of life and of death. he said: 'seek refuge with god from four. say: o god, i seek refuge with you from the punishment of the grave, and from the trial of the grave, and from the trial of the antichrist (al-masīḥ al-dajjāl), and from the trial of life and of death.' these four are what refuge is sought from with god. and in the other transmission: 'o god, i seek refuge with you from the punishment of hell, and i seek refuge with you from the punishment of the grave, and i seek refuge with you from the trial of the antichrist, and i seek refuge with you from the trial of life and of death.' these four are what refuge is sought from with god, and among them are the trial of life and the trial of death. the trial of life is what befalls a person in his lifetime of ease and of hardship: ease drives him to transgress and hardship makes him forget. {truly man transgresses when he sees himself self-sufficient} (sūrat al-ʿalaq 96:6–7).

'are you waiting for anything but a wealth that makes you transgress, or a poverty that makes you forget?' the trial of death is the trial at the moment of dying. a number of reports have come about it: that the dying person who is put to the trial has the tempter (al-fattān) present himself to him, saying to him: die upon the religion of judaism! die upon the religion of christianity! one of the great scholars of this country told me — or rather i heard it from him — and that is the erudite muhammad ʿal wuld niʿmah, god's mercy upon him, that he once fell ill and remained lying on his side for a long period and was certain of death, until the tempter presented himself to him and kept saying to him: die upon the religion of judaism! die upon the religion of christianity! — while he gave him the lie and drove him off. and he recovered from that illness and lived on after it. so the tempter, too, does not know the unseen; he simply presents the trial. this trial may be made visible to some people as a way of establishing the proof against people, and of making plain some of the matters that belong to the unseen, which god discloses to some of the select among his creation so that faith may increase. that is why it happened to ʿabd allah ibn jahsh, god be pleased with him, that when he was ill his sister hamnah would call out to him, saying: 'o my mountain! o my great peak!' — and when he came to, he said: 'you said nothing but that it was said to me, were you really such?' and so when he was killed on the day of uhud she did not weep for him. likewise this kind of trial at death befell ahmad ibn hanbal, god the exalted have mercy on him. it is soundly established from his son salih that he said: i was present with abu ʿabd allah at his death, and there he was saying: 'not yet, not yet.' i said: father, what are you saying? he said: the enemy of god presented himself to me, and he was saying: you have got the better of me, ahmad! — and i was saying: not yet, not until i die upon faith. the enemy of god — satan — presented himself to him and was saying: you have got the better of me, ahmad! — wanting to bring self-admiration upon him in the last hour of his life.
r:
يذكر أن الشياطين تحضر الميت عند موته و تتمثل له في صورة أبويه فهل ذلك حق؟ النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أمرنا أن نستعيذ بالله من فتنة المحيا و الممات فقال: فاستعذ بالله من أربع قل اللهم إني أعوذ بك من عذاب القبر و من فتنة القبر و من فتنة المسيح الدجال و من فتنة المحيا و الممات فهذه الأربع يستعاذ بالله منها و في الرواية الأخرى اللهم إني أعوذ بك من عذاب جهنم و أعوذ بك من عذاب القبر و أعوذ بك من فتنة المسيح الدجال و أعوذ بك من فتنة المحيا و الممات هذه الأربعة يستعاذ بالله منها و منها فتنة المحيا و فتنة الممات ففتنة المحيا ما يعرض للإنسان في حياته من السراء و الضراء فالسراء تطغيه و الضراء تنسيه (إن الإنسان ليطغى أن رآه استغنى)

هل تنتظرون إلا غنى مطغيا أو فقرا منسيا و فتنة الممات هي الفتنة عند الموت و قد جاء فيها عدد من الأحاديث أن المحتضر الذي يفتن يعرض له الفتان فيقول: له مت على دين اليهودية مت على دين النصرانية و قد أخبرني أحد كبار العلماء في هذه البلاد أو سمعت منه ذلك و هو العلامة محمد عال و لد نعمة رحمة الله عليه أنه و قع مرة فمكث على جنبه فترة طويلة و أيقن على الموت حتى عرض له الفتان فكان يقول له مت على دين اليهودية مت على دين النصرانية و هو يكذبه و يجزره و برئ من ذلك المرض و عاش بعده فالفتان أيضا لا يعلم الغيب و تعرض الفتنة و قد تكون هذه الفتنة تظهر لبعض الناس إقامة للحجة على الناس و بيان لبعض الأمور التي هي غيبية فيكشفها الله لبعض خواصه من خلقه لزيادة الإيمان و لذلك حصل لعبد الله بن جحش رضي الله عنه أن أخته حمنة لما مرض كانت تناديه فتقول واجبلاه واطوداه فلما أفاق قال: ما قلت شيئا إلا قيل لي أهكذا كنت فلما قتل يوم أحد لم تبك عليه و كذلك فهذا النوع من الفتنة عند الموت عرض لأحمد بن حنبل رحمه الله تعالى فقد صح عن ابنه صالح أنه قال: حضرت أبا عبد الله عند موته فإذا هو يقول لا بعد لا بعد فقلت يا أبتي ما ذا تقول قال إن عدو الله عرض لي و هو يقول فتني يا أحمد و أنا أقول لا بعد حتى أموت على الإيمان عدو الله الشيطان عرض له و يقول فتني يا أحمد يريد أن يدخل عليه العجب في آخر ساعة من حياته.

t: God Is Worshipped Only by What He Has Prescribed
a: يعبد الله بما شرع
b:
in an earlier lecture you mentioned that it belongs to a correct understanding of islam that god is not to be worshipped except by what he has prescribed. i would like an explanation of that. and do the litanies (awrād) taken from the shaykhs come under it?

as for acts of worship, we know that what we intend by them is to draw near to god, exalted, and to seek his good pleasure. in our dealings with people, we can draw near to them by something they have not commanded us to do, because we know what benefits them and what harms them: this person, for instance — i know that such and such a thing benefits him, or that such and such a thing harms him, so i bring him what benefits him and keep from him what harms him, without asking his leave or taking his opinion; and that is among the things by which one draws near to him.

but god, exalted, says: 'my servants, you will never attain to harming me so as to harm me, and you will never attain to benefiting me so as to benefit me.' it is not possible, then, for us to draw near to him except by what he has prescribed for us, because what he has not prescribed cannot contain any securing of a benefit for him or any warding off of a harm from him. for that reason we cannot worship him except by what he has prescribed.

as for these litanies, they are covered by the general command to remember god in the words of god, exalted: {remember god with much remembrance} (sūrat al-aḥzāb 33:41); {and remember god much, that you may prosper} (sūrat al-jumuʿah 62:10). so their basis is permissible (jāʾiz) and is commanded in the revealed law, and every person is commanded to a great deal of remembrance. the messenger of god, peace and blessings be upon him, would ask forgiveness more than a hundred times in a single sitting. but the fixing of a particular time, or a particular arrangement, or a manner peculiar to these remembrances — there is innovation in that from one angle. so that innovation ought to be left, and the good that is in the remembrance taken.
r:
ذكرتم في محاضرة سابقة أنه من الفهم الصحيح للإسلام أن لا يعبد الله إلا بما شرع أريد توضيحا لذلك و هل يدخل في ذلك الأوراد المأخوذة عن الأشياخ؟ بالنسبة للعبادة نحن نعلم أننا نريد بها التقرب إلى الله تعالى و التماس مرضاته و في معاملتنا مع الأشخاص الذين يمكن أن نتقرب إليهم بما لم يأمرونا به لأننا نعلم ما ينفعهم و يضرهم مثلا هذا الشخص أعلم أن هذا الأمر ينفعه أو أن هذا الأمر يضره فأقدم إليه ما ينفعه و أدفع عنه ما يضره دون أن أستأذنه أو آخذ رأيه فهذا مما يتقرب إليه به

لكن الله تعالى يقول: «يا عبادي إنكم لن تبلغوا ضري فتضروني و لن تبلغوا نفعي فتنفعوني» فلا يمكن إذن أن نتقرب إليه إلا بما شرع لنا لأن ما لم يشرعه لا يمكن أن يكون فيه تحصيل منفعة له و لا دفع ضرر عنه وبسبب ذلك لا يمكن أن نعبده إلا بما شرع بالنسبة للأوراد هذه يتناولها عموم الأمر بالذكر في قول الله تعالى: (اذكروا الله ذكرا كثيرا) (اذكروا الله كثيرا لعلكم تفلحون) فأصلها جائز و مأمور به شرعا و كل شخص مأمور بكثير من الذكر و رسول الله صلى الله عليه و سلم كان يستغفر في الجلسة الواحدة أكثر من مائة مرة و لكن تحديد وقت معين أو هيأة معينة أو أسلوب خاص بهذه الأذكار فيه ابتداع من جهة و لذلك ينبغي أن يترك ذلك الابتداع و أن يأخذ الخير الموجود في الذكر.

t: The Establishment of the Month of Ramadan
a: ثبوت شهر رمضان
b:
in the name of god, the merciful, the compassionate. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds. i pray for blessing and peace upon the one who was sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions and all who are guided by his guidance and follow his practice until the day of judgement.

to proceed: the people of knowledge differed over the establishment of the new moons — whether it falls under the heading of testimony (shahādah) or under the heading of transmission (riwāyah). malik, god have mercy on him, and likewise abu hanifa, held that the establishment of the new moons falls under the heading of testimony, because of the particular rights that follow from it, such as the terms of debts and the waiting periods of women (ʿiddah) and the like. the difference between the heading of transmission and the heading of testimony is that particular rights attach to the heading of testimony, whereas only general rights attach to the heading of transmission — rights in which there is no pleading and no dispute..
r:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين.

أما بعد فإن أهل العلم اختلفوا في ثبوت الأهلة هل هو من باب الشهادة أو من باب الرواية، فذهب مالك رحمه الله وكذلك أبو حنيفة إلى أن ثبوت الأهلة إنما هو من باب الشهادة لما يترتب عليه من الحقوق الخاصة، كآجال الديون وكعدد النساء ونحو ذلك، والفرق بين باب الرواية وباب الشهادة أن باب الشهادة يتعلق به الحقوق الخاصة، وباب الرواية إنما يتعلق به الحقوق العامة التي لا مرافعة فيها ولا منازعة..

t: General Fatwas on the Hajj and the ʿUmrah
a: فتاوي عامة في الحج والعمرة
b:
is one who delays the hajj sinful, when he has the means for it and has no excuse?

the hajj is a pillar of islam, and god, exalted, has said: {and pilgrimage to the house is a duty owed to god by those people who are able to find a way to it; and whoever disbelieves — god is free of need of all the worlds} (sūrat āl ʿimrān 3:97). and the commander of the faithful ʿumar ibn al-khattab, god be pleased with him, said: i have resolved to send men out to these garrison towns, that they may look and see who among them was able to perform the hajj and did not perform it, and impose the poll tax (jizyah) upon them: they are not muslims, they are not muslims, they are not muslims. and ʿali, god be pleased with him, said from the pulpit: whoever was able to perform the hajj and did not perform it, it makes no difference to him whether he dies a jew or a christian; for god, exalted, has said: {and whoever disbelieves — god is free of need of all the worlds} (sūrat āl ʿimrān 3:97). on this basis, whoever is able to perform the hajj is obliged to hasten to it; and the preponderant view is that the hajj is obligatory immediately and not with latitude..

because the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: o people, perform the hajj before you cannot perform it. they said: and what will be the matter with the hajj, messenger of god? he said: its bedouin will sit at the tail-ends of its valleys, and no one will reach the house. and abu dawud brought out in the sunan, with a chain in which there is weakness, that the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'whoever intends the hajj, let him hasten, for the sick man may fall ill, and the need may arise, and the mount may stray.' these are excuses that stand in the way of the hajj, and for that reason a person must hasten to it. some of the people of knowledge held that the hajj is obligatory with latitude and not immediately. they adduced as evidence that god made the hajj obligatory upon the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, at the end of the eighth year of the hijra; then the ninth year came and the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, did not perform the hajj in it, but sent abu bakr to lead the people in the hajj; then in the tenth year the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, performed the farewell pilgrimage. on this basis the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, did not perform the hajj after god had granted him the conquest of mecca and he was able to perform the hajj in the ninth year — he did not perform it in that year, but deferred it to another year. but the answer to this is that the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, would not perform the hajj except at the time of the hajj; and the ninth year was a year of intercalation. intercalation (al-nasīʾ) was something the people of the age before islam used to do, and it is the deferring of certain months from their proper time. the people of mecca made the month of dhu al-hijjah in that year muharram — that is, the month that comes after dhu al-hijjah. they used to do this in the age before islam, and god, exalted, abolished it by sūrat al-tawbah, saying in it: {intercalation is only an increase in unbelief, by which those who disbelieve are led astray. they make it lawful one year and forbidden another, so as to make up the number of what god has made sacred, and so make lawful what god has made forbidden. the evil of their deeds has been made fair-seeming to them} (sūrat al-tawbah 9:37). that is why one of them says:

*and we are the intercalators over maʿadd: the months of the profane, we make them sacred.*

and the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said at the farewell pilgrimage: time has come round as it was on the day god created the heavens and the earth. so he abolished intercalation, and time came round as it was on the day god created the heavens and the earth. and god, exalted, has said: {indeed the number of months with god is twelve months in the decree of god, on the day he created the heavens and the earth; of them four are sacred} (sūrat al-tawbah 9:36). so time came round as it was on the day god created the heavens and the earth, and the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, performed the hajj at the time of the hajj. for that reason a person able to perform the hajj is counted sinful if he delays it, when he is able to and has the means. and the ability that god made a condition in his words {those who are able to find a way to it} (sūrat āl ʿimrān 3:97), and which the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, made a condition in the hadith of gabriel, in his words 'and pilgrimage to the house, for whoever is able to find a way to it' — its definition is provision, a mount, and a passable road: 'provision', that is, the expenses; 'a mount', that is, what brings a person to those regions; and 'a passable road', that is, safety for one's person and property. so if a person finds what will convey him, in money for expenses and for transport, and is secure as to his person and his property on the road, then the hajj has become obligatory upon him and it is not lawful for him to delay performing it. this is the preponderant view, and the evidences stand for it.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

the ruling on a woman who performed the hajj and the ʿumrah having falsified an unmarriageable relative

what is the ruling on a woman who performed the hajj and the ʿumrah having falsified an unmarriageable male relative (maḥram), who stayed with her only for the period of the journey?

speaking falsehood and giving false testimony are among the greatest of the major sins. but the hajj is valid and the ʿumrah is valid, god willing.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

the necessity of an unmarriageable relative for a woman on the hajj journey

a woman who has performed the obligatory hajj, but who wants to perform the hajj on behalf of her parents — must she have an unmarriageable male relative or not?

yes. a woman must have an unmarriageable male relative with her on a long journey, because of the words of the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him: 'it is not lawful for a woman who believes in god and the last day to travel a day and a night except with an unmarriageable male relative.' and as for one who is not a maḥram but whom people claim to be a maḥram, there is in that lying and false testimony, and in the revealed law that is graver than her travelling without a maḥram.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

one who fell ill before the farewell circumambulation. i performed the hajj and fell ill, and i performed all the rites except the farewell circumambulation: the illness became severe upon me after i had performed two circuits of it. what is upon me?

there is nothing upon her. the preponderant view is that the farewell circumambulation is not obligatory; and those who do hold it obligatory likewise do not hold it to be one of the rites of the hajj or of the ʿumrah. for the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, permitted safiyyah bint huyayy, god be pleased with her, to depart after she had performed the circumambulation of the overflowing — because he came in upon her and she was weeping, and he said: 'ḥalqā ʿaqrā! is she going to hold us back?' it was said: she has already performed the circumambulation of the overflowing. he said: 'then let her depart.' this indicates that it is not one of the rites of the hajj, because it falls away with menstruation; and severe illness and the like are comparable to menstruation.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

mixing in the hajj. does the mixing of men with women at the stoning invalidate the hajj or not?

no. god, exalted, commanded the hajj and made it a pillar of islam, and said of it: {and pilgrimage to the house is a duty owed to god by those people who are able to find a way to it; and whoever disbelieves — god is free of need of all the worlds} (sūrat āl ʿimrān 3:97). and it is soundly established from the commander of the faithful ʿumar ibn al-khattab, god be pleased with him, that he said from the pulpit: i have resolved to send men out to these garrison towns, that they may look and see who among them was able to perform the hajj and did not perform it, and impose the poll tax upon them: they are not muslims, they are not muslims, they are not muslims. and it is soundly established from ʿali, god be pleased with him, that he said from the pulpit: 'and whoever disbelieves — god is free of need of all the worlds'; whoever was able to perform the hajj and did not perform it, it makes no difference to him whether he dies a jew or a christian. therefore the hajj is a pillar of islam, and a person's islam is not complete without it if he is able to perform it. what occurs in it of mixing does not prevent it; nor does what some people imagine prevent it — that it leads to abandoning standing in the prayer, for example, if he is going to pray on the aeroplane and is unable to stand, or that it leads to praying it with dry ablution when he is unable to find water. some of the later scholars have mentioned what points to that, but it is not to be conceded. and as for what the erudite muhammad mawlud, god's mercy upon him, said in his words:

*the obligation of the hajj, if it leads to its being performed in a state of impurity, becomes ḥaẓl.*

— this is a position he related from some of the people of knowledge, and it is not correct and not to be conceded. for the obligation of the hajj is to be set against a person's prayer for the whole of his life, because it is obligatory once in a lifetime while the prayer is repeated throughout a life. so the hajj is not to be weighed against a single prayer; rather it is to be weighed against a person's prayer for the duration of his life.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ability and what pertains to it. this is a question about a case whose form is: a woman whose father sent her in marriage to her husband with a cow, and that cow grew with the husband until it produced several cows — it being known that the husband used to see to the needs of the cows, of watering and pasturing and fodder in the periods when livestock are given fodder, and that he used to benefit from their yield. is the said woman to be counted as having means, so that the obligation of the hajj becomes binding upon her; or is it not binding, because the husband has a share in those cows?

the husband has no share in those cows unless he called witnesses, before spending, that he would have recourse against her for what he spends on her cows. if he was spending on them out of generosity, then he owns nothing by that, and the cows are her own property. and if they amount to the price of the costs of the hajj, then that makes the hajj obligatory upon her — if she finds trustworthy company and is able to sell them for what suffices her. for god, exalted, made ability a condition for the hajj in his words: {and pilgrimage to the house is a duty owed to god by those people who are able to find a way to it}; and the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, made that a condition and explained ability: it is provision, a mount and a passable road. 'provision and a mount', that is, what suffices a person going and returning; and 'a passable road', that is, safety for one's person and property on the road.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

a brief account of the hajj and the ʿumrah in ramadan. i would like from you a quick account of the ʿumrah in ramadan and of spiritual retreat in it.
