متى يكون الحج واجبا على الشخص و ما هو التعريف التام للاستطاعة في هذا العصر؟ هذا السؤال متى يكون الحج واجبا على الشخص و ما هو التعريف التام للاستطاعة في هذا العصر؟

إن الله سبحانه و تعالى يقول: في كتابه ﴿و لله على الناس حج البيت من استطاع إليه سبيلا و من كفر فإن الله غني عن العالمين﴾ وقد ربط الله تركه بالكفر فقال:﴿و من كفر فإن الله غني عن العالمين﴾ و قد صح عن أمير المؤمنين عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه أنه قال على المنبر:«لقد هممت أن أبعث رجالا إلا هؤلاء الأمصار فلينظروا من فيهم ممن استطاع الحج فلم يحج فليفرضوا عليهم الجزية ما هم بمسلمين ما هم بمسلمين ما هم بمسلمين» و صح عن أمير المؤمنين علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنه أنه قال على المنبر من استطاع الحج فلم يحج فلا عليه أن يموت يهوديا أو نصرانيا فلذلك على المسلمين إذا استطاع أحد منهم الحج أن يبادر إليه فقد أخرج عبد الرزاق في المصنف أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال :« من استطاع منكم الحج فليبادر فإنه قد يمرض المريض وتضل الراحلة وتعرض الحاجة» وقد أخرج هو أيضا في المصنف وأبو داوود في السنن أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال«حجوا قبل أن لا تحجوا قالوا يا رسول الله وما شأن الحج فقال يجلس أعرابها على أعقاب أوديتها وفي رواية على أذناب أوديتها فلا يصل إلى البيت أحد» فعلى من استطاع الحج أن يكمل اسلامه وأن يعلم أنه لا يرضى لنفسه أن يسكن في بيت قد هدم جانب من جوانبه و أنتم تعلمون أن الإسلام مبني على هذه الأركان الخمسة فهو بمثابة البيت المبني والبيت المبني إذا كان جانب من جوانبه مهدوما هل يضع فيه أحد منكم أملاكه وأمواله وما يحب حفظه أبدا فلذلك لا بد أن يحرص الإنسان على إكمال إسلامه و إتمام أركانه فمن استطاع ذلك فعليه أن يبادر والاستطاعة عرفها صلى الله عليه وسلم بأنها الزاد و الراحلة والسبيل السابلة الزاد ما يتزود به الإنسان والراحلة ما يركبه و يوصله و السبيل والسابلة أي الأمن على النفس والمال حتى يصل الإنسان إلى المشاعر.

t: The Rulings of Fasting
a: أحكام الصيام
b:
in the name of god, the merciful, the compassionate. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds. i pray for blessing and peace upon the one who was sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions and all who are guided by his guidance and follow his practice until the day of judgement.

to proceed: god, exalted, made fasting (ṣawm) obligatory upon his servants and set out the wisdom in his making it obligatory. he said, exalted: {o you who believe, fasting is prescribed for you as it was prescribed for those before you, that you may become god-conscious — for a fixed number of days. whoever among you is ill or on a journey, then a number of other days; and upon those who are able to do it there is a compensatory payment, the feeding of a poor person. whoever volunteers good, it is better for him; and that you fast is better for you, if only you knew. the month of ramadan, in which the qur'an was sent down as guidance for people, and as clear signs of guidance and of the criterion
r:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين، وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين.

أما بعد فإن الله تعالى افترض الصيام على عباده وبين حكمة افتراضه فقال تعالى: {يا أيها الذين آمنوا كتب عليكم الصيام كما كتب على الذين من قبلكم لعلكم تتقون أياما معدودات فمن كان منكم مريضا أو على سفر فعدة من أيام أخر وعلى الذين يطيقونه فدية طعام مسكين فمن تطوع خيرا فهو خير له وأن تصوموا خير لكم إن كنتم تعلمون شهر رمضان الذي أنزل فيه القرآن هدى للناس وبينات من الهدى والفرقان

t: The Rulings Concerning Women in Fasting
a: أحكام النساء في الصيام
b:
in the name of god, the merciful, the compassionate. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds. i pray for blessing and peace upon the one who was sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions and all who are guided by his guidance and follow his practice until the day of judgement. peace be upon you, and the mercy of god and his blessings.

to proceed: women are marked out by certain rulings particular to them, in view of the fact that the rulings — the rulings of the revealed law — are built upon taking account of individual differences, and upon gentleness and kindness. god, exalted, has said: {he has not placed upon you any hardship in religion} (sūrat al-ḥajj 22:78). and hardship brings ease: this is a general maxim, one of the great maxims of the revealed law. so everything in which there is hardship (mashaqqah) for a person, god, exalted, lifts the obligation and the constraint in it..
r: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته، أما بعد فإن النساء يتميزن ببعض الأحكام المختصة، نظرا لأن الأحكام أحكام الشرع مبنية على مراعاة الفروق الفردية وعلى الرفق واللطف، وقد قال تعالى: {ما جعل عليكم في الدين من حرج}، والمشقة تجلب التيسير، وهي قاعدة عامة من القواعد الشرعية الكبرى، فكل ما فيه مشقة على الإنسان فالله تعالى يرفع فيه التكليف والحرج..

t: The Mistakes of Those Who Fast
a: أخطاء الصائمين
b:
in the name of god, the merciful, the compassionate. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds. i pray for blessing and peace upon the one who was sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions and all who are guided by his guidance and follow his practice until the day of judgement. peace be upon you, and the mercy of god and his blessings.

to proceed: this religion which the messenger of god, peace and blessings be upon him, brought from god — and it is the religion of islam — requires exercise and training and refinement. it is not possible for people to be all alike in it; rather they differ in their levels of faith (īmān) and in their levels of holding fast to obedience..
r:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته.

أما بعد فإن هذا الدين الذي جاء به رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم من عند الله وهو دين الإسلام يحتاج إلى رياضة وتدريب، وتحسين فلا يمكن أن يكون الناس فيه سواء، بل هم متفاوتون في مستوياتهم في الإيمان وفي مستوياتهم في الالتزام بالطاعة..

t: The Legal Controls for Understanding the Book and the Sunnah — Part One
a: الضوابط الشرعية لفهم الكتاب والسنة الجزء الأول
b:
in the name of god, the merciful, the compassionate. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds. i pray for blessing and peace upon the one who was sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions and all who are guided by his guidance and follow his practice until the day of judgement. peace be upon you, and the mercy of god and his blessings.

to proceed: god sent muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, to us with this religion, contained within these two weighty revelations — the book of god and the sunnah of muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him — and the two of them are in clear arabic speech. god, glorified and exalted, made their modes of signification various. the qur'an's modes of signification are of different kinds: some of it is clear in what it signifies and some of it is obscure in what it signifies. what is clear in signification includes what is of clear import (muḥkam), what is expounded (mufassar), what is clarified (mubayyan), what is of apparent meaning (ẓāhir), and what is an explicit text (naṣṣ). what is obscure in signification includes what is unelaborated (mujmal), what is problematic (mushkil), what is hidden (khafī), and what is of ambiguous import (mutashābih)..
r:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين، السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته.

أما بعد فإن الله أرسل إلينا محمدا (ص) بهذا الدين مظروفا في هذين الوحيين الثقلين كتاب الله وسنة محمد (ص) وهما بلسان عربي مبين، وقد نوع الله سبحانه وتعالى دلالاتهما، فكانت دلالات القرآن متباينة منه ما هو واضح الدلالة ومنه ما هو خفي الدلالة، وواضح الدلالة منه ما هو محكم ومنه ما هو مفسر ومنه ما هو مبين ومنه ما هو ظاهر ومنه ما هو نص، وخفي الدلالة منه ما هو مجمل ومنه ما هو مشكل ومنه ما هو خفي ومنه ما هو متشابه..

t: The Legal Controls for Understanding the Book and the Sunnah — Part Two
a: الضوابط الشرعية لفهم الكتاب والسنة -الجزء الثاني
b: and people's levels in this are various and distinct from one another. we can set them out by numbers, so that this may better hold the attention. the first rank among people in understanding the book of god and the sunnah of his messenger, peace and blessings be upon him, is the one who does not understand arabic at all — the one entirely without arabic. this person's share of the signification of the texts is to follow a qualified scholar (taqlīd) in what they signify, just as he follows one in their transmission. for we have said that the book and the sunnah are examined from two sides: the side of their coming down to us, and the side of their signification. the side of their coming down to us means their establishment. in the case of the qur'an, we have attained certain knowledge of it by mass transmission (tawātur), and it is preserved and protected, so there is no need today for detailed work on the chains of transmission or close scrutiny of the biographies of the transmitters. but the chain of transmission (isnād) is called for in any case, and it is one of the distinguishing features of this community, by which god has honoured this community from among the communities. that is why the people of hadith say: it is honour enough for a man that his name should be the lowest link in a chain whose highest is the name of the messenger of god, peace and blessings be upon him..
r: ومستويات الناس في هذا متباينة متمايزة يمكن أن نفصلها بالأرقام ليكون ذلك أدعى للانتباه، فالرقم الأول في الناس في فهم كتاب الله وسنة رسوله (ص) من لا يفهم العربية أصلا، المطبق الذي لا يفهم العربية، فهذا حظه من دلالة النصوص التقليد في دلالتها كما يقلد في نقلها، لأننا ذكرنا أن الكتاب والسنة يبحث فيهما من جهتين، جهة الورود وجهة الدلالة، جهة الورود معناه الثبوت، ونحن في القرآن حصل لدينا العلم الجازم بالتواتر به وهو معصوم محفوظ فلا يحتاج اليوم إلى التفصيل في الأسانيد والتدقيق في تراجم الرجال لكن الإسناد مطلوب على كل حال وهو من خصائص هذه الأمة وقد شرف الله به هذه الأمة من بين الأمم ولذلك يقول أهل الحديث: كفى بالرجل شرفا أن يكون اسمه أدنى سلسلة أسماها اسم رسول الله (ص)..

t: Rulings on Purification
a: أحكام في الطهارة
b:
the ruling on performing ablution before the time of the prayer has come in. does ablution for the prayer suffice before the time has come in?

it is better. a person's remaining always in a state of ritual purity, if he is able to, is among the meritorious deeds; and it was the cause of bilal's going ahead into the garden, for whenever he broke his ablution he performed ablution, and whenever he performed ablution he prayed two units of prayer.

------------------------------------------------------

the ruling on one who cannot move her right hand. a woman afflicted with a nerve disease who cannot stand by herself and cannot use her right hand — is ablution waived for her if she wishes to pray?

so long as she finds someone to help her with the ablution and to wash the limbs of ablution for her, ablution is not waived for her; rather it may be part of her treatment and a cause of her cure, god willing. and if she does not find anyone to help her in that, then god does not burden a soul beyond its capacity.

the ruling on the purifying of a garment at the launderer's.

someone who leaves his clothes with the launderer when there is something impure on them and does not tell him of it — do they become pure by that, or not?

purification from filth (ṭahārat al-khabath) does not have intention as a condition for it; it is not like purification from the state of ritual impurity (ṭahārat al-ḥadath). the legal maxim is that every act of devotion performed upon something other than oneself does not require intention — every act of devotion performed upon something other than oneself does not require intention. so the washing of the dead does not require intention, and the purifying of a garment or of a place does not require intention. but he must be sure that the launderer puts the garment in pure unmixed water that has not been altered. for the position of the majority of the people of knowledge is that the purifying and purificatory water, which god described as such in his book in his words 'and we sent down from the sky pure water', and in his words about rainwater 'that he might purify you by it and remove from you the defilement of satan', is only unrestricted water (al-māʾ al-muṭlaq), none of whose three qualities has been altered. some of the people of knowledge held that every detergent liquid that removes the trace of the impurity purifies by it and by it the impurity's ruling goes away. this position was held by some of the malikis, among them al-qarafi, god have mercy on him, and it is the position of the hanafis. but the first is more cautious and cleaner, so a person should take care over purity in this domain.

-----------------------------------------------------

lifting the state of ritual impurity by dry ablution. i am married, and i often pray in a state of major ritual impurity (janābah), especially in the winter season, because i suffer from an allergy to cold and therefore cannot perform the full washing. what is the ruling?

one who is unable to perform the full washing is obliged to perform dry ablution (tayammum), on account of the words of god, exalted: {and if you are ill, or on a journey, or one of you has come from the privy, or you have touched women, and you find no water, then take to clean earth and wipe your faces and your hands with it} (sūrat al-māʾidah 5:6). therefore dry ablution stands in the place of the full washing and of ablution in the case of one unable to use water and of one who lacks water. the sick person who cannot use water — his ruling is dry ablution; he does it in obedience to god and in compliance with his command, and by it he makes lawful for himself what had been prevented to him.
r:
حكم الوضوء قبل دخول الوقت هل يجزئ الوضوء للصلاة قبل دخول الوقت؟

أنه أفضل، فبقاء الإنسان على طهارة دائما إن استطاع من فضائل الأعمال، وهو سبب سبق بلال إلى الجنة، فقد كان كلما أحدث توضأ وكلما توضأ صلى ركعتين.

------------------------------------------------------

حكم من لا يستطيع تحريك يمينه امرأة مصابة بمرض عصبي لا تستطيع الوقوف بنفسها ولا تتصرف بيمينها هل يسقط عنها الوضوء إذا أرادت الصلاة؟

ما دامت تجد من يساعدها على الوضوء ويقوم بغسل أعضاء الوضوء فلا يسقط عنها الوضوء، بل ربما يكون من علاجها وسببا لشفائها إن شاء الله، وإذا لم تجد من يساعدها في ذلك فلا يكلف الله نفسا إلا وسعها.

حكم تطهير الثوب عند الغسال

من يضع ملابسه عند الغسال إذا كان فيها نجس ولم يخبره به هل تطهر بذلك أم لا؟

أن طهارة الخبث لا تشترط لها النية فليست مثل طهارة الحدث، والقاعدة الفقهية أن كل تعبد في الغير لا يحتاج إلى النية، كل تعبد في الغير لا يحتاج إلى النية، فغسل الميت لا يحتاج إلى نية، وتطهير الثوب أو المكان لا يحتاج إلى النية، لكن لا بد أن يعلم أن الغسال يضع الثوب في ماء قراح ليس متغيرا، لأن جمهور أهل العلم أن الماء المطهر الطهور الذي وصفه الله بذلك في كتابه في قوله وأنزلنا من السماء ماء طهورا، وفي قوله في ماء المطر ليطهركم به ويذهب عنكم رجز الشيطان فإنما يطهر الماء المطلق الذي لم يتغير شيء من أوصافه الثلاثة، وقد ذهب بعض أهل العلم إلى أن كل مائع قلاع يزيل أثر النجاسة تطهر به ويذهب به حكمها، وهذا القول ذهب إليه بعض المالكية ومنهم القرافي رحمه الله، وهو مذهب الحنفية، لكن الأول أحوط وأنقى، فعلى الإنسان أن يتعهد الطهارة في هذا المجال.

-----------------------------------------------------

رفع الحدث بالتيمم أنا متزوج وكثيرا ما أصلي بالجنابة خاصة في فصل الشتاء وذلك لأني مصاب بحساسية من البرد ولذلك لا أستطيع أن أغتسل فما الحكم؟

أن العاجز عن الغسل يلزمه التيمم لقول الله تعالى: {وإن كنتم مرضى أو على سفر أو جاء أحد منكم من الغائط أو لامستم النساء فلم تجدوا ماء فتيمموا صعيدا طيبا فامسحوا بوجوهكم وأيديكم منه} فلذلك يقوم التيمم مقام الغسل والوضوء في حق العاجز عن استعمال الماء وفاقد الماء، فالمريض الذي لا يستطيع استعمال الماء حكمه التيمم فيفعله طاعة لله وامتثالا لأمره ويستبيح به ما منع عليه.

t: Supplication Is Worship Itself
a: إن الدعاء هو العبادة
b:
praise belongs to god; we praise him and we seek his help, and we seek refuge with god from the evils of our own souls and from the ill consequences of our deeds. whomever god guides, none can lead astray; and whomever he leads astray, there is no guide for him. and i bear witness that there is no god but god alone, having no partner; and i bear witness that muhammad is his servant and his messenger — god bless him, and his family and his companions, and grant them abundant peace.

{o people, be conscious of your lord, who created you from a single soul and created from it its mate, and spread abroad from the two of them many men and women. and be conscious of god, through whom you ask of one another, and of the ties of kinship. indeed god is ever watchful over you} (sūrat al-nisāʾ 4:1). {o you who believe, be conscious of god and speak words that are apt. he will set right your deeds for you and forgive you your sins. and whoever obeys god and his messenger has attained a mighty attainment} (sūrat al-aḥzāb 33:70–71).
r: إن الحمد لله نحمده ونستعينه ، ونعوذ بالله من شرور أنفسنا ومن سيئات أعمالنا من يهده الله فلا مضل ومن يضلل فلا هادي له ، وأشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له وأشهد أن محمدا عبده ورسوله صلى الله عليه وعلى آله وأصحابه وسلم تسليما كثيرا (يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ نَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ وَخَلَقَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَبَثَّ مِنْهُمَا رِجَالًا كَثِيرًا وَنِسَاءً وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ الَّذِي تَسَاءَلُونَ بِهِ وَالْأَرْحَامَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَقِيبًا) (يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آَمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَقُولُوا قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ أَعْمَالَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَمَنْ يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا).

t: The Ruling on a Man Suckling His Wife's Milk
a: حكم رضاع الرجل لبن زوجته
b:
is it permissible for a man to suckle his wife's milk?

the answer: no. it is not for a man to suckle his wife's milk, because that is not part of conjugal enjoyment. what is permissible to him is enjoyment (mutʿah) — that is, enjoyment of what god has made lawful to him from her — and suckling is not part of that enjoyment. but the position of the majority is that if he did suckle her milk, that does not make her forbidden to him and does not remove her from his marriage bond. this is contrary to the mother of the believers ʿa'isha, god be pleased with her, and to some of the scholars of the early generations, who hold that the milk relationship (raḍāʿ) does take effect in the case of an adult. they adduced as evidence the hadith of salamah bint suhayl, that the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, commanded her to suckle salim, the freedman of abu hudhayfah, when he was an adult. the position of the majority is to confine the taking effect of the prohibition through the milk relationship to the first two years, on the basis of the words of god, exalted: 'and mothers suckle their children two complete years'; and his words, exalted: 'and his bearing and his weaning are thirty months'; and his words, exalted: 'and his weaning is within two years.'

as for the hadith of sahlah, the answer given to it is that it was a special case, because the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, gave her permission only to suckle one whom she had adopted in the age before islam, and there is no adoption after that; for islam abolished adoption after the verse of sūrat al-aḥzāb came down, so that a person is no longer able to adopt another, but rather ascribing him to his own father is obligatory, as god, exalted, said: 'call them by their fathers' names; that is more equitable in the sight of god.'

this woman had adopted salim for a long period, so that she had become as his mother, and for that reason he gave her permission to suckle him. today there is no woman who has adopted a man in a manner recognised by the law, for adoption is not permissible.
r:
هل يجوز للرجل أن يرتضع لبن زوجته؟

الجواب: لا ليس للرجل ارتضاع لبن زوجته ، لأن ذلك ليس من الاستمتاع وإنما يجوز له المتعة؛ أي الاستمتاع بما أحله الله منها، والإرضاع ليس من تلك المتعة، لكن مذهب الجمهور أنه لو ارتضع لبنها فإنه لا يحرمها ذلك عليه ولا يخرجها عن عصمته خلافا لأم المومنين عائشة رضي الله عنها ولبعض علماء السلف فإنهم يرون أن الكبير تنتشر محرميته بالرضاع واستدلوا بحديث سلمة بنت سهيل أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أمرها أن ترضع سالما مولى أبي حذيفة وهو كبير، ومذهب الجمهور قصر انتشار الحرمة بالرضاع على الحولين، لقول الله تعالى " والوالدات يرضعن أولادهن حولين كاملين"، ولقوله تعالى "وحمله وفصاله ثلاثون شهرا، ولقوله تعالى " وفصاله في عامين".

وحديث سهلة يجاب عنه بأنه حالة خاصة لأن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم إنما أذن لها في إرضاع من كانت قد تبنته في الجاهلية ولا تبني بعد ذلك فإن التبني أبطله الإسلام بعد نزول آية سورة الأحزاب فلم يعد الإنسان ممكنا من تبني الغير بل يجب نسبته إلى أبيه كما قال الله تعالى " أدعوهم لآبائهم هو أقسط عند الله".

وهذه المرأة كانت تبنت سالما مدة طويلة فأصبحت بمثابة أمه فلذلك أذن لها في إرضاعه واليوم لا توجد امرأة قد تبنت رجلا على وجه شرعي فالتبني ليس جائزا.

t: Borrowing from an Interest-Based Bank for the Sake of Marriage
a: الاقتراض من البنك الربوي لأجل الزواج
b:
i am a young man about to marry. is it permissible for me to take a loan from the bank, being a state employee in the field of education?

the answer is that the usurious loan is not lawful for a person unless he is under necessity (ḍarūrah) with respect to it. for god, exalted, says: 'o you who believe, be conscious of god and give up what remains of usurious gain (ribā), if you are believers.' and he says, exalted: 'o you who believe, do not consume usurious gain, doubled and multiplied; and be conscious of god, that you may prosper. and guard yourselves against the fire, which has been prepared for the disbelievers.' so it is not lawful for a person to go ahead and take the usurious loan except under necessity; and necessity is, for instance, that he fears fornication for himself and finds nothing to pay as the bridal gift (mahr).

and here is a piece of counsel for young men. many people suppose that marriage has great costs, and that they cannot go ahead with it unless they have gathered enormous sums. but the best of marriages is the one with the least cost, and the best of women is the one whose bridal gift is least. it is established in the hadith of ibn ʿabbas that 'the best of this community is the one whose marriage payment is least'. and it is established from the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, that he said: 'take to yourselves the best of women — the virtuous women of quraysh: the most tender of them towards a child in its infancy, and the most careful of them over a husband in respect of what his hand possesses, and the most content of them with little.'

so if a person is under necessity and finds nothing to serve as the marriage payment — while not being one who goes to extravagance or ostentation — and finds no one to lend to him and no one to trade with him on credit, then at that point his situation is one that can be brought down to the standing of necessity. and it requires a fatwa of its own from someone who is acquainted with his circumstances and his affairs, and whether he qualifies for the dispensation (rukhṣah) or not.
r:
أنا شاب مقدم على الزواج فهل يجوز لي أن أقترض من البنك وأنا موظف للدولة في مجال التعليم ؟

الجواب أن القرض الربوي لا يحل للإنسان إلا إذا اضطر له فإن الله تعالى يقول: " يا أيها الذين آمنوا اتقو الله وذرو ما بقي من الربا إن كنتم مؤمنين، ويقول تعالى " يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تأكلوا الربا أضعافا مضاعفة واتقوا الله لعلكم تفلحون واتقوا النار التي أعدت للكافرين"، فلا يحل للإنسان الإقدام على أخذ القرض الربوي إلا مضطرا والضرورة مثل أن يخاف على نفسه الزنا وأن لا يجد ما يدفعه مهرا ، وهنا نصيحة للشباب أن كثيرا من الناس يظن أن الزواج له تكاليف كبيرة وأنه لا يمكن أن يقدم عليه إلا إذا جمع أموالا طائلة فخير الأنكحة أقلها تكاليفا وخير النساء أقلهن مهرا ، وقد ثبت في حديث ابن عباس " أن أفضل هذه الأمة أقلها صداقا، وثبت عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال عليكم خير النساء صلح نساء قريش؛ أحناه على ولد في صغره، وأرعاه على زوج في ذات يده وأرضاه بالقليل، فإذا اضطر الإنسان ولم يجد ما يكون صداقا مع أنه لم يكن يأتي بسرف ولا بخيلة ولم يجد من يقرضه ولا من يتاجر معه بدين، فحينئذ تكون حالته يمكن أن تنزل منزل الضرورة وتحتاج إلى استفتاء خاص ممن يطلع على ظروفه وشؤونه وهل هو صاحب رخصة أم لا .

t: Fasting the Day of ʿArafah Where the Moonrises Differ
a: صيام يوم عرفة باختلاف المطالع
b:
i am a student in malaysia, and the day of ʿarafah with us falls on the sixteenth of november, while the pilgrims will stand at ʿarafah on the fifteenth of november. how am i to fast the day of ʿarafah? that is, the day on which the pilgrims stand, which in malaysia coincides with the eid?

the answer is that he fasts the ninth day of dhu al-hijjah according to the reckoning of the homeland he is in and the country he is in. that is because the people of each country, when the moonrises differ and the timing differs, have their own time. just as it is not permissible for him to pray according to the prayer of the people of mecca, so likewise he does not fast according to their fasting. for the day, with the people of mecca, begins at midday — or at the end of the day — for the people of malaysia. therefore the day of ʿarafah in his case is not the day on which the pilgrims stand; rather it is the ninth day of dhu al-hijjah.
r:
أنا طالب في ماليزيا ويوم عرفة عندنا يوافق يوم السادس عشر من نوفمبر بينما الحجاج سوف يقفون بعرفة يوم الخامس عشر من نوفمبر، كيف أصوم يوم عرفة ؟ أي اليوم الذي يقف فيه الحجاج وهو يوافق في ماليزيا العيد ؟

الجواب أنه يصوم اليوم التاسع من ذي الحجة على مقتضى الوطن الذي هو فيه والبلد الذي هو فيه وذلك أن أهل كل بلد عندما تختلف المطالع ويختلف التوقيت، لهم وقتهم كما أنه لا يجوز له أن يصلي بصلاة أهل مكة فكذلك لا يصوم بصيامهم، فاليوم عند أهل مكة يبدأ بوسط النهار أو آخره عند أهل ماليزيا لذلك فيوم عرفة في حقه هو ليس هو اليوم الذي يقف فيه الحجاج بل هو اليوم التاسع من ذي الحجة.

t: The Ruling on What Is Called 'l-ḥjāb', and on the Use of the Grids and the Magic Squares
a: حكم ما يسمى بــ " لحْجَابْ" واستعمال الجداول والأوفاق
b:
i ask you to clarify the ruling of the revealed law on what is called among us 'l-ḥjāb', and whether it is permissible to use the awfāq, or what are called the jadāwil??

the answer is that 'l-ḥjāb' is applied to certain incantations and amulets and the like. it is a general name covering both the sound and the defective. some of it is sound, such as the lawful incantation (ruqyah) by the qur'an and by sound hadith; and some of it is void, such as what belongs to sorcery, and — among the sciences of evil — the science of the grid. the science of the grids and of the magic squares (al-awfāq) is entirely among the sciences of evil, so it is not lawful for a muslim to occupy himself with it, nor to hang it about himself.

the people of knowledge differed concerning that by which sorcery is undone. some of them held it permissible, because it is beneficial and not harmful, and because god, exalted, says: 'and they learn what harms them and does not benefit them' — this being the distinguishing property of sorcery, that it harms and does not benefit, whereas what benefits and does not harm does not fall under its definition. but the position of the majority is that this is not lawful at all, and that the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, invalidated it by his words: 'whoever introduces into this affair of ours something that is not of it, it is rejected' — and in a transmission of muslim's: 'whoever performs an act that our affair is not in accordance with, it is rejected.'

so this is not among what the messenger of god, peace and blessings be upon him, brought from god. therefore the muslim does not occupy himself with it, and it is not lawful for him to undertake it.
r:
أطلب منكم توضيح الحكم الشرعي لما يسمى عندنا بــ "لحْجَابْ"، وهل يجوز استعمال الاوفاق أو ما يسمى بالجداول ؟؟.

الجواب أن لحجاب يطلق على بعض الرقى والتمائم ونحوها وهو اسم عام يشمل الصحيح والفاسد ففيه ما هو صحيح مثل الرقيا بالقرآن والحديث الصحيح، وفيه ما هو باطل مثل ما كان من السحر ومن علوم الشر علم الجدول فعلم الجداول والأوفاق كله من علوم الشر فلا يحل للمسلم الاشتغال به ولا تعليقه، واختلف أهل العلم فيما يحل السحر منه فقد ذهب بعضهم إلى جوازه لأنه نافع غير ضار ولأن الله تعالى يقول " فيتعلمون ما يضرهم ولا ينفعهم " فهذه خاصية السحر فهو يضر ولا ينفع، أما ما ينفع ولا يضر فهو ليس داخلا في تعريفه ولكن مذهب الجمهور أن ذلك لا يحل مطلقا وأن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أبطله بقوله: " من أحدث في أمرنا هذا ما ليس منه فهو رد"، وفي رواية لمسلم من عمل عملا ليس عليه أمرنا فهو رد".

فهذا ليس مما جاء به رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم من عند لله فلذلك لا يشتغل به المسلم ولا يحل له الإقدام عليه.

t: Swearing by the Spirits and Addressing Them
a: القسم على الأرواح وخطابها
b:
a matter with which affliction has become general: swearing by the spirit-being — is it permissible? and are there spirit-beings charged with services for the l-ḥjāb??

the answer is that by 'the spiritual' are meant spirits in general. it is not lawful to swear by them, nor to address them. but they do exist: spirits are not non-existent. among them are evil spirits and good spirits. the good spirits are the spirits of the people of faith and god-consciousness, and the evil spirits are the spirits of the people of envy, malice, disbelief and hypocrisy. they include both humankind and the jinn, for each has spirits. but they are not sworn by and they are not addressed.
r:
موضوع عمت به البلوى وهو القسم على الروحاني هل يجوز، وهل هناك روحانيون مكلفون بخدمات لحجاب؟؟

الجواب أن الروحانية المقصود به الأرواح عموما ولا يحل القسم عليها ولا خطابها لكنها موجودة فالأرواح لا تعدم ومنها أرواح شريرة وارواح طيبة فالأرواح الطيبة أرواح أهل الإيمان والتقوى والأرواح الشريرة أرواح أهل الحسد والخبث والكفر والنفاق، وهي تشمل الإنس والجن فكل له أرواح، لكن لا يقسم عليها ولا تخاطب.

t: The Inviolability of Public Money
a: حرمة المال العام
b:
in the name of god, the merciful, the compassionate. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds. i pray for blessing and peace upon the one who was sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions and all who are guided by his guidance and follow his practice until the day of judgement. peace be upon you, and the mercy of god and his blessings.

to proceed: god, exalted, has made people stewards in the wealth he has placed under their hands. and he has made some wealth to be held in common among the muslims, from which their poor and their rich benefit equally, or which is particular to one stratum among their strata and one category among their categories. this is public money, which is a right held in common by the muslims, in which the generations to come share along with the generations now present.
r:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين، السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته.

أما بعد فإن الله تعالى استخلف الناس فيما جعل تحت أيديهم من المال، وجعل من المال مالا مشتركا بين المسلمين، ينتفع به فقراؤهم وأغنياؤهم على حد السواء، أو يكون مختصا بشريحة من شرائحهم وفئة من فئاتهم، وهذا هو المال العام الذي هو حق مشترك للمسلمين تشترك فيه الأجيال اللاحقة مع الأجيال الموجودة.

t: General Fatwas on Purification and Prayer
a: فتاوي عامة في الطهارة والصلاة
b:
the ruling on performing ablution before the time of the prayer has come in. does ablution for the prayer suffice before the time has come in?

it is better. a person's remaining always in a state of ritual purity, if he is able to, is among the meritorious deeds (faḍāʾil al-aʿmāl); and it was the cause of bilal's going ahead into the garden, for whenever he broke his ablution he performed ablution, and whenever he performed ablution he prayed two units of prayer.

--------------------------------------

the ruling on one who cannot move her right hand. a woman afflicted with a nerve disease who cannot stand by herself and cannot use her right hand — is ablution waived for her if she wishes to pray?

so long as she finds someone to help her with the ablution and to wash the limbs of ablution for her, ablution is not waived for her; rather it may be part of her treatment and a cause of her cure, god willing. and if she does not find anyone to help her in that, then god does not burden a soul beyond its capacity.
r:
حكم الوضوء قبل دخول الوقت هل يجزئ الوضوء للصلاة قبل دخول الوقت؟

أنه أفضل، فبقاء الإنسان على طهارة دائما إن استطاع من فضائل الأعمال، وهو سبب سبق بلال إلى الجنة، فقد كان كلما أحدث توضأ وكلما توضأ صلى ركعتين.

--------------------------------------

حكم من لا يستطيع تحريك يمينه امرأة مصابة بمرض عصبي لا تستطيع الوقوف بنفسها ولا تتصرف بيمينها هل يسقط عنها الوضوء إذا أرادت الصلاة؟

ما دامت تجد من يساعدها على الوضوء ويقوم بغسل أعضاء الوضوء فلا يسقط عنها الوضوء، بل ربما يكون من علاجها وسببا لشفائها إن شاء الله، وإذا لم تجد من يساعدها في ذلك فلا يكلف الله نفسا إلا وسعها.

t: Fatwas on Jihad
a: فتاوي في الجهاد
b:
supplicating against the disbelievers. it is known of necessity that supplicating for the muslims is the weakest of faith. so what is the ruling on supplicating against the disbelievers, as in the words of one who says: {my lord, leave not upon the earth any dweller from among the disbelievers} (sūrat nūḥ 71:26)? and as you know, noah did not make this supplication until after the revelation came that {none of your people will believe except those who have already believed} (sūrat hūd 11:36). and the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, when the companion who was from daws came to him and said 'supplicate against daws', said: 'o god, guide daws and bring them as muslims.'

supplicating against the disbelievers is part of fighting them, and the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, carried it out: he supplicated against quraysh that they be seized with years of famine —

'o god, make them years against them like the years of joseph.'
r:
الدعاء على الكفار من المعلوم ضرورة أن الدعاء للمسلمين أضعف الإيمان فما حكم الدعاء على الكفار كمن يقول( رب لا تذر على الأرض من الكافرين ديارا) و كما تعلمون أن نوحا لم يدع بهذا الدعاء إلا بعد مجيء الوحي (أنه لن يؤمن من قومه إلا من قد آمن) و النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم لما أتاه الصحابي الذي هو من دوس و قال ادع على دوس قال: اللهم اهد دوسا و ائت بهم مسلمين؟

الدعاء على الكفار هو من جهادهم و قد نفذه النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقد دعا على قريش أن يؤخذوا بالسنين

اللهم اجعلها عليهم سنينا كسنين يوسف

t: General Fatwas on Fasting
a: فتاوي عامة في الصيام
b:
the ruling on looking at forbidden things while fasting. what is the ruling on the fast of a person who spends his day and his night occupied with looking at the television, on which there are women who display themselves?

this person has not in reality fasted the fast that increases his faith and increases his god-consciousness. he has merely fasted from the permissible things and occupied himself with the forbidden ones. we ask god for safety and well-being. a person must fear god with regard to his sight, and must remember the words of god, exalted: {tell the believing men to lower their gaze and to guard their private parts; that is purer for them. indeed god is aware of what they do} (sūrat al-nūr 24:30). so a person must lower his gaze and guard his private parts, and must know that the eye is the courier of the loins: what he looks at brings a trial into his heart which it may be hard for him to cure, even were he guided to the cure. we ask god to guide us all to what he loves and is pleased with. that is why ibn al-qayyim, god have mercy on him, said:
r:
حكم النظر إلى المحرمات أثناء الصوم ما الحكم في صوم شخص يظل ويبيت مشتغلا بالنظر في التلفزة وفيها النساء المتبرجات؟

هذا لم يصم في الواقع الصوم الذي يزيد إيمانه ويزيد تقواه، وإنما صام عن المباحات واشتغل بالمحرمات نسأل الله السلامة والعافية، فعلى الإنسان أن يتقي الله في بصره وأن يتذكر قول الله تعالى: {قل للمؤمنين يغضوا من أبصارهم ويحفظوا فروجهم ذلك أزكى لهم إن الله خبير بما يصنعون} فعلى الإنسان أن يغض من بصره وأن يحفظ فرجه، وأن يعلم أن البصر بريد الفرج، فما ينظر إليه يدخل فتنة في قلبه قد يصعب عليه علاجها لو اهتدى إلى العلاج، نسأل الله أن يهدينا أجمعين لما يحب ويرضى، ولذلك قال ابن القيم رحمه الله:

t: The Supplications of the Funeral Prayer
a: أدعية صلاة الجنازة
b:
what is the supplication that is established in the prayer over the dead, and what is the soundness of the supplication called the supplication of abu hurayra, god be pleased with him?

many reports have come down concerning supplication in the funeral prayer. the supplication he asked about — the one ascribed to abu hurayra, god be pleased with him — is a report stopping at a companion (mawqūf): it is established from abu hurayra, but he did not trace it back to the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him. as for the reports traced to the prophet (marfūʿ), among them are his words, peace and blessings be upon him: 'o god, forgive our living and our dead, our present and our absent, our elder and our younger, our male and our female. you know our comings and goings and our resting place. o god, whomever of us you keep alive, keep him alive upon islam; and whomever of us you cause to die, cause him to die upon faith. o god, forgive this dead person and have mercy on him, and grant him well-being and pardon him, and shelter him from the trial of the grave and from the punishment of the grave and from the punishment of the fire. o god, if he was a doer of good, then increase him in his good; and if he was a wrongdoer, then overlook his misdeeds. o god, do not deprive us of his reward and do not put us to trial after him, and forgive us and forgive him.' and there are others besides that among the reports carrying this same sense: 'o god, our companion has alighted with you, and you are the most generous with whom any guest alights. o god, so make his lodging generous, and widen his place of entry, and give him in exchange a home better than his home, and a family better than his family, and a spouse better than his spouse; and wash him with water and snow and hail, and cleanse him of sins as a white garment is cleansed of dirt.' and there are still others besides these among the reports.
r:
ما الدعاء الثابت في الصلاة على الميت وما صحة الدعاء الذي يسمى دعاء أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه؟

أن الدعاء في صلاة الجنائز ورد فيه كثير من الأحاديث، والدعاء الذي سأل عنه وهو الدعاء المنسوب إلى أبي هريرة رضي الله عنه موقوف، ثابت عن أبي هريرة لكنه لم يرفعه إلى النبي (ص)، أما الأحاديث المرفوعة عن النبي (ص) فمنها قوله (ص): (اللهم اغفر لحينا ولميتنا ولشاهدنا ولغائبنا ولكبيرنا ولصغيرنا ولذكرنا ولأنثانا إنك تعلم متقلبنا ومثوانا، اللهم من أحييته منها فأحيه على الإسلام ومن أمته منا فأمته على الإيمان، اللهم اغفر لهذا الميت وارحمه وعافه واعف عنه وأجره من فتنة القبر ومن عذاب القبر ومن عذاب النار، اللهم إن كان محسنا فزد في إحسانه، وإن كان مسيئا فتجاوز عنه سيئاته، اللهم لا تحرمنا أجره ولا تفتنا بعده واغفر لنا وله)، وغير ذلك من الأحاديث التي في معنى هذا (اللهم إن صاحبنا قد نزل بك وأنت أكرم منزول به، اللهم فأكرم نزله ووسع مدخله وأبدله دارا خيرا من داره وأهلا خيرا من أهله وزوجا خيرا من زوجه واغسله بالماء والثلج والبرد ونقه من الخطايا كما ينقى الثوب الأبيض من الدنس)، إلى غير ذلك من الأحاديث.

t: The Best Standing in Prayer at Night
a: أفضل القيام
b:
what is the best standing in prayer at night?

the best standing at night is that in which a person feels the sweetness of standing at night — that which draws from him weeping, and awe, and humility, and pondering. this is the best standing at night. as for that of which a person tastes no savour, and which passes him by colourless, just so, having no effect upon him — this is not the standing that is called for.
r:
ما أفضل قيام الليل؟

أن أفضل قيام الليل ما يحس به الإنسان بلذة قيام الليل، ما اقتضى منه بكاء وخشية وخشوعا وتدبرا هذا أفضل قيام الليل، أما ما لا يذوق له الإنسان طعما ويمر به باهتا هكذا لا تأثير له عليه فليس هذا بالقيام المطلوب.

t: Urging the Dawn Prayer in the Mosque
a: الحض على صلاة الصبح في المسجد
b:
what do you counsel someone who always misses the dawn prayer in congregation?

this person must remember that it is the prayer of the hypocrites, and that the companions of the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, used to recognise a man's hypocrisy by his staying away from the congregation at the dawn prayer: if he did not attend the night prayer and the dawn prayer in congregation, they judged him to be a hypocrite and knew that he was one of the hypocrites. for that reason we must be diligent in performing it in congregation, and must know that whoever performs these two prayers in congregation is under god's guarantee — so let god not call on you for anything from his guarantee. and whoever performs both of them in congregation, the standing in prayer of a night and of half a night is written for him. so a person must be diligent, and especially when he knows that the reward for walking in the darkness to the dawn prayer is complete light on the day of resurrection: 'give glad tidings to those who walk much in the darknesses of the night to the mosques, of complete light on the day of resurrection.' therefore we must all be diligent, young and old, in attending the dawn prayer in congregation, and must remember the words of god, exalted: {and the recitation of the dawn — truly the recitation of the dawn is witnessed} (sūrat al-isrāʾ 17:78). it is witnessed: two kinds of angels witness it, the angels of the night and the angels of the day — 'angels take turns among you by night and angels by day, and they gather at the afternoon prayer and the dawn prayer.'
r:
بم تنصحون من تفوته صلاة الصبح في الجماعة دائما؟

أن على هذا الإنسان أن يتذكر أنها صلاة المنافقين، وأن أصحاب النبي (ص) كانوا يعرفون نفاق الرجل بتخلفه عن الجماعة في صلاة الصبح، إذا كان لا يشهد صلاة العشاء والفجر في الجماعة حكموا بنفاقه وعرفوا أنه من المنافقين، ولذلك لا بد أن نحرص على أدائها في الجماعة، وأن نعلم أن من أدى هاتين الصلاتين في الجماعة كان في ذمة الله فلا يطلبنكم الله من ذمته بشيء، ومن أداهما في الجماعة كتب له قيام ليلة ونصف ليلة، فعلى الإنسان أن يحرص وبالأخص إذا عرف أن جزاء المشي في الظلام إلى صلاة الفجر النور التام يوم القيامة: «بشر المشائين في سدف الليل إلى المساجد بالنور التام يوم القيامة»، فلذلك علينا أن نحرص جميعا شبابا وشيبا على شهود صلاة الفجر في الجماعة، وأن نتذكر قول الله تعالى: {وَقُرْآَنَ الْفَجْرِ إِنَّ قُرْآَنَ الْفَجْرِ كَانَ مَشْهُودًا}، فهو مشهود يشهده نوعان من أنواع الملائكة، ملائكة الليل وملائكة النهار: «يتعاقبون فيكم ملائكة بالليل وملائكة بالنهار يجتمعون في صلاة العصر وصلاة الفجر».

t: On a Woman's Prayer in the Mosque
a: الكلام على صلاة المرأة في المسجد
b:
if a woman is in her house and can hear the prayer in the mosque but cannot see those praying with her own eyes, what is better for her: that she pray in her house, or that she go to the mosque?

if a woman finds a place in the mosque in which she does not mix with the men, then her prayer in the mosque is in that case better. and if she would mix with the men, and she fears trial (fitnah), or trial is feared from her, then her prayer in her house is better. by this we reconcile the texts that have come from the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him — such as the hadith of umm humayd al-saʿidiyyah, that the prophet made clear that her prayer in her house is better than her prayer in the mosque of her people, and that her prayer in the mosque of her people is better than her prayer in the congregational mosque — with the texts in which there is exhortation to the congregational prayer without qualification, in a way that takes in both men and women; and with the prophet's permission to them to attend the prayer with him in the mosque; and with the hadith of ʿa'isha, that the women used to attend the dawn prayer with the prophet and would return wrapped in their cloaks, not recognised, because of the darkness before dawn.

and likewise the hadith of ibn ʿumar and abu hurayra, in the sahih of al-bukhari and elsewhere, that the prophet said: 'do not prevent the handmaids of god from the mosques of god.' and likewise his words, peace and blessings be upon him: 'whichever of you women attends the late night prayer with us, let her not touch perfume.' all of these are hadiths indicating that women attended the congregation in the mosque. and the first hadith — the hadith of umm humayd al-saʿidiyyah — requires that her house is better for her. the reconciliation between this hadith and the many hadiths is that this applies in the case of one from whom trial is feared, or for whom it is feared, or who would mix with the men in the mosque — since in earlier times there was no place set apart for women in the mosques, and the women in earlier times used to pray in rows behind the men. that is why the prophet said: 'the best of the men's rows is the first of them and the worst of them the last; and the best of the women's rows is the last of them and the worst of them the first.' what is meant by the rows is where there is no barrier between the men's rows and the women's rows: so the first of the women's rows is the one adjoining the men, and it is the worst of them — that is, the least of them in reward; and the last of them, that is, the furthest of them from the men, is the best of them — that is, the greatest of them in reward. and the first of the men's rows, the nearest of them to the imam, is the best of them; and the last of them, that is, the nearest of them to the women, is the least of them in reward.
r:
إذا كانت المرأة في بيتها تسمع الصلاة في المسجد ولا ترى المصلين بعينها، فما الأحسن لها؟ أن تصلي في بيتها أم الذهاب إلى المسجد؟

أن المرأة إذا كانت تجد مكانا في المسجد لا تخالط فيه الرجال فصلاتها في المسجد حينئذ أفضل، وإذا كانت تخالط الرجال وتخشى الفتنة أو تخشى منها فصلاتها في بيتها أفضل، ولهذا نجمع بين النصوص الواردة عن النبي (ص) كحديث أم حميد الساعدية أن النبي (ص) بين أن صلاتها في بيتها أفضل من صلاتها في مسجد قومها، وصلاتها في مسجد قومها أفضل من صلاتها في مسجد الجامع، وبين النصوص التي فيها حض على صلاة الجماعة مطلقا، بما يشمل الرجال والنساء، وإذن النبي (ص) لهن بشهود الصلاة معه في المسجد، وحديث عائشة أن النساء كن يشهدن الفجر مع النبي (ص) فيرجعن متلفعات بمروطهن ما يعرفن من الغلس،

وكذلك حديث ابن عمر وأبي هريرة في صحيح البخاري وغيره أن النبي (ص) قال: «لا تمنعوا إماء الله مساجد الله» وكذلك قوله (ص): «من شهدت منكن معنا العشاء الآخرة فلا تمسن طيبا»، كل هذا أحاديث تدل على شهود النساء الجماعة في المسجد، والحديث الأول وهو حديث أم حميد الساعدية يقتضي أن بيتها أفضل لها، والجمع بين هذا الحديث والأحاديث الكثيرة أن هذا في حق من تخشى منها الفتنة أو تخشى عليها، أو التي تختلط مع الرجال في المسجد حيث لم يكن في المساجد مكان مخصص للنساء قديما، وكان النساء يصلين قديما في صفوف وراء الرجال ولهذا قال النبي (ص): «خير صفوف الرجال أولها وشرها آخرها وخير صفوف النساء آخرها وشرها أولها» فالمقصود بالصفوف إذا لم يكن بين صفوف الرجال وصفوف النساء حائل، فأول صفوف النساء هو الذي يلي الرجال فهو شرها أي أقلها أجرا، وآخرها أي أبعدها عن الرجال هو أفضلها أي أكثرها أجرا، وأول صفوف الرجال أقربها إلى الإمام أفضلها وآخرها أي أقربها إلى النساء أقلها أجرا.

t: The Quorum by Which the Friday Prayer Is Valid
a: النصاب الذي تصح به صلاة الجمعة
b:
a village that has a congregational mosque, whose imam prays the friday prayer when twelve men are complete for him, and otherwise leaves it and prays it as the noon prayer — is this a correct practice or not?

the number of men by whom the friday prayer becomes obligatory has no delimitation laid down for it in the revealed law, except for what muslim brought out in the sahih from the hadith of abu saʿid al-khudri, that the messenger of god, peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'when they are three, let one of them lead them.' and the erudite ʿabd al-haqq al-ishbili, god have mercy on him — who is among the great scholars of the malikis — said: this is general, covering the friday prayer and others, and there is nothing in the revealed law to specify it. so on this basis, the quorum (niṣāb) by which the friday prayer and the other prayers are prayed is three men. this is what is established from the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him..

as for twelve men: they remained with the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, on the day of the caravan, and he did not hold them back and did not command them; rather that was merely how it fell out, and how a thing falls out is not used as an argument. for the address of the revealed law is by the law, not by how things fall out; the whole of legal obligation is by the law, not by how things fall out. and it is not among the conditions of the friday prayer that there be security, nor a market, nor anything of the kind, for the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, prayed the friday prayer in the days of the siege, in the days of the confederates, and medina was at that time in more intense fear than any other place. god has set out the state of its people, saying: {when they came upon you from above you and from below you, and when eyes swerved and hearts reached the throats, and you were thinking thoughts about god. there the believers were tried, and shaken with a severe shaking} (sūrat al-aḥzāb 33:10–11). and this state of fear, when it actually obtained — it cannot be that the state of the people of some other village is like this state. if this was not an excuse for abandoning the friday prayer, then people's making a pretext of that is merely the work of satan.
r:
قرية فيها جامع وإمامها يصلي الجمعة إذا تم له اثنى عشر رجلا وإلا تركها وصلاها ظهرا فهل هذا فعل صحيح أم لا؟

أن عدد الرجال الذين تجب بهم الجمعة لم يرد فيه تحديد من الشرع إلا ما أخرج مسلم في الصحيح من حديث أبي سعيد الخدري أن رسول الله (ص) قال: «إذا كانوا ثلاثة فليؤمهم أحدهم» وقد قال العلامة عبد الحق الإشبيلي رحمه الله وهو من كبار علماء المالكية، قال: هذا عام في الجمعة وفي غيرها لا مخصص له من الشرع، فعلى هذا النصاب الذي تصلى به الجمعة وغيرها من الصلوات هو ثلاثة رجال هذا الذي ثبت عن النبي (ص)..

أما اثنى عشر رجلا فقد بقوا مع النبي (ص) يوم العير، ولم يمسكهم هو ولم يأمرهم بل كان ذلك قدرا فقط، والقدر لا يحتج به، فالخطاب بالشرع لا بالقدر، التكليف كله بالشرع لا بالقدر، وليس من شروط الجمعة الأمن ولا السوق ولا نحو ذلك فقد صلى النبي (ص) الجمعة في أيام الحصار في أيام الأحزاب، وكانت المدينة أشد خوفا من أي مكان آخر إذ ذاك، وقد بين الله حالة أهلها فقال: {إِذْ جَاءُوكُمْ مِنْ فَوْقِكُمْ وَمِنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ وَإِذْ زَاغَتِ الْأَبْصَارُ وَبَلَغَتِ الْقُلُوبُ الْحَنَاجِرَ وَتَظُنُّونَ بِاللَّهِ الظُّنُونَا (10) هُنَالِكَ ابْتُلِيَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَزُلْزِلُوا زِلْزَالًا شَدِيدًا (11)} [الأحزاب] وهذا الحال من الخوف إذا كان حاصلا فلا يمكن أن يكون حال أهل قرية أخرى مثل هذا الحال، إذا كان هذا لم يكن عذرا في ترك الجمعة فإنما يتذرع الناس بذلك من عمل الشيطان فقط.

t: The Means That Help with Standing in Prayer at Night
a: الوسائل المعينة على قيام الليل
b:
what are the means that help with standing in prayer at night?

among them, first, that a person should grasp the worth of standing in prayer at night and its effect upon his faith; and that he should grasp that god, exalted, laughs at the one who stands in the depth of the night; and that he should grasp the effect of that upon himself — for whoever's work is good by night, his face is good by day. and likewise that he should grasp the difference between the state of the one who stands praying and speaking intimately with god, exalted, while people are asleep, and the state of the sleeper snoring on his bed: prayer is better than sleep. likewise he must seek help for standing at night by sleeping a part of the day, whatever part it may be — he sleeps a little of the day — or by sleeping at the beginning of the night: if he prays the night prayer and then sleeps, he is bound to wake in the middle of the night or at its end, which is the best part of it; for the night vigil (nāshiʾat al-layl) is what god commanded recitation in, saying: {truly the vigil of the night is stronger in tread and more upright in speech} (sūrat al-muzzammil 73:6).

likewise he ought to seek help in it with an instrument such as an alarm, whether on the telephone or on a clock, which alerts him and wakes him at that hour. and likewise he should seek help in it from his household. abu dawud brought out in the sunan that the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, said: 'god have mercy on a man who rises in the night to pray and wakes his wife so that she may pray with him — and if she sleeps on, he sprinkles water on her face. and god have mercy on a woman who rises in the night to pray and wakes her husband so that he may pray with her — or her spouse so that he may pray with her — and if he sleeps on, she sprinkles water on his face.' then likewise seeking help from the neighbours, and this is part of cooperating in righteousness and god-consciousness. if you keep up with your neighbour and there has come to be affection and familiarity between you, and you ask him to cooperate with you in standing at night, and to knock at your door at such and such an hour and keep you to it — this is among the things the companions of the messenger of god, peace and blessings be upon him, used to do. salman would come to abu al-darda, and abu al-darda used to stand the whole night in prayer; so salman held him back and said: 'sleep now.' then when it was the middle of the night he said: 'rise now.' this is the kind of thing in which neighbours keep up with one another and each helps the other.
r:
ما هي الوسائل المعينة على قيام الليل؟

أن منها أولا أن يدرك الإنسان قيمة قيام الليل وأثره الإيماني عليه، وأن يدرك أن الله تعالى يضحك للقائم في جوف الليل، وأن يدرك أثر ذلك عليه هو، فمن حسن عمله بالليل حسن وجهه بالنهار، وأن يدرك كذلك الفرق بين حال القائم الذي يصلي ويناجي الله تعالى والناس نيام وحال النائم الذي يغط على فراشه، فالصلاة خير من النوم، وكذلك عليه أن يستعين على قيام الليل بنوم جزء من النهار أيا كان، ينام قليلا من النهار، أو بنوم أول الليل، إذا صلى العشاء فنام فلا بد أن يستيقظ في وسط الليل أو آخره، وهو أفضله فناشئة الليل هي التي أمر الله بالقراءة فيها فقال: {إن ناشئة الليل هي أشد وطئا وأقوم قيلا}،

وكذلك ينبغي أن يستعين عليه بآلة كالمنبه سواء كان في التلفون أو في الساعة ينبهه ويوقظه في ذلك الوقت، وكذلك يستعين عليه بأهله فقد أخرج أبو داود في السنن أن النبي (ص) قال: (رحم الله رجلا قام من الليل ليصلي فأيقظ امرأته لتصلي معه فإن هي نامت نضح في وجهها من الماء، ورحم الله امرأة قامت من الليل لتصلي فأيقظت زوجها ليصلي معها أو بعلها ليصلي معها فإن هو نام نضحت في وجهه من الماء)، ثم كذلك الاستعانة بالجيران وهذا من التعاون على البر والتقوى، فإذا كنت تتعاهد جارك وحصلت بينكما مودة وألفة فسألته أن يتعاون معك على قيام الليل وأن يطرق عليك الباب عند الساعة الفلانية ويتعاهدك فهذا مما كان أصحاب رسول الله (ص) يفعلونه، فكان سلمان يأتي أبا الدرداء وكان أبو الدرداء يقوم الليل كله فأمسكه سلمان فقال نم الآن، فلما كان نصف الليل قال قم الآن، فهذا النوع مما يتعاهد فيه الجيران ويعين بعضهم به بعضا.

t: General Fatwas on Prayer
a: فتاوي عامة في الصلاة
b:
the ruling on seeking the permission of the district governor for holding the friday prayer

what do you say about the people of a village upon whom the friday prayer had become obligatory, who began to hold it in this village of theirs, except that they prayed three friday prayers before seeking the permission of the governor of the district to which they belong?

the prayer is an obligation which god, exalted, made obligatory upon his servants. it is the bond between the servant and his lord, and it is a right belonging purely to god, so no one is consulted about it. just as the governor is not consulted about holding the dawn prayer, nor the noon prayer, nor the afternoon prayer, nor the sunset prayer, nor the night prayer, so likewise his authorisation is not sought for the friday prayer. there is no difference: it is the obligation of its day. for god made it obligatory upon muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, while he was in mecca before the emigration, and he was not able to perform it in mecca, so his companions prayed it in medina ..
r:
حكم استئذان حاكم المقاطعة في إقامة الجمعة

ما قولكم في أهل قرية وجبت عليهم الجمعة فابتدأوا إقامتها في قريتهم هذه إلا أنهم صلوا ثلاث جمع قبل استئذان حاكم المقاطعة التي يتبعون لها؟

أن الصلاة فريضة افترضها الله تعالى على عباده وهي الصلة بين العبد وربه وهي حق الله المتمحض فلا يستشار فيها أحد، كما لا يستشار الحاكم في إقامة صلاة الصبح ولا صلاة الظهر ولا صلاة العصر ولا صلاة المغرب ولا صلاة العشاء، كذلك لا يستأمر في صلاة الجمعة فلا فرق فهي فرض يومها، فإن الله افترضها على محمد (ص) وهو بمكة قبل الهجرة ولم يكن يستطيع أداءها بمكة، فصلاها أصحابه بالمدينة ..

t: A Lecture by Shaykh al-Dedew Organised by the Women's Association for Culture and Education
a: محاضرة للشيخ الددو تنظمها جمعية المرأة للثقافة والتربية
b:
'woman between the cultures of peoples and the dignity of existence' was the title of a lecture delivered by his eminence the erudite shaykh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew in the lecture hall of the old youth house. it was the first lecture of the cultural week organised by the women's association for education and culture. a select gathering of scholars, intellectuals and politicians representing several currents attended the event, as did a large audience of women.

the shaykh lectured on the pioneering role of women in religion, society and politics, and brought out their leading part in every field of life, and that their sharing of roles equally with men is required by the wisdom of balance in the universe. he spoke about the aspect of liberties in society, surveying in this the juristic heritage and the particularity of the shinqiti tradition on the social side.

he gave examples of the illustrious women companions who embodied the finest example of sacrifice, giving and knowledge..: 'they are the greatest transmitters of the applied sunnah in hadith..'; 'the entire history of the community has not known a woman who was impugned, nor one who was left aside, in the science of appraising narrators.. and this is a great distinction.' 'khadijah bint khuwaylid set the finest example of sacrifice and of consoling the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, and of making him firm upon the truth: "you keep the ties of kinship and you are hospitable to the guest.."' and she was the first of all to believe in the prophet, peace and blessings be upon him. likewise a woman was the first to sacrifice herself in the path of god: the lady sumayyah bint khayyat, god be pleased with her, was the first martyr in islam, just as she was the first to emigrate in the path of god.. and the names of the women companions renowned for knowledge and for abundant transmission are many; the books of hadith and of transmission and of the generations are filled with women who transmitted and from whom the noble hadith was transmitted — such as asma bint abi bakr, asma bint ʿumays, juwayriyah bint al-harith, hafsah bint ʿumar and zaynab bint jahsh, god be pleased with them. and the mother of the believers ʿa'isha, god be pleased with her, comes foremost among the transmitters of hadith: she was eloquent and articulate, learned in genealogies and in poetry, and some reports relate that half of knowledge was with her, which is why she was the recourse of the jurists among the companions in certain intractable questions of law...

we note that the time available for this lecture was brief, since the address was stopped for the performance of the sunset prayer, and it was not possible for the organisers to continue their activities after the prayer because of a power cut at the venue of the event. so shaykh al-dedew was obliged to close it with a supplication, without a loudspeaker, and announced the end of the lecture, and the large audience, men and women, began to disperse.

r:
"المرأة بين ثقافات الشعوب وكرامة الوجود" كان عنوان محاضرة ألقاها فضيلة العلامة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو في مُدَرّج دار الشباب القديمة، وهي المحاضرة الأولى ضمن الأسبوع الثقافي التي تنظمه جمعية المرأة للتربية والثقافة، وقد حضر هذا النشاط نخبة من العلماء والمثقفين والساسة يمثلون أطيافا عدة، كما حضر جمهور نسوي غفير.

حاضر الشيخ عن الدور الرائد للمرأة في الدين والمجتمع والسياسة، وأبرز ريادتها في كل مجالات الحياة، وأن مناصفتها للأدوار مع الرجال تقتضيه حكمة التوازن في الكون، وتكلم عن جانب الحريات في المجتمع مستعرضا في ذلك التراث الفقهي والخصوصية الشنقيطية في الجانب الاجتماعي.

وأعطى أمثلة من الصحابيات الجليلات اللواتي جسدن أروع مثال في التضحية والبذل والعلم..، " فهن أكثر من روى السنن التطبيقية في الحديث.."، "ولم يَعرف تاريخ الأمة كله امرأة جرحت ولا تركت في علم الجرح والتعديل.. وهذا فضل عظيم" " فخديجة بنت خويلد ضربت أروع مثال في التضحية والمواساة للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وتثبيته على الحق؛ "إنك لتصل الرحم وتقري الضيف.."، وهي أول من آمن بالنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم على الإطلاق، وكذلك كانت المرأة أول من ضحت بنفسها في سبيل الله؛ فالسيدة سمية بنت خياط –رضي الله عنها أول شهيدة في الإسلام كما كانت أول من هاجر في سبيل الله..، وتتعدد أسماء الصحابيات اللآتي اشتهرن بالعلم وكثرة الرواية، وتحفل كتب الحديث والرواية والطبقات بالنساء اللآتي رَوَيْن ورُوِيّ عنهن الحديث الشريف، مثل: أسماء بنت أبي بكر، وأسماء بنت عميس، وجويرية بنت الحارث، وحفصة بنت عمر، وزينب بنت جحش رضي الله عنهن، وتأتي أم المؤمنين عائشة رضي الله عنها في مقدمة رواة الحديث؛ فهي الفصيحة البليغة العالمة بالأنساب والأشعار، تروي بعض الآثار أن عندها نصف العلم، لذا كانت مقصد فقهاء الصحابة في بعض المسائل الفقهية المستعصية...

ونشير إلى أن وقت هذه المحاضرة كان وجيزا إذ توقفت الكلمة لأداء صلاة المغرب ولم يتسني للمنظمين إمكانية مواصلة أنشطتهم بعد الصلاة بسبب انقطاع التيار الكهربائي عن مكان التظاهرة، فاضطر الشيخ الددو إلى ختمها بالدعاء، دون مكبر للصوت، وأعلن عن انتهاء المحاضرة، وبدأ الجمهور الغفير رجالا ونساء بالانصراف.

للإستماع للمحاضرة الرجاء الضغط هنــا

t: The Ruling on Voluntary Prayers for One Who Has Prayers to Make Up
a: حكم التنفل لمن عليه قضاء
b:
what is the ruling on performing voluntary prayers for one who has prayers to make up from the time of his youth?

if a person omitted a particular prayer that he knows of, or a number of prayers, then he must make up those prayers. but if he was merely deficient — as, for instance, that he prayed them with dry ablution (tayammum) while able to perform ablution or the full washing, or the like — then there is no making up (qaḍāʾ) upon him for those prayers, and he makes good the shortfall that has occurred by means of the voluntary prayers. for the voluntary acts complete the obligatory ones, and they will complete them on the day of resurrection: god, exalted, says to his angels when the reckoning of one of his servants begins, 'look — has my servant any voluntary prayer?' — and it is used to complete his obligatory prayer for him.
r:
ما حكم التنفل لمن عليه قضاء الصلاة من زمن الشباب؟

أن الإنسان إذا كان فرط في صلاة بعينها وهو يعلمها أو في صلوات فعليه أن يقضي تلك الصلوات أما إذا كان مقصرا فقط كأن يصليها بتيمم وهو قادر على الوضوء أو الغسل أو نحو ذلك فلا قضاء عليه لتلك الصلوات ويكمل النقص الحاصل بالنوافل فالنوافل مكملة للفرائض وهي تكملها يوم القيامة، فإن الله تعالى يقول لملائكته عندما يبدأ حساب عبد من عباده انظروا هل لعبدي من نفل فيتمم له فرضه.

t: The ruling on voluntary prayer on the day of Eid before the prayer
a: حكم التنفل يوم العيد قبل الصلاة
b:
what is the ruling on performing voluntary prayer (nāfilah) at the prayer ground on the day of eid, before the prayer, outside the mosque?

the prophet, upon whom be peace, when he went out to the prayer ground, prayed nothing before the prayer and nothing after it, as is established from him in the ṣaḥīḥ. he prayed nothing before the eid prayer and nothing after it. the prayer ground's voluntary act is the eid prayer itself: that prayer is performed there, and the people disperse afterwards. if it is eid al-adha, then after the prayer there is something to occupy one, namely the rite (nusuk) of that day, the sacrifice; and if it is the prayer of the day of fitr, then before it there is a rite, namely the giving of zakat al-fitr.
r:
ما حكم التنفل في المصلى يوم العيد قبل الصلاة خارج المسجد؟

أن النبي (ص) في ذهابه إلى المصلى لم يصل قبل الصلاة شيئا ولا بعدها شيئا كما ثبت ذلك عنه في الصحيح، فلم يصل قبل صلاة العيد شيئا ولم يصل بعدها شيئا فالمصلى نافلته هي صلاة العيد فتصلى فيه تلك الصلاة وينصرف الناس بعدها، فإذا كان عيد الأضحى فإن بعد الصلاة شغلا وهو نسك ذلك اليوم بالضحية، وإن كانت صلاة يوم الفطر فإن قبلها نسكا وهو إخراج زكاة الفطر.

t: The ruling on praying after ʿAsr
a: حكم الصلاة بعد العصر
b:
what do you say concerning prayer after ʿasr and before maghrib?

al-bukhari and muslim both recorded in the two ṣaḥīḥs, from the hadith of ibn ʿabbas, may god be pleased with them both, who said: "men whose testimony i accept bore witness to me — and the most acceptable of them to me was ʿumar ibn al-khattab — that the messenger of god, upon whom be peace, forbade prayer after fajr until the sun rises, and after ʿasr until it sets." the prophet, upon whom be peace, set out the times in which prayer is forbidden in the hadith of ʿamr ibn ʿabasah, may god be pleased with him: he commanded him to pray when dawn breaks, and then to refrain, until, when the sun has risen the length of a spear and its redness has left it, let him pray; then, when the sun stands at its zenith, let him refrain; then, when he has prayed ʿasr, let him refrain; then, when the sun has set, let him pray..

the prophet, upon whom be peace, warned against praying and against burying the dead at the time the sun rises, at the time it sets, and when the sun stands at its zenith — as in the hadith of ibn ʿumar in the two ṣaḥīḥs: "three hours in which we were forbidden to pray and to bury our dead." the scholars differed as to the degree of this prohibition. the majority of them held that the times in which the prohibition is severe are so by way of forbiddenness (ḥurmah), and that prayer performed in them is void (bāṭil), it being a voluntary prayer. abu hanifah held it to be void without qualification, whether it was an obligatory or a voluntary prayer. so one upon whom the sun rises while he is in the dawn prayer — as with one who did not wake until that time — his prayer is void according to abu hanifah, and valid according to the majority. likewise one upon whom the sun sets while he is in the ʿasr prayer: his prayer is void according to abu hanifah, and he begins it afresh after the sun has disappeared; while according to the majority his prayer is valid, because of the saying of the prophet, upon whom be peace: "whoever forgets a prayer or sleeps through it, let him pray it whenever he remembers it, for its time is when he remembers it" — for god most high says: {and establish the prayer for my remembrance} (sūrat ṭā hā 20:14).
r:
ما قولكم في شأن الصلاة بعد العصر وقبل المغرب؟

أن البخاري ومسلما أخرجا في الصحيحين من حديث ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما قال شهد عندي رجال مرضيون وأرضاهم عندي عمر بن الخطاب أن رسول الله (ص) نهى عن الصلاة بعد الفجر حتى تطلع الشمس وبعد العصر حتى تغرب، وقد بين النبي (ص) في حديث عمرو بن عبسة رضي الله عنه أوقات النهي عن الصلاة، فأمره أن يصلي إذا طلع الفجر، وأن يكف بعد ذلك حتى إذا ارتفعت الشمس قيد رمح وزالت عنها الحمرة فليصل، حتى إذا قام قائم الظهيرة فليكف، حتى إذا صلى العصر فليكف، حتى إذا غربت الشمس فليصل..

وحذر النبي (ص) من الصلاة ودفن الموتى وقت طلوع الشمس ووقت غروبها وعندما يقوم قائم الظهيرة، كما في حديث ابن عمر في الصحيحين ثلاث ساعات نهينا أن نصلي فيها وأن نقبر فيها موتانا، واختلف العلماء في درجة النهي، فذهب جمهورهم إلى أن الأوقات التي النهي فيها شديد على سبيل الحرمة تبطل الصلاة فيها نفلا كانت، ورأى أبو حنيفة بطلانها مطلقا سواء كانت فرضا أو نفلا، فمن طلعت عليه الشمس وهو في صلاة الصبح مثلا كمن لم يستيقظ إلا ذلك الوقت فصلاته باطلة عند أبي حنيفة صحيحة عند الجمهور، وكذلك من غربت عليه الشمس وهو في صلاة العصر فإن صلاته باطلة عند أبي حنيفة ويستأنفها بعد أن تختفي الشمس، وعند الجمهور صلاته صحيحة لقول النبي (ص): من نسي صلاة أو نام عنها فليصلها متى ما ذكرها فإن وقتها ذكرها، فإن الله تعالى يقول: {وأقم الصلاة لذكري}.

t: The ruling on praying in a mosque built on land not authorised by the state
a: حكم الصلاة في مسجد أقيم في مكان غير مشرع من طرف الدولة
b:
one of the imams said last friday that prayer in this mosque is not valid, because it is makzūr [built on land taken without authorisation]?

mosques do not fall within the scope of what is called al-kazrah. we have already said that al-kazrah is bringing land into use by force — that is, taking ownership by force, without permission. mosques are the common property of the people, not anyone's personal property, and for that reason they do not come under this. they belong to god, glorified and exalted, who has freed them from the ownership of his servants and from the ownership of others, so they do not fall into this category at all.
r:
بعض الأئمة في الجمعة الماضية يقول بأن الصلاة في هذا المسجد ليست صحيحة وذلك لأنه مكزور؟

أن المساجد لا تدخل في حيز ما يسمى بالكزرة، قد ذكرنا أن الكزرة هي الإحياء بالقسر أي التملك بقسر من غير إذن، والمساجد ملك عام للناس فليست ملكا شخصيا ومن هنا فلا تدخل في ذلك فهي لله سبحانه وتعالى حررها من ملك العباد ومن ملك الأغيار فلا تدخل في هذا القبيل أصلا.

t: The ruling on more than one call to prayer
a: حكم تعدد الأذان
b:
if a neighbourhood has a regular muezzin who gives the call to prayer over a loudspeaker that is heard from the farthest part of the neighbourhood, what is the ruling on someone else giving the call after him? is it a sunnah, or permissible, or is it an encroachment on another man's office?

more than one call to prayer is sanctioned in the sharia (mashrūʿ) for the friday prayer and for the fajr prayer. in the fajr prayer it is recommended (sunnah) that the call be given in the last sixth of the night, so that the sleeper may rise, the one in a state of major ritual impurity may perform the full ritual washing (ghusl), and people may prepare themselves for the prayer. it is likewise recommended that there be a second call at the breaking of dawn, so that people may know that fajr has entered and may therefore hold back from the things that break the fast if they intend to fast, and may pray. it is soundly established from the prophet, upon whom be peace, that he said: "bilal gives the call while it is still night, so let none of you be kept from his food and his drink until ibn umm maktum gives the call, for he is a blind man who does not call until he is told: 'you have entered upon the morning, you have entered upon the morning'.."

the messenger of god, upon whom be peace, appointed the two of them for the call to fajr. likewise for the friday prayer: ʿuthman, may god be pleased with him, appointed for it a muezzin who called before its time and a muezzin who called when the imam sat upon the pulpit. by this he intended to inform the people so that they might prepare themselves for the friday prayer, since it too requires preparation, washing, applying perfume and cleanliness, and that takes time; and if they were not to hear the call until the imam had already sat upon the pulpit, much good would escape them. as for the other prayers, more than one call is prescribed in them only where those who hear the second call are other than those who heard the first — as was the case in the mosque of kufa in the time of ʿali, may god be pleased with him. it had four muezzins who called from the edges of the mosque, but the one who heard this one was not the one who heard that one, because of the mosque's great extent: a hundred thousand swords used to be hung in it, on its columns. the mosque was therefore very large indeed, and a hundred thousand fighting men prayed in it; so those who heard the muezzin's voice on the eastern side were other than those who heard him on the western side, and so on. even so, more than one call is not to be condemned even if the people hear only part of it, because the people of syria in the time of muʿawiyah, may god be pleased with him, had muezzins who called all at once, and the umayyad mosque was not of that degree of vastness as the mosque of kufa was — although it too was large, it was not of that vastness at that time.
r:
إذا كان الحي له مؤذن راتب يؤذن في مكبر يسمع من أقصى الحي فما حكم أذان غيره بعده هل هو سنة أو جائز أو هو تعد على وظيفة الغير؟

أن تعدد الأذان مشروع في الجمعة وفي صلاة الفجر، وفي صلاة الفجر يسن أن يؤذن من السدس الأخير من الليل ليقوم النائم ويغتسل الجنب ويتأهب الناس للصلاة، ويسن كذلك أذان ثان عند طلوع الفجر ليعلم الناس أن الفجر قد دخل فيكفوا عن المفطرات إذا أرادوا الصوم ويصلوا كذلك، وقد صح عن النبي (ص) أنه قال: «إن بلالا يؤذن بليل فلا يمنعن أحدكم طعامه وشرابه حتى يؤذن ابن أم مكتوم فإنه رجل ضرير لا يؤذن حتى يقال له: أصبحت أصبحت..

وقد رتبهما رسول الله (ص) لأذان الفجر، كذلك الجمعة فإن عثمان رضي الله عنه رتب لها مؤذنا يؤذن قبل وقتها ومؤذنا يؤذن عندما يجلس الإمام على المنبر، وأراد بذلك إعلام الناس ليتأهبوا للجمعة لأنها أيضا تحتاج إلى تهيئة وغسل وتطيب ونظافة فيحتاج ذلك إلى وقت وإذا لم يسمعوا الأذان إلا وقد جلس الإمام على المنبر فاتهم خير كثير، وأما غير ذلك من الصلوات فإنما يشرع تعدد الأذان فيه إذا كان الذين يسمعون الأذان الثاني غير الذين سمعوا الأول، مثل ما كان الحال في مسجد الكوفة في زمان علي رضي الله عنه، فقد كان له أربعة مؤذنين يؤذنون على أطراف المسجد لكن الذي يسمع هذا غير الذي يسمع هذا، وذلك لاتساع المسجد فقد كان يعلق فيه مائة ألف سيف، في اسطواناته، فلذلك كان المسجد متسعا جدا يصلي فيه مائة ألف مقاتل، فلهذا الذين يسمعون صوت المؤذن في الناحية الشرقية غير الذين يسمعونه في الناحية الغربية وهكذا، ومع هذا فلا ينكر تعدد الأذان ولو سمع الناس بعضه لأن أهل الشام في زمان معاوية رضي الله عنه كان لهم مؤذنون يؤذنون دفعة ولم يكن الجامع الأموي بهذا القدر من الضخامة كحال جامع الكوفة، وإن كان كبيرا أيضا لكن لم يكن بهذه الضخامة في ذلك الوقت.

t: The ruling on one who wakes in the night having prayed witr before sleeping
a: حكم من استيقظ من الليل وكان قد أوتر قبل نومه
b:
is it permissible for someone who prayed thirteen rakʿahs, including the witr, before sleeping to perform voluntary prayer if he wakes during the night?

yes. whoever wakes after having prayed witr may pray as many voluntary prayers (nawāfil) as he wishes, but he does not pray witr again, because his witr has already been performed.
r:
هل يجوز لمن صلى ثلاث عشرة ركعة بالوتر قبل نومه إذا استيقظ ليلا أن يتنفل؟

نعم من استيقظ بعد أن أوتر فله أن يصلي ما شاء من النوافل ولا يوتر لأن وتره قد سبق.

t: The ruling on one for whom the prayer is called while he is in a voluntary prayer
a: حكم من أقيمت عليه الصلاة وهو في نافلة
b:
what is the ruling on one performing a voluntary prayer when the obligatory prayer is called while he is in it? does he perform the rest of it sitting, or not?

the prophet, upon whom be peace, said: "when the prayer is called, there is no prayer but the prescribed one." this hadith is established from the prophet, upon whom be peace, so the investigation is not into its soundness but into its signification; and the people of knowledge differed as to its signification. some of them held that the meaning of his words "there is no prayer" is "there is no beginning afresh of a prayer", and others held that its meaning is "there is no validity of a prayer". all agreed that the lā is a negating lā and not a prohibiting one, because the prohibiting lā does not enter upon a noun here — rather, had lā been in the sense of prohibition he would have said "so do not pray": "when the prayer is called, do not pray". but he said "there is no prayer". so the lā is negating; and the negation is not directed at the existence of the prayer, because that would be untrue, for we see the prayer taking place when the obligatory prayer has been called, and untruth is impossible in the case of the prophet, upon whom be peace. that indicates that there is an elided element required by the sense, without which the speech does not stand. this signification is what the legal theorists call the signification of requirement (dalālat al-iqtiḍāʾ)..

it is that there is an elided element without which the speech does not stand; and this elided element, which is the thing required, has no generality — it cannot comprise a number of possibilities, but must be confined to a single possibility.

here, this elided element without which the speech does not stand is of three kinds. the first kind: that without which the speech does not stand rationally, as in god most high's words: {and there was behind them a king seizing every ship by force (79)} [al-kahf]. the speech here does not stand rationally except by an elided element, because making a hole in the ship does not take it out of being a ship. he made a hole in it, and then he said {and there was behind them a king seizing every ship by force (79)}. does making a hole in it take it out of being a ship? it does not take it out of being a ship. so there must be an elided element, its implied sense being "every sound ship", because the king took only sound ships — which is why al-khidr made a hole in the ship, so that there might be a defect in it by reason of which it would escape the king. this, then, is the elided element without which the speech does not stand rationally.

the second kind: that without which the correctness of the speech does not stand — the speech would be untrue without it. that is like the prophet's words, upon whom be peace: "error, and forgetfulness, and what they are compelled to, have been lifted for me from my community." for error and forgetfulness exist in the community, and compulsion exists in the community; so the speech does not stand except by an elided element, its implied sense being "the sin of error, and of forgetfulness, and of what they are compelled to". what has been lifted from the community is the sin of error and forgetfulness and what they are compelled to — not the existence of error and forgetfulness and what they are compelled to, for this exists.

the third kind: that whose meaning does not stand in the eyes of the sharia except by that elided element. that is like your saying "give in charity on my behalf with such-and-such", "give in charity on my behalf with your house". for i cannot give in charity on your behalf unless you own the house and i then give it in charity on your behalf, because what is meant by charity on your behalf is its being given out after it has entered your ownership. so the meaning of this is "sell me your house", or "give me your house and then give it in charity on my behalf". so there is an elided element without which the speech does not stand in the eyes of the sharia only, and not rationally.

from here, his words, upon whom be peace, "when the prayer is called, there is no prayer but the prescribed one", are of this sort. some of the people of knowledge took them to mean "there is no completing of a prayer", and so held that if a person is performing a voluntary prayer and the prayer is called while he is in the mosque, he must break off that voluntary prayer in order to join with the imam in the prayer — for the prophet, upon whom be peace, said: "two prayers together?", when he saw some people praying while the imam was praying. and another group said: rather, the elided element without which the speech does not stand is to be taken as "so there is no beginning afresh of a prayer" — so that when the prayer is called it is not lawful for a person to enter anew upon another prayer in the mosque. this is what the majority of the people of knowledge adopted.

this disagreement goes back to another disagreement, namely the disagreement as to the voluntary act: does it become obligatory by commencing it, or not? for we know that when the lawgiver legislated the rulings, he did not put them all at one degree: he made some of them obligatory and some of them recommended; and the wisdom of the lawgiver is that the obligatory should remain at obligation and the recommended at recommendation. but as to after commencing it, the people of knowledge have differed. one group of them said: the voluntary becomes obligatory by commencement. another group said: the voluntary does not become obligatory by commencement.
