this verse has two readings. one is {wa-lā tusʾalu ʿan aṣḥāb al-jaḥīm} and the other is {wa-lā tasʾal ʿan aṣḥāb al-jaḥīm} (sūrat al-baqarah 2:119). as for the reading wa-lā tasʾal ʿan aṣḥāb al-jaḥīm — that is, let their affair not trouble you, for they are in the utmost of the abiding, perpetual punishment. and as for wa-lā tusʾalu ʿan aṣḥāb al-jaḥīm — that is, that you are not held to account for their disobedience, for every person is answerable for his own sin and no one else is asked about it..

t: Commentary on al-Jazariyyah — part one
a: شرح الجزرية -الجزء الأول
b:
in the name of god, the merciful, the compassionate. praise be to god, lord of the worlds. i pray for blessing and peace upon him who was sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions and all who are guided by his guidance and follow his sunnah until the day of judgement. peace be upon you, and the mercy of god and his blessings.

to proceed: god most high sent down the qur'an upon muhammad, upon whom be peace, in a clear arabic tongue. gabriel, peace be upon him, brought it to the messenger of god, upon whom be peace, in instalments over twenty-three years, coming down according to the events and according to what the people of the earth asked about. that was a communication between the people of heaven and the people of the earth, and a bond between the creation and the creator, mighty and exalted, by the making clear of what he wants from them and the legislating of what he approves for them. god sealed the messages to the people of the earth with the message of muhammad, upon whom be peace, and sealed the books sent down to the people of the earth with the qur'an, and made it confirming the truth that was before it, and a guardian over all the books, and abrogating them..
r: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين، السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته، أما بعد فإن الله تعالى أنزل القرآن على محمد (ص) بلسان عربي مبين، وقد جاء به جبريل عليه السلام إلى رسول الله (ص) منجما في ثلاث وعشرين سنة، ينزل بحسب الوقائع وبحسب ما يسأل عنه أهل الأرض وكان ذلك اتصالا بين أهل السماء وأهل الأرض، وارتباطا بين الخلق والخالق، جل وعلا ببيان ما يريده منهم وتشريع ما يرتضيه لهم، وقد ختم الله الرسائل إلى أهل الأرض برسالة محمد (ص)، وختم الكتب المنزلة إلى أهل الأرض بالقرآن، وجعله مصدقا لما بين يديه من الحق ومهيمنا على كل الكتب وناسخا لها..

t: Commentary on al-Jazariyyah — part two
a: شرح الجزرية -الجزء الثاني
b: and by this you know that hafs al-duri, for example, died in the third century; that al-khaqani died in the fourth century; and that makki ibn abi talib died in the fifth century. the people of al-andalus in general were renowned for their mastery of this science, and for that reason makki was a renewer in it. then after him came abu ʿamr al-dani, who is the imam of all the qur'anic sciences without dispute; then after him his student abu dawud sulayman ibn al-najih, who is likewise al-dani's successor in this science. the people of al-andalus were renowned for the sciences of recitation, and for the exegesis of the qur'an as well: among them ibn ʿatiyyah, ibn juzayy, al-qurtubi and abu bakr ibn al-ʿarabi, and others among the leading authorities of the people of tajwīd, such as abu hayyan and ibn al-faras al-maliki, the author of the book aḥkām al-qurʾān. they have very many works indeed in the service of the qur'an..
r: وبهذا تعلمون أن حفص الدوري مثلا توفي في القرن الثالث والخاقاني توفي في القرن الرابع، ومكي بن أبي طالب توفي في القرن الخامس، وأهل الأندلس عموما اشتهروا بإتقان هذا العلم ولذلك فإن مكيا كان مجددا فيه ثم جاء بعده أبو عمرو الداني وهو إمام علوم القرآن كلها بلا منازع، ثم بعده تلميذه أبو داود سليمان بن النجيح وهو كذلك خليفة الداني في هذا العلم، فأهل الأندلس اشتهروا بعلوم التجويد وبتفسير القرآن كذلك فمنهم ابن عطية وابن جزي والقرطبي وأبو بكر بن العربي وغيرهم من أئمة أهل التجويد كأبي حيان وابن الفرس المالكي مؤلف كتاب أحكام القرآن، فلهم مؤلفات كثيرة جدا في خدمة القرآن..

t: Commentary on al-Jazariyyah — the last tape
a: شرح الجزرية الشريط الأخير
b:
i shall repeat the text of the previous chapter in order to correct the errors in it. the author, may god have mercy on him, said:

*and know, for what is written separated and what is written joined, and for the tāʾ, in the codex of the imam, in what has come down: separate in ten words — ألا with ملجإ, and لا إله إلا, and أن تعبدوا, [in] yāsīn, the second [instance in] hūd, لا يشركن, تشرك, يدخلن, تعلوا على, أن لا يقولوا, لا أقول, إما in al-raʿd; and the one with the fatḥah, join; and عما نهوا, separate; مما in al-rūm and al-nisāʾ, with a difference of opinion in al-munāfiqūn; أمن أسسا; فصلت al-nisāʾ, and ذبح wherever it occurs; and أن لم with the fatḥah, break; إنما al-anʿām, and the one with the fatḥah, يدعون, both; and a difference of opinion in al-anfāl, and in al-naḥl it occurred; and كل ما سألتموه, and they differed over ردوا; likewise قل بئسما, and as for the joined, describe [it]; خلفتموني and اشتروا in ما, separate; أوحي, أفضتم, اشتهت, يبلو, both.*
r:
سأعيد متن الباب السابق لتصحيح الأخطاء التي فيه، قال المؤلف رحمه الله:

واعْرِفْ لمقطوع وموصول وتا** في مصحف الإمام فيما قد أتى فاقطــــع بعــشر كلــــــــمات ألا** مـــعْ مَلْـــجَإٍ ولا إلـــــــــه إلا وتعبدوا يَاسِينَ ثاني هــــــودَ لا** يشركن تشركْ يدخُلَنْ تعلوا على ألَّا يقولوا لا أقولَ إمــــــــــــــا** بالرعد والمفتوح صل وعما نهوا اقطعوا مما بروم والنـسا** خلف المنافقــــين أمَّن أسسا فصلت النسا وذبــــــح حيثـما** وأن لم المفتوح كسر إنما الانعام والمفتوح يدعون مـعا** وخلف الانفال ونحل وقعا وكل ما سألتموه واخـــــتلف** ردوا كذا قل بيسما والوصل صف خلفتموني واشتروا في ما اقطعا** أوحي أفضتم اشتهت يبلو معا

t: Commentary on al-Jazariyyah — tape nine
a: شرح الجزرية -الشريط التاسع
b:
in the name of god, the merciful, the compassionate. praise be to god, lord of the worlds. i pray for blessing and peace upon him who was sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions and all who are guided by his guidance and follow his sunnah until the day of judgement.

the author says, may god most high have mercy on him: "chapter on the knowledge of the stopping-places." he set out this chapter to explain an important matter among the matters of recitation, namely the ruling on stopping (waqf) and on beginning (ibtidāʾ). waqf in the language is the verbal noun of waqafa, which is used intransitively and is used transitively. one says "so-and-so waqafa in the prayer", meaning he stood; and one says "so-and-so waqafa his mount or his she-camel", meaning he brought it to a halt. from this is the saying of ʿantarah:

*and long did i halt my she-camel there, making my complaint to blackened hearth-stones, motionless and crouching.*

and the saying of imru' al-qays:

*my companions halted their mounts over me there, saying: do not perish of grief; bear yourself well.*

and its counterpart, the saying of tarafah:

*my companions halted their mounts over me there, saying: do not perish of grief; be steadfast.*
r:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين يقول المؤلف رحمه الله تعالى: باب معرفة الوقوف عقد هذا الباب لبيان أمر مهم من أمور التجويد وهو حكم الوقف والابتداء، والوقف في اللغة مصدر وقف تستعمل لازمة وتستعمل متعدية، فيقال وقف فلان في الصلاة أي قام، ويقال وقف فلان راحلته أو ناقته إذا حبسها، ومنه قول عنترة

ولقد وقفت بها طويلا ناقتي** أشكو إلى سفع رواكد جثم

وقول امرئ القيس:

وقوفا بها صحبي علي مطيهم** يقولون لا تهلك أسى وتجمل

ونظيره قول طرفة:

وقوفا بها صحبي علي مطيهم** يقولون لا تهلك أسى وتجلد

t: Commentary on al-Jazariyyah — tape three
a: شرح الجزرية -الشريط الثالث
b:
in the name of god, the merciful, the compassionate. praise be to god, lord of the worlds. i pray for blessing and peace upon him who was sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions and all who are guided by his guidance and follow his sunnah until the day of judgement.

to proceed: the author says, may god have mercy on him: "chapter on the points of articulation of the letters." bāb in the language is an opening in a barrier by which one passes from inside to outside and the reverse — literally so in buildings, as with the door of a house, and by attribution in matters of meaning, as with the "chapter" on the points of articulation of the letters. as a technical term it is a name for a group of topics within a discipline which share certain rulings and are distinguished from others; it is set out for whatever in the science needs explaining. this science, which is the science of performance (ʿilm al-adāʾ), has among its topics those that require a chapter on the points of articulation of the letters to be set out. the letters have already been defined. they are investigated from four aspects. the first aspect: the point of articulation (the makhraj of the letter). the second aspect: the quality by which the letter is characterised. the third aspect: the form, that is, the marking it bears, whether quiescence or a vowel. the fourth aspect: the phonetic accidents that arise on combination, such as assimilation (idghām) and thinning (tarqīq) and other phonetic accidents. whoever masters these four matters, each one separately, is able to perform the letter in its correct form; and whoever knows some of them and not others will inevitably fall into flaw and error from the side of what he did not know of them..
r:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين.

أما بعد فيقول المؤلف رحمه الله: باب مخارج الحروف الباب في اللغة فرجة في ساتر يتوصل بها من داخل إلى خارج وبالعكس حقيقةً في المباني كباب الدار وحكما في المعاني كباب مخارج الحروف، وهو في الاصطلاح اسم لطائفة من الفن تشترك في بعض الأحكام وتتميز عن غيرها، وهو يعقد لما يحتاج لبيانه من العلم، فهذا العلم الذي هو علم الأداء من مسائله التي تحتاج إلى عقد باب مخارج الحروف، والحروف قد سبق تعريفها وهي يبٍحث فيها من أربعة أوجه، الوجه الأول: المخرج (مخرج الحرف)، والوجه الثاني الصفة التي يتصف بها الحرف، والوجه الثالث الشكل أي الضبط الذي يكون عليه سكونا أو حركة، والوجه الرابع العوارض الصوتية عند التركيب كالإدغام والترقيق وغير ذلك من العوارض الصوتية، فمن أتقن هذه الأمور الأربعة كلٌّ على حدة استطاع أداء الحرف على وجهه الصحيح، ومن عرف بعضها دون بعض لا بد أن يدخل عليه الخلل والخطأ من جهة ما جهل منها..

t: Commentary on al-Jazariyyah — tape eight
a: شرح الجزرية -الشريط الثامن
b:
praise be to god, lord of the worlds. may god bless our prophet muhammad and grant him peace, and his family and his companions and all who are guided by his guidance and follow his sunnah until the day of judgement. peace be upon you, and the mercy of god and his blessings.

to proceed: among the letters are some that are singled out for certain rulings, and these must be attended to in order that those rulings peculiar to them may be attended to. these letters are the mīm, the nūn and the lām. these three letters depart from the rules of the letters, on account of certain particularities that belong to them, so there was a need to set out the rulings peculiar to them. the author, may god most high have mercy on him, set out this chapter to explain the rulings of the mīm and to explain the ruling of the doubled nūn, and said:

*and make the nasalisation clear, from a nūn and from a mīm, when the two are doubled....*

this rule entails that with the mīm and the nūn the nasalisation is increased in the case of assimilation, that is, in the case of doubling — because each of the two is in origin a nasal letter, so that when it is repeated its share of nasalisation increases. for that reason the two must be attended to in the case of doubling ..
r:
الحمد لله رب العالمين وصلى الله وسلم على نبينا محمد وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين، السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته.

أما بعد فإن من الحروف ما هو مختص ببعض الأحكام، فلا بد من العناية به للعناية بتلك الأحكام التي تختص به، وهذه الحروف هي الميم والنون واللام فهذه الحروف الثلاثة تخرج عن قواعد الحروف لبعض الاختصاصات التي تختص بها، فاحتيج لبيان أحكام تختص بها، وقد عقد المؤلف رحمه الله تعالى هذا الباب لبيان أحكام الميم ولبيان حكم النون المشددة فقال:

وأظهر الغنة من نون ومن** ميم إذا ما شددا....

هذه القاعدة تقتضي أن الميم والنون تزداد الغنة معهما في حال الادغام أي في حال التشديد، لأن كل واحد منهما في الأصل حرف أغن، فإذا تكرر ازداد نصيبه من الغنة، فلذلك لا بد من العناية بهما في حال التشديد ..

t: The importance of the Arabic language
a: أهمية اللغة العربية
b:
in the name of god, the merciful, the compassionate. praise be to god, lord of the worlds. i pray for blessing and peace upon him who was sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions and all who are guided by his guidance and follow his sunnah until the day of judgement. peace be upon you, and the mercy of god and his blessings.

to proceed: it is among god most high's kindness and his favours and his mercy that he made for people a tongue by which they understand one another. people have need of one another, and none of them can meet his need without others; none of them can be independent in managing his affairs or in discharging his tasks unless he finds someone to help him in that. from this they had need to understand one another and to know one another. so god made for them means of knowing one another, the greatest of which are lineages, as god most high said: {o mankind, we have created you from a male and a female, and made you peoples and tribes, that you may know one another. indeed the most honoured of you with god is the most god-conscious of you} (sūrat al-ḥujurāt 49:13). and he made for them means of understanding one another, the greatest of which are languages. for this reason god linked colours and languages with the creation of the heavens and the earth, in his words, most high: {and among his signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the difference of your tongues and your colours. indeed in that are signs for those who know} (sūrat al-rūm 30:22). human beings cannot understand one another except by way of the means of sense — except by way of the five senses — because the means of knowledge a person has are three: the intellect, the spirit and the senses..
r:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته.

أما بعد فإن من لطف الله تعالى ونعمه ورحمته أن جعل للناس لسانا يتفاهمون به، فالناس يحتاج بعضهم لبعض ولا يمكن أن يقوم أحد منهم بحاجته دون بعض، ولا يمكن أن يستقل منهم إنسان بقضاء أموره ولا بأداء مهماته إلا إذا وجد من يساعده على ذلك، ومن هنا احتاجوا إلى التفاهم فيما بينهم والتعارف، فجعل الله لهم وسائل للتعارف ومن أعظمها الأنساب حيث قال تعالى: {يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاكُمْ مِنْ ذَكَرٍ وَأُنْثَى وَجَعَلْنَاكُمْ شُعُوبًا وَقَبَائِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوا إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ أَتْقَاكُمْ} وجعل لهم وسائل للتفاهم وأعظمها اللغات ولهذا ربط الله بين الألوان واللغات وبين خلق السماوات والأرض في قوله تعالى: {وَمِنْ آَيَاتِهِ خَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافُ أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَأَلْوَانِكُمْ إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لَآَيَاتٍ لِلْعَالِمِينَ} فالبشر لا يمكن أن يتفاهموا إلا عن طريق وسائل الحس، إلا عن طريق الحواس الخمس، لأن وسائل العلم لدى الإنسان ثلاث، هي العقل والروح والحس..

t: Answers on the science of legal theory
a: أجوبة في علم الأصول
b:
the rejection of the singly transmitted report in the qur'an:

is what is also said correct, namely that the companions, may god be pleased with them, entrenched this principle of rejecting the singly transmitted report when they rejected established singly transmitted narrations of companions and so did not establish a qur'anic reading by them — as with the reading "ten known sucklings", and the reading "so cut off their right hands"?

the answer: no. this too is not a case of rejecting the singly transmitted report. the companions established that the qur'an must be mass-transmitted, so that it cannot be narrated by a singly transmitted report: it differs from the singly transmitted reports. singly transmitted reports do not occur in the qur'an; they occur in the sunnah only. for this reason the companions did not accept as qur'an anything narrated by a few individuals — except one verse, which they found written down and for which they found no one who had memorised it but khuzaymah ibn thabit; but the messenger of god, upon whom be peace, had made his testimony equal to the testimony of two men. it is god most high's words: {there has come to you a messenger from among yourselves; grievous to him is that you should suffer; he is deeply concerned for you, and to the believers kind and merciful} (sūrat al-tawbah 9:128). they did not doubt that this is the speech of god and that it had been sent down upon the messenger, upon whom be peace — indeed many of them had heard it. they doubted only whether it had been abrogated in the final review or not. khuzaymah informed them that he had heard it from the messenger of god, upon whom be peace, in his last recitation of sūrat al-tawbah, so they established it in it, because they knew that his testimony was equal to the testimony of two men.

*- the probative force of the singly transmitted report:

does this apply to us, the community of muslims, since we act upon singly transmitted hadiths which yield nothing but probability — the substance of the noble verse: {we only conjecture, and we are not certain}?
r:
رد خبر الآحاد في القرآن:

هل صحيح ما يقال أيضا من أن الصحابة رضوان الله عليهم قد كرسوا مبدأ رد خبر الآحاد هذا حين ردوا روايات آحاد الصحابة الثابتة فلم يثبتوا بها القراءة القرآنية وذلك كقراءة عشر رضعات معلومات وكقراءة فاقطعوا أيمانهما؟

الجواب: لا، هذا أيضا ليس من رد خبر الآحاد، فقد أثبت الصحابة أن القرآن لا بد أن يكون متواترا فلا يمكن أن يروى بخبر الآحاد فهو يختلف عن أخبار الآحاد، أخبار الآحاد لا تكون في القرآن إنما تكون في السنة فقط، ولهذا فلم يقبل الصحابة من القرآن ما رواه آحاد قلائل إلا آية واحدة وجدوها مكتوبة ولم يجدوا من يحفظها إلا خزيمة بن ثابت ولكن رسول الله (ص) جعل شهادته بشهادة رجلين، وهي قوله تعالى: {لقد جاءكم رسول من أنفسكم عزيز عليه ما عنتم حريص عليكم بالمؤمنين رؤوف رحيم} ولم يترددوا أن هذا من كلام الله وأنه قد نزل على الرسول(ص)، بل قد سمعه كثير منهم وإنما ترددوا هل نسخت في العرضة الأخيرة أم لا؟ فأخبرهم خزيمة أنه سمعها من رسول الله (ص) في آخر قراءته لسورة التوبة فأثبتوها فيها، لأنهم علموا أن شهادته بشهادة رجلين.

*- حجية خبر الآحاد:

هل ينطبق هذا علينا نحن معاشر المسلمين إذ نعمل بأحاديث الآحاد التي لا تفيد إلا الظن مضمون الآية الكريمة: {إن نظن إلا ظنا وما نحن بمستيقنين}؟

t: Commentary on the Waraqāt of Imam al-Haramayn on legal theory — tape one
a: شرح ورقات إمام الحرمين في أصول الفقه الشريط الأول
b:
in the name of god, the merciful, the compassionate. praise be to god, lord of the worlds. i pray for blessing and peace upon him who was sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions and all who are guided by his guidance and follow his sunnah until the day of judgement.

this is the commentary on the waraqāt of imam al-haramayn on legal theory. it is a small, abridged composition of the introductory definitions in legal theory, set down by the imam of the shafi'is, abu al-maʿali ʿabd al-malik ibn ʿabd allah ibn yusuf ibn muhammad al-juwayni — the name being taken from juwaynah, of nishapur. he was born, may god have mercy on him, in the year 419 ah and died in the year 478 ah, and he was among the famous theologians, jurists and legal theorists. he composed these waraqāt so that they might be a beginning for students of knowledge, by which they would come to know some of the terms of legal theory.

legal theory is among the most important of the sharia sciences, because it is that by which one can arrive at an understanding of the book and the sunnah, and at the taking of rulings from them. that is because the book and the sunnah are investigated from two sides: the side of their coming down, and the side of their signification. as for the side of their coming down, it is transmission — meaning the ascertaining of the attribution of the qur'an to god, and the ascertaining of the attribution of the hadith to the prophet, upon whom be god's blessing and peace; and that is by narration and by the chain of transmission. and the second side, the side of signification, means what is intended by this speech: what god wants from his servants by this wording, and what the prophet, upon whom be god's blessing and peace, wants from his community by this wording.
r:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ، الحمد لله رب العالمين وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين.

هذا شرح ورقات إمام الحرمين في أصول الفقه وهو تأليف صغير مختصر للتعريفات المبدئية في أصول الفقه وضعه إمام الشافعية أبو المعالي عبد الملك بن عبد الله بن يوسف بن محمد الجويني نسبة إلى جوينة من نيسابور وقد ولد رحمه سنة 419هـ وتوفي سنة 478هـ ، وكان من مشاهير المتكلمين والفقهاء والأصوليين وقد ألف هذه الورقات لتكون مبدءا لطلاب العلم يعرفون به بعض مصطلحات أصول الفقه ، وأصول الفقه علم من أهم العلوم الشرعية لأنه الذي يمكن أن يتوصل به إلى فهم الكتاب والسنة و أخذ الأحكام منهما ، و ذلك أن الكتاب والسنة يبحث فيهما من جهتين ـ جهة الورود وجهة الدلالة ، أما جهة الورود فهي النقل بمعنى التحقق من ثبوت نسبة القرآن إلى الله والتحقق من ثبوت نسبة الحديث إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وذلك بالرواية والإسناد والجهة الثانية ، جهة الدلالة ومعناها ما يراد بهذا الكلام ، ما يريده الله من عباده بهذا اللفظ ، وما يريده النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم من أمته بهذا اللفظ .

t: Commentary on the Waraqāt of Imam al-Haramayn on legal theory — tape three
a: شرح ورقات إمام الحرمين في أصول الفقه الشريط الثالث
b: he said: "and the form of the imperative occurs while what is meant by it is permissibility, or a threat, or equivalence, or bringing into being." he means that the form of the imperative may occur for other than its original meaning, because of an indication pointing to that. it may occur for permissibility (ibāḥah), as in god most high's words: (and when you have left the state of pilgrim consecration, then hunt) — "then hunt" here does not indicate obligation, even though it is the form of an imperative, and it does not indicate recommendation either; rather it indicates permissibility. likewise, the form of the imperative may occur to indicate a threat, so that a command is not meant by it in that case, as in god most high's words: (say: enjoy yourselves, for your destination is the fire) — this is not a command to enjoy oneself in the true sense; rather what is meant by it is a threat. and the like of it: (so whoever wishes, let him believe, and whoever wishes, let him disbelieve; we have prepared for the wrongdoers a fire) — this is for a threat. likewise equivalence, which is equivalence between doing and leaving undone, as in god most high's words: (so be patient or be not patient; it is the same for you) — "be patient" here, the command in it is not for obligation, but is for equivalence, by the indication of what follows it; the verbal indication required that the imperative be turned away from its original meaning. or for bringing into being, which is causing to exist, as in god most high's words: (be apes, despised) — "be" here, the command in it is not for obligation, but is for bringing into being. the indications are more than those mentioned; rather these are examples of indications. and the like of them, conversely, for the prohibition also: the prohibition may occur for other than what it is set for — it may occur for dislikedness, and it may occur for a threat, and the like of that..
r: قال "وترد صيغة الأمر والمراد به الإباحة أو التهديد أو التسوية أو التكوين" يقصد أن صيغة الأمر قد ترد لغير المعنى الأصلي لقرينة تدل على ذلك ، فقد ترد للإباحة كقول الله تعالى: (وإذا حللتم فاصطادوا) فاصطادوا هنا لا تدل على الوجوب وإن كانت صيغة أمر ولا تدل أيضا على الندب بل تدل على الإباحة ، وكذلك قد ترد صيغة الأمر للدلالة على التهديد فلا يقصد بها حينئذ الأمر ، كقول الله تعالى: (قل تمتعوا فإن مصيركم إلى النار) فليس هذا أمرا بالتمتع على حقيقته بل المقصود به التهديد ومثله (فمن شاء فليؤمن ومن شاء فليكفر إنا أعتدنا للظالمين نارا) ، فهذا للتهديد ، وكذلك التسوية وهي التسوية بين الفعل والترك وذلك مثل قول الله تعالى: (فاصبروا أو لا تصبروا سواء عليكم) فاصبروا هنا ليس الأمر فيها للوجوب بل هو للتسوية بدلالة ما بعدها ، فالقرينة المقالية اقتضت صرف الأمر عن معناه الأصلي ، أو للتكوين وهو الإيجاد لقول الله تعالى: (كونوا قردة خائسين) فكونوا هنا ليست الأمر فيها للوجوب وإنما هو للتكوين والقرائين أكثر مما ذكر بل هذه أمثلة للقرائن ومثلها في العكس أيضا للنهي فقد يرد النهي على غير ما هو له، قد يرد للكراهة وقد يرد للتهديد ونحو ذلك..

t: Commentary on the Waraqāt of Imam al-Haramayn on legal theory — tape five
a: شرح ورقات إمام الحرمين في أصول الفقه الشريط الخامس
b:
the singly transmitted:

al-āḥād is the plural of aḥad, which means "one". (and what is meant by al-āḥād in the terminology of the legal theorists) — what is meant by the singly transmitted report in the terminology of the legal theorists is what individuals among the people have narrated who do not reach the degree of mass transmission. it is for this reason that he defined it by his words: "and the singly transmitted is that which necessitates action but does not necessitate knowledge." he divided the report into two divisions: into the mass-transmitted, and the singly transmitted report. so al-āḥād here involves the elision of a governed noun, the implied sense being: the singly transmitted report is that which necessitates action but does not necessitate knowledge. what is meant here by its necessitating action is: on the assumption of its soundness, and of its entailing obligation — for the singly transmitted is not necessarily sound, such that it should necessitate action. and his words "and does not necessitate knowledge" mean: so long as it is not attended by supporting indications. for a singly transmitted report may be attended by indications, and so entail necessary knowledge as well, as with what malik narrated from nafiʿ from ibn ʿumar, and what al-bukhari and muslim agreed upon recording among the singly transmitted reports; for there attends it such indications as entail confidence in it, so that it becomes like the mass-transmitted, and knowledge is obtained by it — and this knowledge is theoretical, not necessary ...
r:
الآحاد:

والآحاد جمع أحد وهو الواحد ، (والمقصود بالآحاد في اصطلاح الأصوليين) ، و المقصود بخبر الآحاد في اصطلاح الأصوليين ما رواه آحاد من الناس لا يصلون إلى درجة التواتر ، ولهذا عرفه بقوله: والآحاد هو الذي يوجب العمل ولا يوجب العلم ، فقد قسم الخبر إلى قسمين إلى متواتر ، و خبر آحاد ، فالآحاد هنا على حذف مضاف تقديره خبر الآحاد هو الذي يوجب العمل ولا يوجب العلم ، والمقصود هنا بإيجاب العمل أي على فرض صحته ، واقتضائه الوجوب ، فالآحاد ليس بالضرورة صحيحا حتى يوجب العمل ، وقوله ولا يوجب العلم أي ما لم يحتف بالقرائن فقد يحتف خبر الآحاد بالقرائن ، فيقتضي العلم الضروري كذلك كما رواه مالك عن نافع عن ابن عمر ، وما اتفق على إخراجه البخاري ومسلم من أخبار الآحاد ، فقد احتف به من القرائن ما يقتضي الثقة به حتى يكون كالمتواتر ، فيحصل به العلم ، وهذا العلم نظري لا ضروري ...

t: Commentary on the Waraqāt of Imam al-Haramayn on legal theory — tape four
a: شرح ورقات إمام الحرمين في أصول الفقه -الشريط الرابع
b:
abrogation:

this chapter is set out to explain abrogation and to mention its divisions. naskh: its meaning in the language is removal. one says "the winds nasakhat the trace" when they removed it and altered it, and one says "the sun nasakhat the shade" when it removed it. it is also applied to transferring, so one says "he nasakha the book" when he copied it. this is its meaning in the language.

as for its meaning as a technical term, it is the alteration of a ruling of the sharia by an address subsequent to it. what is meant by the ruling of the sharia is one that was itself also an address — so the original absence of legal liability (al-barāʾah al-aṣliyyah) is not abrogated, and nothing is abrogated by it, because all the rulings came down upon an original absence of liability that preceded them; and if that were reckoned to be abrogation, all the rulings would be abrogating something that had preceded, namely the original absence of liability and the absence of legal responsibility. nor is anything abrogated except by an address: so there is no abrogation by analogical reasoning, nor by independent legal reasoning, nor by scholarly consensus; abrogation comes about only by revelation sent down.

, he said: "as for abrogation, its meaning in the language is removal. one says: the sun nasakhat the shade, when it removed it. and it is said that its meaning is transferring, from their saying: i nasakhtu what is in this book, that is, i copied it"..
r:
النسخ:

عقد هذا الباب لبيان النسخ و ذكر أقسامه، و النسخ معناه في اللغة الإزالة، فيقال نسخت الرياح الأثر إذا أزالته و غيرته و يقال نسخت الشمس الظل إذا أزالته، و يطلق أيضا على النقل فيقال نسخ الكتاب إذا نقله، فهذا معناه في اللغة.

و أما معناه في الاصطلاح فهو تغيير الحكم الشرعي بخطاب متراج عنه، و المقصود بالحكم الشرعي ما كان خطابا أيضا، فلا تنسخ البراءة الأصلية و لا ينسخ بها لأن الأحكام كلها إنما نزلت على براءة أصلية سابقة لها، فلو اعتبر ذالك نسخا لكانت الأحكام كلها ناسخة لأمر قد سبق و هو البراءة الأصلية و عدم التكليف و لا ينسخ أيضا إلا بالخطاب فلا نسخ بالقياس و لا بالاجتهاد و لا بالإجماع، و إنما يحصل النسخ بالوحي المنزل.

،قال وأما النسخ فمعناه لغة الإزالة يقال نسخت الشمس الظل إذا أزالته ، وقيل معناه النقل ، من قولهم نسخت ما في هذا الكتاب أي نقلته ..

t: Commentary on the Waraqat of Imam al-Haramayn on Legal Theory — Tape Two
a: شرح ورقات إمام الحرمين في أصول الفقه -الشريط الثاني
b: the divisions of knowledge. this chapter is set down to set out the divisions of knowledge and to define its categories, after knowledge and its opposite — which is ignorance — have been defined. he said: necessary knowledge (al-ʿilm al-ḍarūrī), which is that which does not arise from reflection (naẓar) and inference (istidlāl), such as the knowledge that comes about through one of the five senses. so he divided knowledge here into the necessary and the reflective (naẓarī). "necessary" is derived from necessity (ḍarūrah), in the sense of that to which a person is compelled: a person is compelled to know it of itself. he said: necessary knowledge is that which does not arise from reflection and inference — that is, what is obtained without reflection and inference, what does not depend on reflection. and reflection (naẓar), as we said, is thought (fikr). and inference — istidlāl is the setting up of the evidence (iqāmat al-dalīl). so the necessary is that which needs no deliberation, which needs no movement of the soul within it, neither by reflection — that is, thinking — nor by inference. as for the knowledge that comes about through one of the five senses: things seen, things heard, things smelled and things touched — necessary knowledge is obtained by all of them, so a person needs no deliberation in them. whoever hears the speech of a person concludes with certainty that he is a speaker, because this speech issued from him; and whoever sees him perform an act concludes that with certainty without needing to deliberate over it or to set up evidence for it, and so on.
r: أقسام العلم عقد هذا الباب لبيان تقسيمات العلم وتعريف أقسامه بعد أن عرف العلم وما يقابله وهو الجهل ، فقال العلم الضروري وهو ما لا يقع عن نظر واستدلال كالعلم الواقع بإحدى الحواس الخمس ، فقسم العلم هنا إلى ضروري ونظري ، فالضروري منسوب إلى الضرورة بمعنى الذي يضطر الإنسان إليه ، فالإنسان مضطر لأن يعرفه بذاته ، قال والعلم الضروري ما لا يقع عن نظر واستدلال ، أي ما يحصل دون نظر واستدلال لا يتوقف على نظر ، والنظر كما قلنا هو الفكر ، واستدلال والاستدلال هو إقامة الدليل ، فالضروري هو ما لا يحتاج إلى التأمل لا يحتاج إلى حركة النفس فيه لا بنظر أي تفكر ولا باستدلال فالعلم الواقع بإحدى الحواس الخمس فالمرئيات والمسموعات والمشمومات والملموسات كلها يحصل بها العلم الضروري فلا يحتاج الإنسان فيها إلى تأمل ، فمن سمع كلام إنسان جزم بأنه متكلم ، لأن هذا الكلام صدر منه ، ومن رآه يفعل فعلا جزم بذلك دون أن يحتاج إلى تأمل في هذا أو إقامة دليل عليه وهكذا .

t: Sheikh al-Dedew Visits the "Peace Be upon You, O Prophet" Centre in Mecca
a: الشيخ الددو يزور مركز "السلام عليك أيها النبي" بمكة
b:
the sheikh visited the "peace be upon you, o prophet" centre in mecca the ennobled. what he saw there of distinguished efforts to spread the biography (sīrah) of the chosen one — may god bless him and grant him peace — stirred his admiration, and he recited the following poem: (the poem). we note here that this centre is headed by his eminence sheikh nasir ibn musfir al-zahrani, that it is based in mecca, that it is concerned with making the relics of the prophet — may god bless him and grant him peace — known, and that it seeks to present them in a new dress, in style and in method.

*the light has blazed upon the heights of the mother of cities, and (victory has broken, blossoming) and illuminating. here is (nasir), he of noble learning, who has brought back to life what ignorance had killed of it and buried away. whoever visits his centre — "peace be upon you, o best of creation" — will see in it the best of creation. there he will see the lights of ahmad, which have shamed, in all the cosmos, the cleaving of the radiant dawn; and the perfume of his life, fragrant, shaming the scent of all creation were that the most pungent musk. he will see him in every scene, marked out by miracles, divinely upheld and given victory. he will see him in the sorrowful ravine, girded for hardship, and see him withdrawing alone for worship in hira. he will see him at the hour of revelation, after it came down upon him, in his house wrapped in his cloak, enveloped in his mantle. he will see him piercing the layered heavens, honoured, on the night of the ascent (miʿrāj) and the night journey. at the pledge of good pleasure (bayʿat al-riḍwān) he beholds his companions clad in their mail, and beholds him when he conquers khaybar. he sees the swords of the chosen one and his arrows, his spears, his coats of mail and his helmet; his garment, his bedding and his furnishings, his bedstead, his sandal and the pulpit; his food, his drink and his writing, and the seal engraved upon it, round. all of it he sees embodied and represented — a truthful representation — standing out and depicted. and he sees in it (an encyclopaedia) that has gathered what lies in the books — (all the game is in the belly of the wild ass). (an encyclopaedia) that has gathered hadith with its sources traced, that has gathered the book recited in measure and expounded; that has gathered the prophet's traits (shamāʾil), the campaigns (maghāzī), the raiding parties (sarāyā) and the expeditions, and all that took place in them. so he fancies that he has lived among his companions an age, hearing the hadith in it and seeing. and he fancies the horses of god before him, their squadrons standing firm, raising the dust. and he says: what are the films, the relics and the stirring tales, when they are seen, but hurried glimpses that handle one single element — and most of them a fabricated report. but that which al-sharif has been guided to gather and to order, or what has come forth from him of it, is a truthful exposition of all the elements, one that makes the truth plain and leaves no element out. how excellent is our sharif and his comrades! how truthful are these folk — indeed, how patient! they have made new what they laid down, and brought that beside which those who prize it would count a jewel cheap. o lord, grant victory to (nasir) and honour him, and open for him, o lord, a greater opening; and guard him from the evils of the envious, and turn them back in surrender, retreating, when they see him. and continue your blessing and your peace upon him whom you have ennobled and raised to the highest summits.*
r: قام الشيخ بزيارة مركز " السلام عليك أيها النبي" في مكة المكرمة، وقد أثار إعجاب الشيخ ما رآه من جهود مميزة لنشر سيرة المصطفى صلى الله عليه وسلم، فأنشد القصيدة التالية: ( القصيدة)، ونشير هنا إلى أن هذا المركز يرأسه فضيلة الشيخ ناصر بن مسفر الزهراني ، ومقره بمكة، ويهتم بالتعريف بآثار النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، ويسعى لتقديمها في ثوب جديد أسلوبا ومنهجا. النور شعشع في ذرى أُمِّ القُرى و ( النَّصْرُ أَسْفَر مُزْهِرَا ) وَمُنَوِّرَا ذا ( ناصر ) العلم الشريف قد انشرَا ما قد أَمَاتَ الجَهْلُ منه وأَقبَرَا من زار مركزهُ " السلام عليك يا خير الورى " سيرى به خير الورى فيرى به أنوار أحمدَ أخجَلت في الكون مفتوقَ الصباحِ الأَزهَرَا وعبير سيرته المعَطر مخجِلاً عطر الورى لو كان مِسْكًا أذْفرَا ويراهُ في كل المشاهد مُعْلمًا بالمعجزاتِ مُؤيَّدًا ومُظفَرَا ويراه في الشعب الحزين مشمرًا ويراه يخلو للعبادة في حِرَا ويراه وقت الوحي بعد نزوله في بيته مُزَّمِلاً مُدَّثِرَا ويراه يخترق الطباق مُكرَّمًا في ليلة المعراج منه والسُّرى في بيعة الرضوان يبصر صحبه مستلئمين وحين يفتح خيبرَا ويرى سيوف المصطفى وسهامه ورماحه ودروعه والمغفرَا ولباسه وفراشَهُ وأَثَاثَه وسريرَهُ وحذاءَهُ والمنبرَا وطعامه وشرابه وكتابَه ُ والخاتم المنقوش فيه مُدَوَّرَا كلٌّ يراهُ مجسَّدًا ومُمَثَّلاً تمثيلَ صِدْقٍ بارزا ومصوَّرا ويرى به ( موسوعة ) حَوَتِ الذي في الكتب ( كلُّ الصيد في جَوْفِ الفَرَى ) ( موسوعة ) حوَتِ الحديث مُخَرَّجًا حَوَتِ الكتابَ مُرَتَّلاً ومُفَسَّرَا حوتِ الشمائل والمغازي والسَّرَا يَا والبعوث وكُلُّ ما فيها جرى فيخال أن قد عاش بين صحابه دهرًا به سمع الحديث وأَبْصَرَا ويخال خيل الله بين يديه قد صبرت قنابلها تثير العِثْيَرَا فيقول مَا الأفلامُ والآثار وال قِصص المثيرة إذْ تُرَى إلا رُؤى عَجْلَى تُعَالِج عنصرًا فَرْدًا وأغلبها حديث مفترى لكن ما هُديَ الشريفُ لجمعه ونظامِهِ أو مَا لَه مِنه انْبَرى تفسيرُ صدقٍ للعناصر كلها يجلو الحقيقة لا يغادر عنصرا لله دَرُّ شريفنا ورفاقه ما أصدق الأقوامَ بل ما أصبرا قد أبدعوا ما أودعوا وأتوا بما يَسْترخصُ المغلون فيه الجوهرا يا رب فانصر ( ناصرا ) وأعزَّه وافتح له يا رب فتحًا أكبرا وقه شرور الحاسدين ورُدَّهُمْ مستسلمين إذا رأوه القهقرى وأدم صلاتك والسلام على الذي شرفته ورفعته أعلى الذرى

t: The Creed of al-Ash'ari and His Retraction of It
a: عقيدة الأشعري و رجوعه عنها
b:
some people say that the creed of al-ash'ari is not sound and that he retracted it before his death. what truth is there in that?

imam abu al-hasan ali ibn isma'il al-ash'ari is one of the imams of ahl al-sunnah among the muslims. he is a descendant of abu musa, the companion of the messenger of god — may god bless him and grant him peace. he was renowned for his memorisation of the book and the sunnah and for his mastery of the religious sciences. he had taken the view that the independent legal reasoning (ijtihād) in which the schools of law were laid down had been confined to the juristic side and had not reached the creedal side, so he wished to lay down principles for the muslims in creed (ʿaqīdah) that would constitute a school. at the outset he had followed the school of the mu'tazilah, then he retracted it and repented of it, and he refuted them with many refutations; his books on that are extant and in circulation.

then, when he laid down those principles, among them were some erroneous exercises of independent reasoning for which he is certainly rewarded, because he was known for his uprightness and his scrupulousness: what he got right in it earns him two rewards, and what he got wrong in it earns him one reward. as for those errors into which he fell, he himself stated plainly that he retracted them, in his book maqalat al-islamiyyin and in his book al-ibanah 'an usul al-diyanah — both of which are transmitted with chains of transmission (asānīd) connected back to the author. likewise the ḥāfiẓ ibn asakir composed a book which he named al-dhabb 'an al-ash'ari, and it is a printed, available book. for this reason it is known that abu al-hasan did retract those errors into which he had fallen; and whoever retracts an error, it is not reckoned against him.

this is so all the more because, of the school that people ascribe to al-ash'ari, there are many questions that al-ash'ari never heard of, never said, and which did not exist in his time nor in any of his books; rather it was the later theologians (mutakallimūn) who said them. if you consult the books of creed composed according to what is called the ash'ari school, you will find that they say things contrary to shaykh abu al-hasan; and there are positions ascribed to him which some of the ash'aris themselves reject. that is why al-suyuti — may god have mercy on him — said in al-kawkab al-sati':

*following a qualified scholar (taqlīd) is impermissible in matters of creed — and al-'anbari permitted it, and it has been prohibited — then, upon the first position, if one does follow — but abu hashim did not reckon it — al-qushayri said: it is a fabrication against him — al-fakhr, and al-ustadh, then al-amidi — our predecessors, such as al-shafi'i: with him lies the considered view — then he is a believer who is disobedient, upon the relied-upon position — his faith; and that has been ascribed to al-ash'ari.*

many of the positions ascribed to al-ash'ari are ones he did not hold; their chains of transmission are not sound, and they are not found in any of his books at all. with many of them his own followers state plainly that they departed from shaykh abu al-hasan in the matter — such as the affirmation of the maʿnawiyyāt, the seven attributes that became known as the maʿnawiyyāt. the first to affirm them was al-fakhr al-razi, and he said concerning them that he was departing from shaykh abu al-hasan in that; he himself stated plainly that he departs from shaykh abu al-hasan in that. that is why shaykh muhammad al-mamm — may god have mercy on him — said:

*al-ash'ari denied the states (aḥwāl), and it was al-fakhr al-razi who worked out from them the attributes of the all-merciful.*

so the author of the idea is al-fakhr al-razi, and not imam abu al-hasan al-ash'ari. al-ash'ari, then, denied that. on this basis, what is ascribed to him as being a school of his is like what is ascribed to imam malik as being a school of his: many of the positions he did not state, nor are they in his muwatta', nor in the books transmitted from him. that is why al-dabusi of the hanafis said — he said: the positions ascribed to the imams, and the jurisprudence set down in the books, ought to be reviewed. whatever of it comes from the independent reasoning of those qualified to exercise it is to be taken; and whatever comes from the reasoning of those who merely follow a qualified scholar is to be rejected — for how can they exercise independent reasoning when they do not even claim to be capable of it? this is the statement of al-dabusi, one of the imams of the hanafis, even though he was himself a follower of a school.
r: بعض الناس يقول إن عقيدة الأشعري غير صحيحة و أنه تراجع عنها قبل موته فما صحة ذلك؟ إ ن الإمام أبا الحسن علي بن إسماعيل الأشعري إمام من أئمة أهل السنة من المسلمين و هو من ذرية أبي موسى صاحب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم و قد اشتهر بحفظ الكتاب و السنة و إتقان علوم الدين و كان قد رأى أن الاجتهاد الذي وضعت فيه المذاهب اقتصر على الجانب الفقهي و لم يصل إلى الجانب العقدي فأراد أن يضع قواعد للمسلمين في العقيدة تكون مذهبا و قد كان في البداية على مذهب المعتزلة فرجع عنه و تاب منه. و رد عليهم بكثير من الردود و كتبه في ذلك موجودة منتشرة ثم لما وضع تلك القواعد كان منها بعض الإجتهادات الخاطئة التي هو مثاب عليها قطعا لأنه عرف منه الصلاح و الورع فما أصاب فيه فله فيه أجران و ما أخطأ فيه فله به أجر و تلك الأخطاء التي وقع فيها قد صرح هو برجوعه عنها في كتابه (مقالات الإسلاميين) و في كتابه (الإبانة عن أصول الديانة) و كلاهما مروي بالأسانيد المتصلة إلى المؤلف و قد ألف كذلك الحافظ بن عساكر كتابا سماه الذب عن الأشعري و هو كتاب مطبوع موجود فلهذا يعلم أن أبا الحسن قد رجع عن تلك الأخطاء التي وقع فيها و من رجع عن الخطإ فإنه لا يعد محسوبا عليه و بالأخص أن المذهب الذي ينسبه الناس إلى الأشعري كثير من مسائله لم يسمع بها الأشعري و لا قالها ولا وجدت في زمانه و لا في شيء من كتبه و إنما قالها المتأخرون من المتكلمين و إذا راجعتم كتب العقائد المؤلفة على ما يسمى بالمذهب الأشعري ستجدون أنهم يقولون خلافا للشيخ أبي الحسن و بعض الأقوال تنسب إليه فينكرها بعض الأشاعرة أنفسهم و لذلك قال السيوطي رحمه الله في الكوكب الساطع: يمتنع التقليد في العقائد و العنبري جوزه و قد حظر ثم على الأول إن يقلد لكن أبو هاشم لم يعتبر قال القشيري عليه مفترى الفخر و الأستاذ ثم الآمدي أسلافنا كالشافعي به النظر فمؤمن عاص على المعتمد إيمانه وقد عزي للأشعري فكثير من الأقوال التي تنسب إلى الأشعري لم يقل بها و أسانيدها غير صحيحة و لا توجد في شيء من كتبه أصلا و كثير منها يصرح أصحابه بأنهم خالفوا الشيخ أبا الحسن في ذلك كإثبات المعنويات الصفات السبع التي اشتهرت بالمعنويات أول من أثبتها الفخر الرازي و قد قال فيها إنه يخالف الشيخ أبا الحسن في ذلك صرح هو أنه يخالف الشيخ أبا الحسن في ذلك و لهذا قال الشيخ محمد المام رحمه الله: الاشْعَرِي الاحْوَالْ انْكَرْهَ وَ اْلفَخَرْ الرَّازِي حَرَّرْهَ عَنْهَ صِفَاتْ الرَّحْمَنْ فصاحب الفكرة هو الفخر الرازي و ليس الإمام أبا الحسن الأشعري فالأشعري إذن أنكر ذلك و على هذا فما ينسب إليه على أنه مذهب له مثل ما ينسب إلى الإمام مالك أنه مذهب له و كثير من الأقوال لم يقلها و لا هي في موطئه و لا في الكتب المروية عنه و لهذا قال الدبوسي من الحنفية قال: إن الأقوال المنسوبة إلى الأئمة و الفقه المدون في الكتب ينبغي أن يراجع فما كان منه من اجتهاد المجتهدين أخذ به و ما كان من اجتهاد المقلدين رد عليهم فكيف يجتهدون و هم لا يدعون الاجتهاد. هذا كلام الدبوسي من أئمة الحنفية مع أنه مقلد.

t: Qatar Television Hosts the Sheikh on the Programme "Life of the Hearts"
a: تلفزيون قطر يستضيف الشيخ في برنامج حياة القلوب
b: qatar television hosted his eminence the erudite sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew yesterday, friday, on the programme "life of the hearts" at ten in the morning, on the subject: "the constituents of the contemporary islamic personality". the sheikh spoke on the subject "the constituents of the contemporary islamic personality", on the concept of constituents and on the human being's need to develop the three natural capacities: spirit, body and intellect. he explained that islam has set out for each kind of these capacities a mode of address that goes along and accords with the innate human disposition (fiṭrah) and that secures for him every benefit and every desire that profits him in this world and the next. his eminence also stressed that the constituents of the muslim personality are attained only by building four necessary stages: 1 — seeking knowledge; 2 — acting upon what one has learned; 3 — calling people to islam (daʿwah); 4 — patience upon the path of truth. these four constituents are the embodiment of the words of god most high in sūrat al-ʿaṣr: {by time. truly man is in loss, save those who believe and do righteous deeds, and enjoin one another to truth, and enjoin one another to patience.} (sūrat al-ʿaṣr 103:1–3). his eminence mentioned that the exemplary muslim personality is the one god — glorified and exalted is he — has made a model for humankind and commanded us to follow, and that it is embodied in the person of the prophet — may god bless him and grant him peace — in bearing and in method.
r: استضافت تلفزيون قطر أمس الجمعة فضيلة العلامة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو في برنامج "حياة القلوب" في الساعة العاشرة صباحا في موضوع: "مقومات الشخصية الإسلامية المعاصرة". وقد تحدث الشيخ في موضوع: "مقومات الشخصية الإسلامية المعاصرة" عن مفهوم المقومات وحاجة الإنسان إلى تنمية القدرات الطبيعية الثلاث: الروح والجسم والعقل، وبين أن الإسلام رتب لكل نوع من هذه القدرات خطابا يتماشا وينسجم مع فطرة الإنسان ويحقق له كل المصالح والرغبات النافعة له دنيا وأخرى. كما ركز فضيلته على أن مقومات الشخصية المسلمة لا ينالها الإنسان إلا ببناء مراحل أربعة ضرورية: 1- طلب العلم. 2 - العمل بما تعلمه. 3 - الدعوة. 4 - الصبر على طريق الحق. وهذه المقومات الأربع هي مصداق لقول الله تعالى في سورة العصر: " وَالْعَصْرِ (1) إِنَّ الإِنسَانَ لَفِي خُسْرٍ (2) إِلاَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ (3). وذكر فضيلته أن الشخصية المسلمة النموذجية هي التي جعلها الله سبحانه وتعالى قدوة للبشر وأمرنا باتباعها؛ وهي المتمثلة في شخص النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم سمتا ومنهجا.

t: His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan on Al Jazeera Mubasher
a: فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن في قناة الجزيرة مباشر
b: al jazeera satellite channel hosted his eminence the erudite sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew yesterday, friday, at six in the evening, on the programme "live with", on a subject concerning "the role of the scholars in confronting strife". his eminence brought out the effective role and the grave responsibility that the scholars bear towards what is taking place in the muslim world of sectarian and political strife (fitan). his eminence affirmed that the scholars are the heirs of the prophets and god's successors on earth; that they are obliged to discharge their duty and to let no reproacher's reproach deter them where god is concerned; that they should aid the wronged, restrain the hand of the wrongdoer, and stand in the face of every first spark of strife. he explained — may god preserve him — that conveying islam is an obligation (farīḍah), and that this is the role entrusted to the scholars first and foremost, part of which is to make its tolerance and its balance plain to people. we note that the programme was interspersed with calls putting questions to the sheikh and adding contributions, most of which the sheikh answered fully, while time ran short for some of them.
r: استضافت قناة الجزيرة الفضائية أمس الجمعة في الساعة السادسة مساءا فضيلة العلامة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو في برنامج "مباشر مع" في موضوع حول: "دور العلماء في مواجهة الفتن". وقد أبرز فضيلة العلامة ما للعلماء من دور فعال ومسؤولية جسيمة اتجاه ما يحدث في العالم الإسلامي من الفتن الطائفية والسياسية. وأكد فضيلته على أن العلماء هم ورثة الأنبياء، وخلفاء الله في الأرض، يجب عليهم أن يقوموا بواجبهم، ولا تأخذهم في الله لومة لائم؛ ينصروا المظلوم، ويأخذوا على يد الظالم، ويقفوا في وجه كل شرارة بادئة للفتن. وبين – حفظه الله- أن تبليغ الإسلام فريضة، وهو الدور المنوط بالعلماء أساسا، ومن ذلك تبين سماحته ووسطيته للناس. ونشير إلى أن البرنامج تخللته اتصالات؛ تطرح أسئلة على الشيخ وتضيف مداخلات، رد الشيخ على معظمها ردودا وافية، وضاق الوقت عن بعضها.

t: The Sharia Sciences Series — Tape Nine
a: سلسلة العلوم الشرعية -الشريط التاسع
b: the book tabaqat al-hanabilah by abu ya'la, and its continuation (dhayl) by his son, and likewise its continuation by ibn al-jawzi. among the later scholars, the book al-suhub al-wabilah 'ala bara'ih al-hanabilah — this one is devoted to dates of death and the like. then there are the works of biographical classes (ṭabaqāt) devoted to some other science, such as the classes of the qur'an reciters: a number of books have been written on it. the ḥāfiẓ al-dhahabi wrote his book tabaqat al-qurra' al-kibar; al-dawudi wrote the book tabaqat al-mufassirin, and al-suyuti likewise tabaqat al-mufassirin. al-suyuti abridged al-dhahabi's tadhkirat al-huffaz in his book tabaqat al-huffaz on hadith, and it is no more than an abridgement of al-dhahabi's book — though a number of continuations have been placed upon al-dhahabi's book, such as the book of ibn al-najjar, then the book of al-suyuti, in which he gave an entry for himself and for a number of his contemporaries.
r: كتاب "طبقات الحنابلة" لأبي يعلى وذيله لابنه ، وذيله كذلك لابن الجوزي ، ومن المتأخرين كتاب "السحب الوابلة على برائح الحنابلة" وهذا مختص بالوفيات ونحو ذلك. ثم الطبقات المختصة بعلم آخر كطبقات القراء ، فقد ألف فيه عدد من الكتب ، قد ألف الحافظ الذهبي كتابه "طبقات القراء الكبار" ، وألف الداودي كتاب "طبقات المفسرين" ، والسيوطي كذلك "طبقات المفسرين" ، والسيوطي قد اختصر تذكرة الحفاظ للذهبي في كتابه "طبقات الحفاظ" في الحديث ، وهو مجرد اختصار لكتاب الذهبي ، وإن كان قد وضع على كتاب الذهبي عدد من "الذيول" ككتاب ابن النجار ثم كتاب السيوطي الذي ترجم فيه لنفسه ، ولعدد من معاصريه.

t: The Sharia Sciences Series — Tape Three
a: سلسلة العلوم الشرعية -الشريط الثالث
b: among contemporaries who have followed this sequential method is al-maraghi — may god have mercy on him — for in his exegesis (tafsīr) he brought it in a scholastic, methodical fashion: he gives the passage, then after it gives the explanation of the individual words and the occasions of revelation (asbāb al-nuzūl), then gives the overall sense and what is derived from the verses. al-sabuni followed part of it likewise, except that al-sabuni intended to abridge earlier books, and for that reason his expressions are not contemporary expressions but expressions transmitted from those who went before. his books are therefore abridgements of the words of the earlier scholars: he omits much of what does not suit the present time, or what contains prolixity or length, and abridges the cream of what is intended from the exegesis he wishes to abridge. as for the exegesis of shaykh sa'id hawwa — may god have mercy on him — the one called al-asas fi al-tafsir, there is no doubt that the shaykh's style in it is distinctive and clear; but he concentrated on the side of spiritual effect in the qur'an and the nurture it contains, and for this reason it may be that it is not reckoned a complete exegesis in every respect, but rather concentrates on the parables of the qur'an, its admonitions, its tender passages and the like.
r: ومن الذين سلكوا هذا المنهج الترتيبي من المعاصرين المراغي رحمه الله فإنه بتفسيره أتى به على طريقة مدرسية منهجية فيذكر المقطع ثم يذكر بعده تفسير المفردات وأسباب النزول ثم يذكر المعنى الإجمالي وما يستنبط من الآيات، وكذلك سلك بعضه الصابوني، إلا أن الصابوني أراد تلخيص كتب سابقة فلذلك عباراته ليست عبارات معاصرة إنما هي عبارات منقولة عن من سبق ولذلك كتبه تلخيصات لكلام السابقين ويحذف كثيرا مما لا يتناسب مع هذا الوقت أو مما فيه إسهاب أو تطويل ويلخص زبدة المقصود من التفسير الذي يريد تلخيصه، أما تفسير الشيخ سعيد حوى رحمه الله المسمى بالأساس في التفسير فلا شك أن أسلوب الشيخ فيه متميز بين لكنه ركز على جهة التأثير الروحي في القرآن والتربية فيه وبهذا فيمكن أن لا يعد تفسيرا كاملا من كل الأوجه وإنما يركز على أمثال القرآن ومواعظه ورقائقه ونحو هذا.

t: The Sharia Sciences Series — Tape Six
a: سلسلة العلوم الشرعية -الشريط السادس
b: al-tirmidhi left no chapter of the chapters of knowledge without bringing it into his book — unlike the sunan of abu dawud, for example, in which you will find neither the chapters on merits, nor the biographies, nor the virtues of the qur'an, nor anything else of what al-tirmidhi mentioned in his book. this book of al-tirmidhi is found today only through the transmission of ibn mahbub, and through no other. the second aspect: that it is an extraction (mustakhraj) made upon the two ṣaḥīḥs. so when he finds the prophetic report (ḥadīth) by a route other than that of the two shaykhs, or [cites] it by a route other than theirs, he then says afterwards: "and in this chapter there is [a report] from so-and-so and so-and-so among the companions"; and for the most part he does not bring the well-known report that is in the two ṣaḥīḥs. for example, if the report is found in the two ṣaḥīḥs by the transmission of abu hurayrah, and al-tirmidhi finds it by the transmission of anas, he brings it by anas's transmission, then says "and in this chapter from abu hurayrah", alluding to the well-known report.
r: فلم يترك الترمذي بابا من أبواب العلم إلا وأورده في كتابه بخلاف سنن أبي داود مثلا فلا تجد فيه المناقب ولا السير ولا فضائل القرآن ولا غير ذلك مما ذكره الترمذي في كتابه، وكتاب الترمذي هذا لا يوجد اليوم إلا من رواية ابن محبوب فقط. الوجه الثاني : أنه مستخرج على الصحيحين فالحديث إذا وجده من غير طريق الشيخين أو رده من غير طريقهما ، ثم يقول بعد ذلك وفي الباب عن فلان وفلان من الصحابة ، ولا يورد الحديث المشهور الذي في الصحيحين في الغالب ، مثلا إذا كان الحديث يوجد في الصحيحين من رواية أبي هريرة ووجده الترمذي من رواية أنس فيأتي به من رواية أنس ثم يقول وفي الباب عن أبي هريرة ، يلمح إلى الحديث المشهور.

t: The Sharia Sciences Series — Tape Two
a: سلسلة العلوم الشرعية -الشريط الثاني
b: in the name of god, the all-merciful, the mercy-giving. we begin, then, with what god began with, so we begin with the book of god — glorified and exalted is he. many of the islamic sciences attach to the book of god, the most important of them being: the science of memorising it and of rendering it aloud (adāʾ), then the science of its exegesis (tafsīr), then the qur'anic sciences, then after that the science of the canonical readings (qirāʾāt), to which is added the science of its orthography and its vocalisation. so let us begin with the memorisation of the qur'an. there is no doubt that one who has the qur'an memorised needs numerous skills for that; and as for these skills, the islamic experience in them is enough to spare a person many of the errors into which many of the earlier teachers of qur'an memorisation fell. those who supervise qur'an memorisation circles, or who undertake the teaching of boys and the hearing of their memorisation, have a great fund of the muslim world's experience in this matter; and many of these experiences have become an object of mockery and ridicule among people, for many authors have written on the amusing anecdotes of the qur'an memorisation teachers and the jokes made at their expense. they relate that a man saw in his sleep that he was chewing pebbles, so he came to ibn sirin and asked him about it, and he said: you will be a teacher of boys..
r: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم نبدأ إذن بما بدأ الله به فنبدأ بكتاب الله سبحانه وتعالى، وكتاب الله يتعلق به كثير من العلوم الإسلامية، من أهمها : علم حفظه وأدائه ثم علم تفسيره ثم علوم القرآن ثم بعد ذلك علم القراءات ويضاف إليها علم الرسم والضبط، فلنبدأ بحفظ القرآن: لا شك أن الذي يُحَفظُ القرآن يحتاج إلى مهارات عديدة لذلك، وهذه المهارات التجربة الإسلامية فيها كفيلة بأن تجنب الإنسان كثيرا من الأخطاء التي وقع فيها كثير من محفظي القرآن السابقين، الذين يشرفون على حلقات تحفيظ القرآن أو يباشرون تدريس الصبيان وتحفيظهم لهم رصيد كبير من تجارب العالم الإسلامي في هذا الباب، وهذه التجارب كثير منها أصبح محل هزء وسخرية لدى الناس فقد ألف كثير من المؤلفين فيما يتعلق بطرائف محفظي القرآن والتنكيت عليهم، فيذكرون أن رجلا رأى في النوم أنه يمضغ الحصى فأتى ابن سيرين فسأله عن ذلك فقال تكون معلما للصبيان..

t: The Sharia Sciences Series — Tape Four
a: سلسلة العلوم الشرعية -الشريط الرابع
b: in the name of god, the all-merciful, the mercy-giving. question 1: the difficulty that arises when a person memorises al-shatibiyyah and al-durrah, in the confusion between alif, bāʾ, jīm, dāl and the like of the shared symbols — how does a person rid himself of it? the answer: he rids himself of it only by mastering the memorisation of the two poems — that he memorise each of the two with a firm memorisation, such that the one is not confused for him with the other; because confusion arises only where the memorisation has not been mastered. if you have memorised this one and memorised that one and your memorisation is not firm, they run into one another for you and become confused. for that reason, with many of those who memorise al-shatibiyyah and al-durrah today, if you test one of them by surprise and ask him about a line — whether it is from al-shatibiyyah or from al-durrah — the matter becomes confused for them; and this is what leads to falling into an error of this kind. it is possible to be rid of that, also, by mastering the reading itself: whoever has mastered the seven readings, or one of them, knows what belongs to al-durrah as against what belongs to al-shatibiyyah..
r: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم السؤال 1 : الاستشكال الذي يحصل عندما يحفظ الإنسان الشاطبية والدرة في الالتباس بالألف والباء والجيم والدال ونحو ذلك من الرموز المشتركة كيف يتخلص منه الإنسان ؟ الجواب : إنما يتخلص منه بإتقان حفظ القصيدتين ، أن يحفظ كل واحدة منهما حفظا محكما بحيث لا تلتبس عليه بالأخرى ، لأن الالتباس إنما يقع عند عدم إتقان الحفظ ، إذا حفظت هذه وحفظت هذه وكان حفظك غير محكم تتداخل عليك وتلتبس ، ولذلك كثير من الذين يحفظون الشاطبية والدرة اليوم إذا امتحنت أحدهم بالمفاجأة فسألته عن بيت هل هو من الشاطبية أو من الدرة التبس عليهم الأمر ، وهذا الذي يقتضي الوقوع في خطئ مثل هذا ، ويمكن التخلص من ذلك أيضا بإتقان القراءة نفسها فمن كان متقنا للسبع أو لإحداها عرف ما كان من الدرة مما كان من الشاطبية ..

t: The Sharia Sciences Series — Tape Five
a: سلسلة العلوم الشرعية -الشريط الخامس
b:
*create anew; complete; expound; and for your abridging — collect, arrange, and set right, my brother, the flaw.*

his words "create anew": this is the first of the aims of authorship, that a person bring something new to which no one has gone before him. and "new" is relative, because it is possible that someone has touched upon it in one place or another, or spoken about it somewhere; but that opened a wide door before you, or gave you threads by which you could reach something beyond it. so origination is always relative. for this reason you find many of the people of knowledge saying, of what god has favoured them with of divine openings, they say: "and i have not been preceded to the like of this". ibn al-'arabi — may god have mercy on him — says, when he brings up one of the rare juristic questions or one of the questions of legal theory (uṣūl), he says: "i say: this is a knowledge whose scent the malikis have not smelled, and it has not passed beyond balkh and khurasan" — because it is among the sciences of the easterners; it had not reached the maghrib at all, and he is the first to bring it there. he says: our colleagues have not smelled the scent of this question before me; it has not gone beyond balkh and khurasan..
r: *أبدع تمام بيان لاختصارك في ** جمع ورتب وأصلح يا أخي الخللا* فقوله "أبدع" هذا هو المقصد الأول من مقاصد التأليف أن يأتي الإنسان بجديد لم يسبق إليه، والجديد نسبي لأنه بالإمكان أن يكون قد تعرض له شخص في موضع من المواضع أو تكلم عليه في مكان ما ، لكن فتح أمامك أنت ذلك بابا واسعا ، أو أعطاك خيوطا يمكن أن تصل بها إلى غير هذا فالإبداع نسبي دائما ، ولهذا تجدون كثيرا من أهل العلم يقولون فيما من الله عليهم به من الفتوحات الربانية، يقولون ولم أسبق إلى مثل هذا ، يقول بن العربي رحمه الله عندما يورد مسألة من المسائل الفقهية النادرة أو الأصولية ، يقول: قلت وهذا علم ما شم المالكية رائحته، ولا تجاوز بلخ وخراسان لأنه من علوم المشارقة ما وصل إلى المغرب نهائيا ، هو أول من أوصله ، يقول ما شم أصحابنا رائحة هذه المسألة قبلي ، لم تتعد بلخ وخراسان ..

t: The Pilgrimage to the Sacred House of God
a: الحج إلى بيت الله الحرام
b: praise belongs to god. we praise him, we seek his help, and we take refuge in god from the evils of our own selves and from the ill of our deeds. whomever god guides, none can lead astray; and whomever he leads astray, none can guide. i bear witness that there is no god but god alone, who has no partner, and i bear witness that muhammad is his servant and his messenger — may god bless him, and his family and his companions, and grant them abundant peace. {o humankind, be mindful of your lord, who created you from a single soul and created from it its mate, and from the two of them spread abroad many men and women. be mindful of god, in whose name you make demands of one another, and of the ties of kinship. truly god is ever watchful over you. o you who believe, be mindful of god and speak words that hit the mark: he will set your deeds right for you and forgive you your sins. whoever obeys god and his messenger has won a great victory.} (sūrat al-nisāʾ 4:1; sūrat al-aḥzāb 33:70–71). to proceed: the best of speech is the book of god, and the best guidance is the guidance of muhammad — may god bless him and grant him peace. the worst of matters are those newly introduced, and every innovation in religion (bidʿah) is misguidance...
r: إن الحمد لله نحمده ونستعينه ونعوذ بالله من شرور أنفسنا ومن سيئات أعمالنا، من يهده الله فلا مضل له ومن يضلل فلا هادي له، وأشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له وأشهد أن محمدا عبده ورسوله صلى الله عليه وعلى آله وأصحابه وسلم تسليما كثيرا {يا أيها الناس اتقوا ربكم الذي خلقكم من نفس واحدة وخلق منها زوجها وبث منهما رجالا كثيرا ونساء واتقوا الله الذي تساءلون به والأرحام إن الله كان عليكم رقيبا، يا أيها الذين آمنوا اتقوا الله وقولوا قولا سديدا يصلح لكم أعمالكم ويغفر لكم ذنوبكم ومن يطع الله ورسوله فقد فاز فوزا عظيما}، أما بعد فإن خير الحديث كتاب الله وخير الهدي هدي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم وشر الأمور محدثاتها وكل بدعة ضلالة...

t: The Merit of the Last Ten Nights
a: فضل العشر الأواخر
b: in the name of god, the all-merciful, the mercy-giving. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds. i ask god's blessing and peace upon the one sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions and all who have taken guidance from his guidance and followed his practice until the day of judgement. peace be upon you, and god's mercy and his blessings. it is part of the wisdom of god — majestic is his majesty — that he has set within times and within places seasons of good, in which good deeds are multiplied and rewards are raised up. god has made the month of ramadan the best of the months of the year and has multiplied good deeds within it for the believers; and it is for that reason that the gates of paradise are opened in it, the gates of the fire are shut in it, and the rebellious devils are shackled in it, and it is said in it: "o seeker of good, come forward; o seeker of evil, hold back."
r: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته. من حكمة الله جل جلاله أن جعل في الأزمنة والأمكنة مواسم للخير يضاعف فيها الحسنات ويرفع فيها الأجور، وقد جعل الله شهر رمضان أفضل شهور السنة وضاعف فيه الحسنات للمؤمنين، ولذلك تفتح فيه أبواب الجنة وتوصد فيه أبواب النار وتصفد فيه مردة الشياطين، ويقال فيه: يا باغي الخير أقبل ويا باغي الشر أقصر.

t: The Causes of the Punishment of the Grave
a: أسباب عذاب القبر
b:
what is the best deed for deliverance from the punishment of the grave?

the punishment of the grave has causes that lead to it. among them is failing to shield oneself from urine and failing to keep clean of it; among them is going about with talebearing (namīmah); among them is lying; and other things besides, such as leaving off the payment of zakat. these sins are a cause of the punishment of the grave. so if a person avoids these sins, god — glorified and exalted is he — will deliver him, if he wills, from the punishment of the grave.
r: ما أفضل عمل للنجاة من عذاب القبر؟ أن عذاب القبر له أسباب تؤدي إليه منها عدم الاستتار من البول، وعدم النظافة منه ومنها المشي بالنميمة ومنها الكذب وغير ذلك كترك أداء الزكاة فهذه الذنوب سبب لعذاب القبر، فإذا كان الإنسان يجتنب هذه الذنوب فإن الله سبحانه وتعالى سينجيه إن شاء من عذاب القبر.

t: Responses to the Requests for Rulings Received by the Site
a: ردود على الاستفتاءات الواردة على الموقع
b:
## on shaving the beard

**what is the ruling on shaving the beard, and may one trim it while it is short?**

shaving the beard is among the things the messenger of god (peace and blessings be upon him) forbade, and he made known that trimming it with scissors and the like is not permitted, because it runs contrary to the letting-grow that the messenger of god (peace and blessings be upon him) commanded. but if the beard grows very long and spreads out and becomes thick, then a person — if he is on hajj or on the lesser pilgrimage (ʿumrah) and has come out of the consecrated state of his hajj or his ʿumrah, whether by casting the pebbles at the jamrat al-ʿaqabah on the day of eid or by finishing the running (saʿy) of the ʿumrah — may take it in two handfuls and cut off what goes beyond them. among the scholars are those who hold that if he takes one ample handful he has the right to cut off what goes beyond it; ibn umar and abu hurayrah used to do that.

## on the subject of visiting graves

**in the prophet's words (peace and blessings be upon him) on this there is a way of reconciling the cursing of women who frequent the graves with his granting of permission. what are the particulars of that??**

the answer is that women's visiting of graves is a matter of disagreement among the people of knowledge. some of the people of knowledge held it forbidden (ḥarām) without qualification, and adduced this report of the curse as their evidence. others held that this is abrogated (mansūkh), because abrogation is established with regard to visiting graves.. for the prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: «i had forbidden you to visit the graves; now visit them, and do not utter anything unseemly.» and he said: «i had forbidden you to visit the graves; now indeed visit them, for they remind you of the hereafter.» this abrogation is, in principle, explicit in removing every prohibition that preceded it, whether the earlier prohibition was specific to women or not; because the permission here — rather, the command — is directed to men and women together, since he said: «visit them, for they remind you of the hereafter». "visit them" is a command to all people, taking in men and women alike. this position — that of abrogation with respect to women — is the preponderant one, because the prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) taught aisha what to say when visiting graves; and had her visiting of graves been forbidden (ḥarām), he would not have taught her that.

## on what establishes the milk relationship

**a woman swore that she had breastfed me, and my parents denied it. what is the ruling on this?**

the people of knowledge have differed over what establishes the milk relationship (raḍāʿ), into four positions.

the hanafis held that the threshold of testimony in the milk relationship is like the threshold of testimony generally, in all matters, so that the testimony of two upright men, or of one upright man and two women, is required. they explained that god — glorified and exalted is he — set the threshold of testimony in the qur'an in that way, for he said: {and call two witnesses to witness from among your men; and if there are not two men, then one man and two women} (sūrat al-baqarah 2:282), and he said concerning divorce: {and call to witness two men of probity from among you, and establish the testimony for god} (sūrat al-ṭalāq 65:2). on this basis the threshold of testimony is always two upright men, or one man and two women.

the shafi'is held that the milk relationship is established by the testimony of four women who are qualified to testify, because it is a matter belonging to women and not to men, and in testimony two women stand in the place of each man.

the malikis held that the milk relationship is established by the testimony of two women of probity, because plurality is a condition in testimony but not in the transmission of reports; and this class of matter is proper to women, so that once plurality is achieved, enough has been achieved by it for the substance of the question to be established, this being among the matters that rest on probable evidence.

the hanbalis held that the milk relationship is established by the testimony of a single woman. the hanbalis adduced as evidence what al-bukhari brought out in the ṣaḥīḥ, and others besides him, from the report of uqbah ibn al-harith — may god be pleased with him — who said: i married umm yahya bint abi ihab ibn aziz, and a black woman came and said, "i breastfed uqbah and the woman he has married." i said: i did not know that, and you did not tell me. so i sent to the family of abu ihab to ask them, and they said: we did not know that. so i mounted my riding camel and came to the prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) in medina and asked him, and he said: «how can that be, when it has already been said?» and in one transmission: «part from her, for there is no good for you in her.» so i parted from her, and she married a man other than me.

the hanbalis adduce this report as evidence that the milk relationship is established by the testimony of a single woman, even if she is the nursing woman herself, and even if the infant's parents call her a liar; for the parents of abu ihab's daughter denied that that woman had breastfed her, and said: we did not know that. yet despite that, the prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) forbade him to continue in that marriage and said: part from her, for there is no good for you in her, and said: how can that be, when it has already been said?

the malikis, for their part, saw this report as evidence that the milk relationship is not established by the testimony of a single woman, because he said: part from her; and you know that parting is divorce, and divorce comes about only after a valid marriage contract, by the words of the prophet (peace and blessings be upon him): «a person has no divorce and no manumission in what he does not own.» this entails that the marriage was valid, because he said "part from her", the meaning of which is that the marriage that took place is recognised in law, so that a separation within it is needed, and that separation is divorce — which amounts to holding the contract valid. and it is well known that a woman who is forbidden in marriage cannot lawfully be contracted, and the contract is not valid in any respect whatever; so had the milk relationship been established, the marriage would not have been conceivable in the first place.

even so, the malikis took account of the disagreement and held it recommended (mandūb) to keep clear on the testimony of a single woman. this is with respect to marriage, that is, on the side of prohibition. as for the side of declaring lawful — that is, the spread of the marriage impediment, as when he shakes hands with this woman who has claimed that she breastfed him — then if his parents deny it, the prudent course is that he not shake hands with her, and that he not act upon this milk relationship in what concerns the affirmative side. as for the prohibitive side, which is the negative side, we have already mentioned the disagreement within it; as for the affirmative side, he is not to act upon this milk relationship.

a single person may have two aspects to him. for when sa'd ibn abi waqqas and abd ibn zam'ah brought a dispute before the prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) over a boy — abd saying that he was a son to his father, born upon his bed from his slave woman, and sa'd ibn abi waqqas saying that his brother utbah ibn abi waqqas had charged him that the boy was his son — the prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) adjudged him to abd ibn zam'ah and said: «the child belongs to the bed, and for the fornicator is the stone.» yet despite that he commanded sawdah bint zam'ah — and she is a mother of the believers — to veil herself from him. the meaning of this is that he took account of both aspects: in view of his resemblance to utbah ibn abi waqqas, he having been utbah's son through fornication, the prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) commanded sawdah to veil herself from him; and in view of his having been born upon the other man's bed, the other man not having disowned him, he being the son of his slave woman upon his bed, lineage follows that — and for that reason he adjudged him to abd ibn zam'ah, and commanded sawdah to veil herself from him.

## the ruling on shaving customers' beards

**is it permissible to shave customers' beards? many customers shave their beard along with their head, and if i refuse to do it for him i lose the trade.**

it appears that the questioner is one of those who practise the barber's trade, so he is not asking about shaving his own beard but about occupying himself with shaving the beards of others. the answer is that occupying oneself with that is part of cooperating in sin and transgression, so it is not lawful to occupy oneself with it. god most high has said: {and cooperate in righteousness and god-consciousness (taqwā), and do not cooperate in sin and transgression} (sūrat al-māʾidah 5:2).

a person must know that god is the provider, the possessor of strength, the firm; that provision is in god's hand and has already been written; that the pens have been lifted and the pages have dried upon what is to be. god — glorified and exalted is he — sends an angel to the foetus while it is in its mother's womb, as the prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) explained, and he is commanded with four words: to write its provision, its appointed term, its deeds, and whether it is wretched or happy. for that reason a person ought to know that provision has been written and neither increases nor decreases, and that he must be moderate in the seeking of it, as the prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: «god has written for every soul its provision, so be mindful of god and be moderate in seeking.» and in the other report: «the holy spirit breathed into my heart that no soul will die until it has completed its provision, so be mindful of god and be moderate in seeking.» part of moderation in seeking is that it be from what is lawful; seeking provision from what is forbidden (ḥarām) is no part of moderation in seeking. for what is with god is not to be sought by means of the forbidden — what is with god is not sought by disobeying him.

## the ruling on being alone together in a car

**is it permissible for a woman to ride alone with the owner of the car, in the middle of the city for instance?**

if she rides in the back and is not immediately beside the owner of the car, and this is at a time when the streets are crowded — that is, there are people in them — then this is not a case of seclusion (khalwah), so long as no ground for suspicion arises. but if this is at suspect times, such as in the dark, or when the streets are empty of people, or she is in the seat next to him such that their limbs may easily touch, then this is forbidden (ḥarām), because the prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) warned against the breaths of men coming close to the breaths of women.

## the ruling on a woman who acknowledged having breastfed a little girl and then denied it

**a woman had a small daughter; she went out and left her with another woman, and when she came back the woman told her that she had breastfed the girl. she became angry with her, so she then denied that she had breastfed her. is her first statement to be relied upon, or her second, given that there is no witness?**

when a witness retracts his testimony, it becomes void (bāṭil). so if the woman has retracted her statement and there is no witness besides her, then no weight attaches to it, and her first statement alone, which she has retracted, does not establish it.

## some rulings on offering condolences

**does the presence of the deceased's family in their house count as sitting to receive condolences, or not? and is that for three days, or not?**

gathering at the house of the deceased's family was counted as ritual wailing in the time of the companions, may god be pleased with them. what is meant by that is gathering in assemblies where people come together for food and for talk, so that the clamour in them grows great and the deceased's family are put to heavy expense. this sort is part of the wailing that the prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) forbade, and from whose practitioners he declared himself free.

as for gathering at their house to offer condolences — as when a delegation of people comes to them to offer condolences, or a person comes to them to offer condolences and a number of people gather at their house — this is not among what the law forbids; but they are not to eat, nor to drink, nor to gather for the repetition of much talk, for that is what is counted as wailing. their sitting in order to offer condolences is part of cooperating in righteousness and god-consciousness, for god — glorified and exalted is he — has prescribed for us that we cooperate in righteousness and god-consciousness. offering condolences is among the things that bind the ties of kinship and increase love, and it means urging the bereaved to patient endurance.
