r: غرق الكثير من المسلمين اليوم في محيط الغفلات المتلاطم، فضيعوا الواجبات، واجترءوا على المحرمات، ونسوا الله والدار الآخرة، ولم ينج من الغرق إلا من ركب قوارب النجاة التي تصنعها الخشية من الله ومراقبته وذكره، فالخائف من الله قوي الإيمان في كل مواجهة مع الشيطان، وثيق الصلة بربه الكريم الرحمن، لا تلقاه إلا حيث أراد الله، لأنه موقن أن الله معه يسمعه ويراه، ومن كان هذا حاله فإن الله في الدنيا مولاه، والجنة في الآخرة مأواه. خشية الله ناتجة عن العلم به: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين، وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين، السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته. أما بعد: فإن من قيم الإيمان التي ينبغي أن يتحلى بها كل مؤمن: خشية الله سبحانه وتعالى، فهو أهل للخشية، ومن حقوقه على عباده أن يخافوه وأن لا يشركوا به شيئاً، وذلك مقتض لتمام معرفته، فمن عرف الله تعالى خافه، وقد بين الله سبحانه وتعالى سر هذه الخشية، فربطه بالعلم، فقال تعالى: إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى اللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْعُلَمَاءُ. [فاطر:28]...

t: Maintaining the Ties of Kinship
a: صلة الأرحام
b:
*[site synopsis]* god, glorified is he, prescribed for his servants the ordinances of the religion, and his messenger — may god bless him and grant him peace — confirmed them and made them plain. among these ordinances is the maintaining of the ties of kinship. whoever maintains them and discharges their due, god maintains his bond with him and is pleased with him, and this is a cause of his lifespan being lengthened and his provision blessed; and whoever severs them and neglects their due, god severs him, and severs his progeny and his provision.

## the evidence indicating kindness to close relatives and the maintaining of the ties of kinship

in the name of god, the all-merciful, the mercy-giving. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds. i ask god's blessing and peace upon the one sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions, and upon all who have taken guidance from his guidance and followed his practice until the day of judgement. to proceed:

god, glorified and exalted is he, prescribed for his servants the ordinances of the religion, and his messenger — may god bless him and grant him peace — confirmed them and made them plain; and he bound his servants to follow them and urged them to take them up, both positively and negatively — positively, by encouragement to follow them; negatively, by warning against departing from them. among these ordinances which god prescribed for his servants and was pleased with for them is the ordinance of maintaining the ties of kinship. it is a mighty ordinance, of great standing in this religion which the messenger — may god bless him and grant him peace — brought from god most high..
r: شرع الله سبحانه لعبادة شرائع الدين، وأكدها وبينها رسوله صلى الله عليه وسلم، ومن هذه الشرائع صلة الأرحام، فمن وصلها وأدى حقها وصله الله ورضي عنه، وكان ذلك سبباً في زيادة عمره وبركة رزقه، ومن قطعها وأهمل حقها قطعه الله، وقطع نسله ورزقه. الأدلة الدالة على الإحسان إلى ذوي القربى وصلة الرحم: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين، وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه، واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين. أما بعد: فإن الله سبحانه وتعالى شرع لعباده شرائع الدين، وأكدها وبينها رسوله صلى الله عليه وسلم، وألزم عباده باتباعها، وحظهم على الأخذ بها إيجاباً وسلباً، فالإيجاب بالترغيب في اتباعها، والسلب في الترهيب من مخالفتها، ومن هذه الشرائع التي شرعها الله لعباده وارتضاها لهم: شريعة صلة الأرحام، إنها شريعة عظيمة، ذات مكانة عظيمة في هذا الدين الذي جاء به الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم من عند الله تعالى..

t: The Opportunity of a Lifetime
a: فرصة العمر
b:
*[site synopsis]* a person in this world is commanded to use his life in obedience to god, mighty and majestic, and is commanded not to squander his lifetime in what has no point to it. the lifetime is an opportunity that cannot be replaced; and once it has run out and gone, whoever did not use it in obedience to god, mighty and majestic, will regret it at a time when regret is of no use. so fear god, fear god, in seizing the moments, in filling them with good deeds, and in keeping far from the people of debauchery and of evil deeds.

## the human being's personal lifetime, and how to use it in obedience

praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds. i ask god's blessing and peace upon the one sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions, and upon all who have taken guidance from his guidance and followed his practice until the day of judgement. to proceed:

god, glorified and exalted is he, has appointed for the human being two lives. one of them is this abode, which is an abode of work and of no recompense; the other is the abode of the hereafter, which is an abode of recompense and of no work. and he made the human being begin with this worldly abode — whose name, al-dunyā, is derived either from nearness (dunuww), because of its closeness, or from baseness (danāʾah), because it does not weigh with god as much as the wing of a gnat..
r: الإنسان في هذه الدنيا مأمور باستغلال حياته في طاعة الله عز وجل، ومأمور بأن لا يضيع عمره فيما لا طائل تحته، فالعمر فرصة لا تعوض، فإذا ما انقضت وذهبت ندم من لم يستغلها في طاعة الله عز وجل حين لا ينفع الندم. فاللهَ اللهَ في اغتنام الأوقات، وإعمارها بالحسنات، ومباعدة أهل الفجور والسيئات. العمر الشخصي للإنسان وكيفية استغلاله في الطاعة: الحمد لله رب العالمين، وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه، ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين، أما بعد: فإن الله سبحانه وتعالى جعل للإنسان حياتين: إحداهما هي هذه الدار التي هي دار عمل ولا جزاء، والأخرى هي دار الآخرة التي هي دار جزاء ولا عمل. وجعل الإنسان يبدأ بهذه الدار الدنيا التي اسمها إما أن يكون مشتقاً من الدنو لقربها، أو مشتقاً من الدناءة؛ لأنها لا تساوي عند الله جناح بعوضة..

t: The Proprieties of Seeking Knowledge
a: آداب طلب العلم
b:
*[site synopsis]* the specialisms of the islamic sciences with which scholars have occupied themselves are many. whoever has learned them, has reached a middling degree of grasp of them, and is able to teach each one of these sciences — he is "the scholar". whoever has specialised in some of them does not merit this title; he merits only to be counted among the bearers of knowledge, and among those who specialise in some of its aspects and not others. students of knowledge must give this knowledge its due of concern and attention, must be keen upon its proprieties, its means and its conditions, and must be conscious of its merit and its distinction.

## knowledge and the proprieties

in the name of god, the all-merciful, the mercy-giving. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds. i ask god's blessing and peace upon the one sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions, and upon all who have taken guidance from his guidance in the seeking of knowledge. and now: the elements i shall speak about in this lesson are:

the first element: the merit of knowledge and of its people.
the second element: the reward for seeking knowledge and for teaching it.
the third element: scholarly books and their merit.
the fourth element: the conditions of seeking knowledge.
the fifth element: the means of acquiring knowledge.
the sixth element: the kinds of the sciences.

......
r: تخصصات العلوم الإسلامية التي اشتغل بها العلماء كثيرة، ومن تعلمها، فوصل إلى حد متوسط من إدراكها، واستطاع تدريس كل واحد من هذه العلوم فهو (العالم)، ومن تخصص في بعضها لم يستحق هذا اللقب، وإنما يستحق أن يدرج في حملة العلم والمتخصصين في بعض جوانبه دون بعض. وعلى طلاب العلم أن يعطوا هذا العلم حقه من الاهتمام والعناية، وأن يحرصوا على آدابه ووسائله وشروطه، وأن يستشعروا فضله ومزيته. العلم والآداب: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين، وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه لطلب العلم، وبعد: العناصر التي سأتحدث عنها في هذا الدرس هي: العنصر الأول: فضل العلم وأهله. العنصر الثاني: أجر طلب العلم وتعليمه. العنصر الثالث: الكتب العلمية وفضلها. العنصر الرابع: شروط طلب العلم. العنصر الخامس: وسائل تحصيل العلم. العنصر السادس: أنواع العلوم. ......

t: The First God-Devoted Generation (al-jīl al-rabbānī)
a: الجيل الرباني الأول
b:
*[site synopsis]* god conferred a favour upon humankind in sending muhammad, god bless him and grant him peace, and through him brought humankind out of the darknesses into the light. he, god bless him and grant him peace, undertook the formation of his companions — a formation that made them fit to serve the religion, to carry its burdens, to meet its demands and to cooperate in supporting it. today we live the estrangement of islam at the end of time, so every muslim among us ought to support islam and to stand by the righteous so far as he is able, in the hope that god will join us to the first god-devoted generation.

## god's rescue of the community through islam after the age of ignorance

praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds. i ask god's blessing and peace upon the one sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions, and upon all who have taken guidance from his guidance and followed his practice until the day of judgement. to proceed: god, glorified and exalted is he, sealed the nations with this honoured and mighty community, which he made the best community brought forth for mankind, and which he ennobled with every kind of ennoblement. he sent to it the best of the messengers, sent down upon it the best of the books, and laid down for it the best of the revealed codes of the religion. and god, glorified and exalted is he, has made the people of this community witnesses over mankind, upright in their testimony, for he, exalted is he, said: {and thus we made you a middle community, that you may be witnesses over mankind and that the messenger may be a witness over you} (sūrat al-baqarah 2:143) …
r:
لقد امتن الله على البشرية ببعثة محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، فأخرجها به من الظلمات إلى النور، وقد قام صلى الله عليه وسلم بتربية أصحابه تربية تؤهلهم لخدمة الدين والقيام بأعبائه، وتحقيق مطالبه والتعاون على نصرته، ونحن اليوم نعيش غربة الإسلام آخر الزمان، فينبغي على كل مسلم منا أن ينصر الإسلام، ويؤازر الصالحين بقدر إمكانه، لعل الله يلحقنا بالجيل الرباني الأول.
إغاثة الله للأمة بالإسلام بعد الجاهلية:
الحمد لله رب العالمين، وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه، ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين أما بعد: فإن الله سبحانه وتعالى ختم الأمم بهذه الأمة المشرفة العظيمة التي جعلها خير أمة أخرجت للناس، وشرفها بأنواع التشريف، فأرسل إليها أفضل الرسل، وأنزل عليها أفضل الكتب، وشرع لها خير شرائع الدين. وقد جعل الله سبحانه وتعالى أهل هذه الأمة شهوداً على الناس عدولاً، فقال تعالى: وَكَذَلِكَ جَعَلْنَاكُمْ أُمَّةً وَسَطًا لِتَكُونُوا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَيَكُونَ الرَّسُولُ عَلَيْكُمْ شَهِيدًا.[البقرة:143] ...

t: Wisdom in Calling People to Islam [1]
a: الحكمة في الدعوة [ 1 ]
b:
*[site synopsis]* calling people to god, glorified and exalted is he (daʿwah), is held to be the first support in making the pillars of the islamic religion firm. for this reason god commanded the prophets and their followers to undertake it, since it was by their calling that the religions were established and the affirmation of god's oneness spread through the lands. the people of knowledge have discussed the various calls and the different classes of people in their reception of them, and the ways of the call and the wisdom to be used in it — whether that wisdom concerns the persons addressed, or the hours, or the seasons suited to it. for the call was laid down for no purpose other than to establish the religion and to change the wrong standing among people, with wisdom and deliberation, and by putting matters in their proper places.

## reminding people of god and calling them to him is a religious necessity

in the name of god, the all-merciful, the mercy-giving. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds. i ask god's blessing and peace upon the one whom his lord sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions, and upon all who have taken guidance from his guidance and followed his practice until the day of judgement. to proceed: god, mighty and majestic, has described himself as calling, for he, glorified and exalted is he, said in the clear text of his book: {and god calls to the abode of peace, and he guides whom he wills to a straight path} (sūrat yūnus 10:25). and he, exalted is he, said: {those call to the fire, and god calls to the garden and to forgiveness by his leave} (sūrat al-baqarah 2:221). and he described his messenger, god bless him and grant him peace, in the same terms, in his words, exalted is he: {and as one calling to god by his leave, and as an illuminating lamp} (sūrat al-aḥzāb 33:46) …
r:
تعتبر الدعوة إلى الله سبحانه وتعالى الركيزة الأولى في تثبيت دعائم الدين الإسلامي، لذا أمر الله بها الأنبياء وأتباعهم؛ إذ بدعوتهم قامت الأديان وانتشر توحيد الله في البلدان. وقد تحدث أهل العلم عن الدعوات واستقبال الناس لها على أصنافهم، وعن سبل الدعوة والحكمة فيها، سواءٌ أكانت تلك الحكمة تجاه الأشخاص أم الأوقات أم الأزمان المناسبة لها؛ فإنها ما شرعت إلا لإقامة الدين وتغيير المنكر القائم بين الناس بحكمة وروية، ووضع للأمور في مواضعها.
التذكير بالله والدعوة إليه ضرورة دينية:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين، وأصلي وأسلم على من بعثه ربه رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه، ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين. أما بعد: فإن الله عز وجل قد وصف نفسه بالدعوة، فقال سبحانه وتعالى في محكم كتابه: وَاللَّهُ يَدْعُوا إِلَى دَارِ السَّلامِ وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ [يونس:25] ، وقال تعالى: أُوْلَئِكَ يَدْعُونَ إِلَى النَّارِ وَاللَّهُ يَدْعُو إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَالْمَغْفِرَةِ بِإِذْنِهِ [البقرة:221] . ووصف رسوله صلى الله عليه وسلم بذلك في قوله تعالى: وَدَاعِيًا إِلَى اللَّهِ بِإِذْنِهِ وَسِرَاجًا مُنِيرًا. [الأحزاب:46]...

t: Wisdom in Calling People to Islam [2]
a: الحكمة في الدعوة [2]
b:
*[site synopsis]* the default in calling people to god, exalted is he, is that it be done with wisdom and fair exhortation, and by disputing in the way that is best. this manner is required in dealing with those who reject faith, let alone with believers who disobey. this is not in conflict with fighting those who associate partners with god, nor with carrying out the prescribed penalties upon the transgressors: each has its own place. and part of wisdom in calling people to god, exalted is he, is the practical application of every matter of the religion, for by it the circle is completed and the gap between knowledge and action is closed.

## how to call non-muslims with wisdom

in the name of god, the all-merciful, the mercy-giving. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds. i ask god's blessing and peace upon the one whom his lord sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions, and upon all who have taken guidance from his guidance and followed his practice until the day of judgement. to proceed: we have already spoken about the concept of calling people to god, its characteristics, its distinguishing features, its foundations and its governing limits. we shall now speak — by god's power — about some of the means of calling people to god, as in his words, exalted is he, in sūrat al-naḥl: {call to the way of your lord with wisdom and fair exhortation, and dispute with them in the way that is best. your lord is he who knows best who has strayed from his way, and he knows best those who are guided} (sūrat al-naḥl 16:125). let us take from this verse a lamp by which to be guided to what we say; and god is the one who grants success in word and in deed …
r:
إن الأصل في الدعوة إلى الله تعالى أن تكون بالحكمة والموعظة الحسنة، والجدال بالتي هي أحسن، وهذا الأسلوب مطلوب في حق الكافرين فضلاً عن عصاة المؤمنين، ولا يعارض هذا قتال المشركين، أو إقامة الحدود على الفاسقين، فكل له موطنه. ومن الحكمة في الدعوة إلى الله تعالى التطبيق العملي لكل أمور الدين؛ إذ به تكتمل الدائرة، ويسد الفراغ بين العلم والعمل.
كيفية دعوة غير المسلمين بالحكمة:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين، وأصلي وأسلم على من بعثه ربه رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه، ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين. أما بعد: فقد سبق أن تحدثنا عن مفهوم الدعوة إلى الله خصائصها ومميزاتها وأسسها وضوابطها وسنتحدث -بحول الله- عن بعض وسائل الدعوة إلى الله، كما في قوله تعالى في سورة النحل: ادْعُ إِلَى سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَالْمَوْعِظَةِ الْحَسَنَةِ وَجَادِلْهُمْ بِالَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ ضَلَّ عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ [النحل:125] ، فلنأخذ من هذه الآية نبراساً نهتدي به إلى ما نقول، والله الموفق في القول والعمل...

t: The Danger of Trading in the Word of Truth
a: خطورة المتاجرة بكلمة الحق
b:
*[site synopsis]* when faith penetrates deep into hearts, no human power can stand before it. here are pharaoh's magicians: once faith had mingled with the innermost of their hearts, they did not fear pharaoh's threat of killing and crucifixion, but said instead, "decree what you will decree; you decree only for this worldly life." so the scholars and those who call people to god must strive to increase faith and to strengthen it, so that by it they may meet the pressures of the tyrants and the despots, and must speak the word of truth and not fear, where god is concerned, the reproach of anyone who reproaches.

## the necessity of knowing god's blessings upon us

praise belongs to god. we praise him and seek his help. we take refuge with god from the evils of our own selves and from the ill of our deeds. whomever god guides, none can lead astray; whomever he leads astray, none can guide. i bear witness that there is no god but god alone, who has no partner, and i bear witness that muhammad is his servant and his messenger — god bless him, and his family and his companions, and grant them abundant peace. {o mankind, be mindful of your lord, who created you from a single soul and created from it its mate, and from the two of them spread abroad many men and women. and be mindful of god, in whose name you ask of one another, and of the ties of kinship. god is ever watchful over you} (sūrat al-nisāʾ 4:1). {o you who believe, be mindful of god and speak a word that is sound; he will set right your deeds for you and forgive you your sins. and whoever obeys god and his messenger has won a great triumph} (sūrat al-aḥzāb 33:70-71) …
r:
عندما يتغلغل الإيمان في القلوب لا يمكن لأي قوة بشرية أن تقف أمامه، فهاهم سحرة فرعون عندما خامر الإيمان شغاف قلوبهم لم يخشوا تهديد فرعون بالقتل والصلب وإنما قالوا: اقض ما أنت قاض إنما تقضي هذه الحياة الدنيا. فعلى العلماء والدعاة أن يسعوا إلى زيادة الإيمان وتقويته، حتى يواجهوا به ضغوطات الجبابرة والطغاة، وأن يقولوا كلمة الحق ولا يخافوا في الله لومة لائم.
ضرورة معرفة نعم الله علينا:
إن الحمد لله نحمده ونستعينه، ونعوذ بالله من شرور أنفسنا ومن سيئات أعمالنا، من يهده الله فلا مضل له، ومن يضلل فلا هادي له، وأشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، وأشهد أن محمداً عبده ورسوله صلى الله عليه وعلى آله وأصحابه وسلم تسليماً كثيراً: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمُ الَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ مِنْ نَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ وَخَلَقَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَبَثَّ مِنْهُمَا رِجَالًا كَثِيرًا وَنِسَاءً وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ الَّذِي تَسَاءَلُونَ بِهِ وَالأَرْحَامَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَقِيبًا [النساء:1] ، يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَقُولُوا قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا * يُصْلِحْ لَكُمْ أَعْمَالَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَمَنْ يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيمًا [الأحزاب:70-71]...

t: How We Are to Work for Islam
a: كيف نعمل للإسلام
b:
*[site synopsis]* islam began as a stranger and will return to being a stranger as it began. the first estrangement of islam passed away and was replaced by honour, ascendancy and established strength — after continuous effort and unwearying work, which showed itself in the life of the prophet, god bless him and grant him peace, and in the lives of his companions and of those who came after them. today we are living a new estrangement of islam, and this estrangement will not pass away from islam except through continuous work and the joined efforts of every section of the muslims.

## god's ennobling of this community above all other communities

in the name of god, the all-merciful, the mercy-giving. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds. i ask god's blessing and peace upon the one sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions, and upon all who have taken guidance from his guidance and followed his practice until the day of judgement. to proceed: all muslims know that god, glorified and exalted is he, created them for a clear purpose which he has set out in his book; that he laid down for them the code of this religion, which is the best of his codes; that he placed within it the best of his books; and that he sent to them the best of his messengers, and by this ennobled them above all other communities and made them a middle community, that they might be witnesses over mankind.

it is established from the messenger of god, god bless him and grant him peace, in the two ṣaḥīḥs, that he said: "this community are witnesses whose probity is accepted on the day of resurrection. there is no prophet but that he will dispute with his community in the highest assembly, and it will be said to him: who will testify for you? and he will say: muhammad and his community. even noah will dispute with his community in the highest assembly, and they will say: no bearer of good news and no warner came to us! and he will say: i remained among you a thousand years less fifty, calling you to god. and they will deny it, and it will be said: who will testify for you? and he will say: muhammad and his community" …
r:
بدأ الإسلام غريباً وسيعود غريباً كما بدأ، وقد زالت الغربة الأولى للإسلام ليحل محلها العز والظهور والتمكين، بعد جهد متواصل وعمل دءوب، تجلى في سيرة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم، وفي سيرة أصحابه ومن بعدهم، ونحن اليوم نعيش غربة جديدة للإسلام، ولن تزول هذه الغربة عن الإسلام إلا بعمل متواصل وجهود متضافرة من جميع فئات المسلمين.
تشريف الله لهذه الأمة على سائر الأمم:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين، وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه، ومن اهتدى بهداه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين. أما بعد: فإن جميع المسلمين يعلمون أن الله سبحانه وتعالى خلقهم لحكمة واضحة بينها في كتابه، وشرع لهم شرائع هذا الدين الذي هو خير شرائعه، وضمنه خير كتبه، وأرسل إليهم خير رسله، فشرفهم بذلك على سائر الأمم، وجعلهم أمة وسطاً ليكونوا شهداء على الناس، وقد ثبت عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في الصحيحين أنه قال: إن هذه الأمة شهود عدول يوم القيامة، وإنه ما من نبي إلا يخاصم أمته في الملأ الأعلى، فيقال له: من يشهد لك؟ فيقول: محمد وأمته. حتى إن نوحاً يخاصم أمته في الملأ الأعلى فيقولون: ما جاءنا من بشير ولا نذير! فيقول: مكثت فيكم ألف سنة إلا خمسين عاماً أدعوكم إلى الله. وهم ينكرون، فيقال: من يشهد لك؟ فيقول: محمد وأمته...

t: What a Caller to God Must Have
a: مقومات الداعية
b:
*[site synopsis]* calling people to god is among the greatest of the acts that bring one near to him, and among the greatest of obligatory duties (wājibāt); through it god guides peoples who had strayed from the even path. the call has means that must be present if it is to succeed, just as there must be certain important qualities in the one who calls people to god, if he is to be successful and to be granted success in his work.

## the merit of the call and of those who make it

in the name of god, the all-merciful, the mercy-giving. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds. i ask god's blessing and peace upon the one sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions, and upon all who have taken guidance from his guidance and followed his practice until the day of judgement. to proceed: the title of our subject here is "what a caller to god must have", and in it, god willing, we shall speak on the following elements:

the merit of the call and of those who make it.
the benefit of the call.
the aims of the call.
the means of the call.
the qualities of the successful caller.

god, glorified and exalted is he, described himself as calling, and said: {and god calls to the abode of peace, and he guides whom he wills to a straight path} (sūrat yūnus 10:25). and he described his noble messenger, god bless him and grant him peace, as calling, and said: {and as one calling to god by his leave, and as an illuminating lamp} (sūrat al-aḥzāb 33:46) ..
r:
الدعوة إلى الله من أعظم القربات، وأعظم الواجبات، وبها يهدي الله أقواماً ضلوا سواء السبيل. وللدعوة وسائل لابد من توافرها لنجاحها، كما لابد من وجود صفات مهمة في الداعي إلى الله؛ ليكون ناجحاً وموفقاً في عمله.
فضل الدعوة والدعاة:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين، وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين. أما بعد: فموضوعنا هذا بعنوان: (مقومات الداعية) وسنتكلم فيه إن شاء الله على العناصر التالية: فضل الدعوة والدعاة. فائدة الدعوة. أهداف الدعوة. وسائل الدعوة. صفات الداعية الناجح. إن الله سبحانه وتعالى وصف نفسه بالدعوة فقال: وَاللَّهُ يَدْعُوا إِلَى دَارِ السَّلامِ وَيَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ [يونس:25] ، ووصف رسوله الكريم صلى الله عليه وسلم بالدعوة فقال: وَدَاعِيًا إِلَى اللَّهِ بِإِذْنِهِ وَسِرَاجًا مُنِيرًا [الأحزاب:46]..

t: Faith Is What Holds the Community Together
a: الإيمان أساس تماسك الأمة
b:
*[site synopsis]* what we see today of calamities and afflictions, of humiliation and of our being made weak, comes only from ourselves: we let go of the causes of victory, of honour and of established strength, and so god tried us with their opposites. if we want god to change the state we are in, we must change what is in ourselves, and must take up the causes of that — realising faith, realising the brotherhood that faith creates, and casting off division and disagreement. for in holding together there is strength and honour, and in splitting apart there is weakness and defeat.

## the command to hold together, and the prohibition of splitting apart and disagreeing

in the name of god, the all-merciful, the mercy-giving. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds. i ask god's blessing and peace upon the one sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions, and upon all who have taken guidance from his guidance and followed his practice until the day of judgement. to proceed: the secret of the muslims' union, of their holding together and of their not splitting apart, is their faith, which is what calls them to it. for god, glorified and exalted is he, made the principle of creed the foundation of the whole of action, and made union and holding together follow upon this principle. he, exalted is he, said: {he has laid down for you of the religion that which he enjoined upon noah, and that which we have revealed to you, and that which we enjoined upon abraham and moses and jesus: that you establish the religion and do not split apart over it} (sūrat al-shūrā 42:13) …
r:
إن ما نراه اليوم من نكبات ومصائب وذل واستضعاف لنا إنما هو من عند أنفسنا، وذلك أننا ضيعنا أسباب النصر والعز والتمكين، فابتلانا الله بضدها. فإذا أردنا أن يغير الله الحال فعلينا أن نغير ما بأنفسنا، وأن نأخذ بأسباب ذلك من تحقيق الإيمان، وتحقيق الأخوة الإيمانية، ونبذ الفرقة والخلاف؛ فإن في الجماعة قوة وعزة، وفي التفرق ضعفاً وهزيمة.
الأمر بالائتلاف والنهي عن التفرق والاختلاف:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين، وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين. أما بعد: فإن سر اتحاد المسلمين والتئامهم وعدم فرقتهم هو إيمانهم الذي يدعوهم إلى ذلك؛ فإن الله سبحانه وتعالى جعل المبدأ العقدي أساساً للعمل كله، وجعل الاتحاد والالتئام جارياً على هذا المبد إ، فقال تعالى: شَرَعَ لَكُمْ مِنَ الدِّينِ مَا وَصَّى بِهِ نُوحًا وَالَّذِي أَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْكَ وَمَا وَصَّيْنَا بِهِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُوسَى وَعِيسَى أَنْ أَقِيمُوا الدِّينَ وَلا تَتَفَرَّقُوا فِيهِ [الشورى:13]...

t: Faith in the Messengers
a: الإيمان بالرسل
b:
*[site synopsis]* when god created human beings, he did not leave them to no purpose nor neglect them in vain; rather he sent his messengers to them, to bring them out of the darknesses into the light. the prophets have distinguishing features and qualities that must be present in them — as an ennobling from god, as a safeguarding of the message, and as the establishing of the proof against people.

## messengerhood is a choosing by god, not something earned

in the name of god, the all-merciful, the mercy-giving. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds, and god's blessing and peace upon our prophet muhammad and upon his family and his companions all together. the sheikh, may god preserve him, said: *[and the messengers are true; and the arabian prophet is the seal of them, the highest of them in rank.]* by this he means to set out another of the pillars of faith, namely faith in god's messengers.

"rusul" is the plural of "rasūl", and a messenger is one to whom a revealed law has been revealed and who has been commanded to convey it. god, glorified and exalted is he, chooses the messenger from among the angels or from among human beings, as he, exalted is he, said: {god chooses messengers from among the angels and from among people} (sūrat al-ḥajj 22:75). but the messengers who are angels are messengers to the messengers who are human beings, and this is one of the kinds of revelation — and the kinds of revelation have already been mentioned. the messengers among the angels likewise convey to some of the angels, and for this reason god, glorified and exalted is he, mentioned that the angels ask, once the terror has been lifted from their hearts, when they hear the speech of god, glorified and exalted is he: {until, when the terror is lifted from their hearts, they say: what did your lord say? they say: the truth. and he is the most high, the most great} (sūrat sabaʾ 34:23) …
r:
لما خلق الله البشر لم يتركهم عبثاً ولا أهملهم سدى، بل أرسل إليهم رسله ليخرجوهم من الظلمات إلى النور، وللأنبياء خصائص وصفات يجب أن تتوفر فيهم؛ تشريفاً من الله، وصيانة للرسالة، وإقامة للحجة.
الرسالة اجتباء لا اكتساب:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين، وصلى الله وسلم على نبينا محمد وعلى آله وأصحابه أجمعين. قال الشيخ حفظه الله: [والرسل حق والنبي العربي خاتمهم أعلاهم في الرتب] يريد بهذا بيان ركن آخر من أركان الإيمان وهو الإيمان برسل الله. والرسل جمع رسول، وهو من أوحي إليه بشرع وأمره بتبليغه، والرسول يختاره الله سبحانه وتعالى من الملائكة أو من الناس، كما قال تعالى: اللَّهُ يَصْطَفِي مِنَ الْمَلائِكَةِ رُسُلًا وَمِنَ النَّاسِ [الحج:75] ، لكن الرسل من الملائكة هم رسل إلى الرسل من البشر، وهذا نوع من أنواع الوحي، وقد سبق ذكر أنواع الوحي. والرسل من الملائكة كذلك يبلغون بعض الملائكة، ولهذا ذكر الله سبحان وتعالى أن الملائكة يسألون بعد أن يفزع عن قلوبهم إذا سمعوا كلام الله سبحانه وتعالى: حَتَّى إِذَا فُزِّعَ عَنْ قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُوا مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُوا الْحَقَّ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ [سبأ:23]...

t: Faith in Revelation and in the Angels
a: الإيمان بالوحي والملائكة
b:
*[site synopsis]* among the pillars of faith are faith in the books, faith in the angels and faith in the messengers, and no believer's faith is valid without them. what is obligatory (wājib), however, is faith in detail in what has been set out in detail in the qur'an and the sunnah; what has not been set out in detail, we believe in in summary form.

## faith in revelation

the sheikh, may god preserve him, said: *[and revelation is true, not speech that is fabricated; and the books are true, and the angels are true.]* he mentioned that revelation is among the things faith in which is obligatory. ......

## the definition of revelation

in the language, "waḥy" is applied to speed, to inspiration and to writing — so it has three senses. one says "waḥā" and "awḥā" in the sense of "he wrote", in the sense of "he hastened", and in the sense of "he directed". like it is "wakhā", with khāʾ, and likewise "tawakhkhā", which also occurs in this sense. from it are the words of the poet:

*when he saw that escape had become impossible, he saw that the one burdened with two distresses is not beyond reach; he steered her toward the course of canopus, though short of it, on the syrian side, are mountains that rise high and fall low.*

the occurrence of "waḥy" in the sense of inspiration is frequent in the qur'an, as in the words of god, exalted is he: {and your lord inspired the bee: take for yourself dwellings in the mountains, and in the trees, and in what they build} (sūrat al-naḥl 16:68) …
r:
من أركان الإيمان الإيمان بالكتب والإيمان بالملائكة والإيمان بالرسل، فلا يصح إيمان مؤمن إلا بها، لكن الواجب هو الإيمان تفصيلاً بما ورد تفصيله في القرآن والسنة، وما لم يرد تفصيله فإننا نؤمن به إجمالاً.
الإيمان بالوحي:
قال الشيخ حفظه الله: [والوحي حق ليس قولاً يختلق والكتب حق والملائكة حق] ذكر أن مما يجب الإيمان به الوحي. ......
تعريف الوحي:
والوحي في اللغة يطلق على السرعة وعلى الإلهام وعلى الكتابة، فله ثلاثة معان، يقال: وحى وأوحى بمعنى: كتب، وبمعنى: أسرع، وبمعنى: أذهب، ومثلها وخى -بالخاء- وكذلك توخى، ترد أيضاً بهذا المعنى. ومنه قول الشاعر: فلما رأى أن النجاة تعذرت رأى أن ذا الكربين لا يتعذر توخى بها مجرى سهيل ودونه من الشام أجبال تطول وتقصر وورود الوحي بمعنى الإلهام كثير في القرآن، كقول الله تعالى: وَأَوْحَى رَبُّكَ إِلَى النَّحْلِ أَنِ اتَّخِذِي مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا وَمِنَ الشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعْرِشُونَ[النحل:68]...

t: Faith Before Knowledge, and What Is Rationally Impossible of God
a: الإيمان قبل العلم وما يستحيل في حق الله تعالى
b:
*[site synopsis]* to god, exalted is he, belong the most beautiful names and the most exalted attributes. the scholars have divided what pertains to god of attributes into the rationally impossible, the necessary and the possible, according to the divisions of the rational judgement; and in this material the sheikh explains this division and what follows from it in the science of theology (kalām).

## the divisions of the rational judgement, and how the attributes relate to them

praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds, and blessing and peace upon his messenger muhammad and upon his family and his companions all together. and now: here it is necessary for us to know that the rational judgement falls into three divisions, which are:

- necessity;
- impossibility;
- and possibility.

necessity is that the intellect judges a thing to be established in such a way that its removal is not admissible. impossibility is that the intellect judges a thing to be negated in such a way that its being established is not admissible. possibility is that the intellect judges the two alternatives to be on an equal footing, in such a way that both the negation of it and the affirmation of it are admissible. and in the field of god's attributes, glorified and exalted is he, the judgements of the intellect are likewise three. the first kind of attribute is that which the intellect makes necessary for god; under this fall the attributes already mentioned, which the sound intellect makes necessary and to which sound transmitted evidence points …
r:
لله تعالى الأسماء الحسنى والصفات العلا، وقد قسم العلماء ما يتعلق بالله من الصفات إلى مستحيلة وواجبة وجائزة بحسب أقسام الحكم العقلي، وفي هذه المادة يشرح الشيخ هذا التقسيم، وما يترتب عليه من الكلام.
أقسام الحكم العقلي وتعلق الصفات بها:
الحمد لله رب العالمين، والصلاة والسلام على رسوله محمد، وعلى آله وصحبه أجمعين. وبعد: فهنا يلزمنا أن نعرف أن الحكم العقلي ثلاثة أقسام هي: - الوجوب. - والاستحالة. - والجواز. فالوجوب هو: أن يحكم العقل بثبوت شيء بحيث لا يقبل ارتفاعه. والاستحالة هي: أن يحكم العقل بنفي شيء بحيث لا يقبل ثبوته. والجواز هو: أن يحكم العقل بتساوي الأمرين بحيث يجوز نفي هذا وإثباته. ومجال صفات الله سبحانه وتعالى أحكام العقل ثلاثة كذلك: النوع الأول من الصفات ما يوجبه العقل لله بها، وهذا فيه الصفات المذكورة، حيث يوجبها العقل السليم ودل عليها النقل الصحيح...

t: Supplication, Seeking a Means of Approach, and Calling for Aid
a: الدعاء والتوسل والاستغاثة
b:
*[site synopsis]* god commanded his servants to call upon him and promised them that he would answer, and taught them the causes that make their supplication answered. among these is seeking a means of approach to him (tawassul) through his names and attributes, through righteous deeds, and through the supplication of the righteous. but people have brought into this matters concerning seeking a means of approach through persons and the like, over which there is disagreement; and it is preferable for the muslim to avoid it, because it may be a means leading to associating partners with god (shirk).

## on the meaning of lordship

in the name of god, the all-merciful, the mercy-giving. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds. i ask god's blessing and peace upon the one sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions, and upon all who have taken guidance from his guidance and followed his practice until the day of judgement. to proceed: the sheikh, may god preserve him, says: *(and by lordship declare him one, for he is the one before whom faces humble themselves.)* ......

## what the arabs understood by "lordship"

this is the beginning of the treatment of the oneness of god in his lordship (tawḥīd al-rubūbiyyah), which, on the division we have mentioned, is reckoned the third of the divisions of the oneness of god. what is meant by it is affirming lordship of god, exalted is he, and denying it of everything other than him. "rubūbiyyah" is an abstract noun formed from "rabba al-shayʾa yarubbuhu", said when one has command and mastery over a thing. the arabs derive four verbs from this root: one says "rabbahu yarubbuhu" when he has taken possession of it …
r:
أمر الله عباده أن يدعوه ووعدهم بالإجابة، وعلمهم الأسباب التي تجعل دعاءهم مستجاباً، ومنها التوسل إليه بأسمائه وصفاته وبالأعمال الصالحة ودعاء الصالحين، ولكن أدخل الناس في ذلك أموراً في التوسل بالأشخاص ونحو ذلك مما فيه خلاف، وأولى للمسلم اجتنابه لأنه قد يكون وسيلة إلى الشرك.
ذكر معنى الربوبية:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين، وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين. أما بعد: فيقول الشيخ حفظه الله تعالى: (وبالربوبية وحدوه فهو الذي تعنو له الوجوه) ......
تعريف الربوبية عند العرب:
هذا شروع في ذكر توحيد الربوبية، وهو على التقسيم الذي ذكرناه يُعَدُّ القسم الثالث من أقسام التوحيد، والمقصود به: إثبات الربوبية لله تعالى ونفيها عن كل ما عداه. والربوبية: مصدر صناعي من رَبَّ الشيء يَرُبُّهُ إذا كان مهيمناً عليه مسيطراً. والعرب تشتق من هذه المادة أربعة أفعال، فيقال: رَبَّهُ يَرُبُّهُ إذا استولى عليه...

t: The Indispensable Preliminaries to the Science of Creed
a: المقدمات الضرورية لعلم العقائد
b:
*[site synopsis]* before embarking on any science, the student ought to know its ten preliminaries, by the knowledge of which learning is made easier. the people of knowledge have taken care to set out and explain these ten principles for students of knowledge; and among the most important of them are the preliminaries to the science of creed.

## knowing the definition of the science of creed

in the name of god, the all-merciful, the mercy-giving. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds, and blessing and peace upon the master of the prophets and the messengers, our prophet muhammad, and upon his family and his companions all together. before embarking on any science, a person ought to acquaint himself with ten preliminaries which he needs in order to form a conception of the science he intends to set about learning. these ten preliminaries are the ones al-maqqari put into verse, saying:

*whoever aims at a discipline, let him put first a knowledge of its definition, and its subject matter next; and its founder, and its relation to other sciences, and the sources it draws upon, and its merit, and the ruling (ḥukm) relied upon concerning it; and its name, and what it yields, and its questions. those are ten, and they are the means to what is sought. some have confined themselves to a part of them; but whoever knows them all has prevailed.*
r:
قبل الشروع في أي علم ينبغي أن يعرف الطالب مقدماته العشر التي بمعرفتها يسهل التعلم، وهذه المبادئ العشر اهتم أهل العلم ببيانها وشرحها لطلاب العلم، ومن أهم ذلك مقدمات علم العقائد.
معرفة حد علم العقائد:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين، والصلاة والسلام على سيد الأنبياء والمرسلين، نبينا محمد وعلى آله وأصحابه أجمعين. قبل الشروع في كل علم ينبغي أن يطلع الإنسان على عشر مقدمات يحتاج إليها في تصور ذلك العلم الذي يريد الإقدام على تعلمه، وهذه المقدمات العشر هي التي نظمها المقري بقوله: من رام فناً فليقـــدم أولاً ***علماً بحده وموضـوع تلا/ وواضع، ونسبة وما استمــد *** منه، وفضله، وحكم يعتمـد/ واسم وما أفاد والمســائل *** فتلك عشر للمنى وسـائل/ وبعضهم فيها على البعض اقتصر*** ومن يكن يدري جميعها انتصر...

t: God's Being First Without Beginning, and the Coming-to-Be of Creation
a: أولية الله وحدوث الخلق
b:
*[site synopsis]* god, exalted is he, is the creator of creation out of nothing. god was, and nothing else was with him; so to him belongs absolute priority, which was preceded by no non-existence. likewise to him belong the most beautiful names, whose root and point of reference is the name "allah", and the most exalted attributes, which are free of every deficiency and of every likeness to created things.

## the meaning of "creed"

in the name of god, the all-merciful, the mercy-giving. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds, and god's blessing and peace upon our prophet muhammad and upon his family and his companions all together. the sheikh, may god preserve him, says: *(the articles of creed.)* "ʿaqāʾid" is the plural of "ʿaqīdah", which is what a person holds as a conviction — that is, what he assents to with an assent that admits no doubt.

what is meant by it is that most of these matters mentioned here are matters established by explicit text, which have come in the qur'an or in the sunnah. whoever knows that they are so established, it is obligatory (wājib) upon him to believe in their truthfulness and their soundness. whoever does not know that, and has not heard them, is not held to anything beyond the six fundamentals, which are the pillars of faith. a person is not held to knowing them in detail unless he has heard the revelation that came down concerning them. from this it follows that many of the attributes you hear of here have come only in singly transmitted reports (āḥād), and the messenger, god bless him and grant him peace, did not teach them to the whole community …
r:
الله تعالى هو خالق الخلق من عدم، وقد كان الله ولا شيء سواه، فله الأولية المطلقة التي لم تسبق بعدم، كما أن له الأسماء الحسنى التي أصلها ومرجعها لفظ الجلالة، وله الصفات العلا المنزهة عن كل نقص وتشبيه.
معنى العقائد:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين، وصلى الله وسلم على نبينا محمد وعلى آله وأصحابه أجمعين. يقول الشيخ حفظه الله تعالى: (العقائد). والعقائد جمع عقيدة، وهي ما يعتقده الإنسان، أي يجزم به جزماً لا يقبل الشك، والمقصود به أن هذه الأمور المذكورة هنا أكثرها أمور نصية جاءت في القرآن أو في السنة، فمن عرف أنها نصية وجب عليه الإيمان بصدقها وصحتها، ومن لم يعرف ذلك ولم يسمعها فهو غير مطالب إلا بالأصول الستة التي هي أركان الإيمان، فلا يطالب الإنسان بمعرفتها تفصيلاً إلا إذا سمع الوحي الذي نزل فيها، ومن هنا فإن كثيراً من الصفات التي تسمعونها هنا إنما جاءت في أحاديث آحاد ولم يعلّمها الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم لكل الأمة...

t: The Oneness of God in Worship
a: توحيد العبودية
b:
*[site synopsis]* god sent the messengers calling to the devoting of worship to god alone, and forbidding whatever impairs that or leads to its opposite in the way of associating partners with god (shirk) — such as making names into names of servitude to other than god, and the forbidden seeking of blessing. they likewise forbade rubbing oneself against graves, making vows to other than god, and slaughtering for the dead, and other things of that kind.

## the obligation to devote worship to god alone

he said: *[so devote worship to him alone, exalted is he; do not associate his servants with him in any kind of it.]* the "so" here is a connective ordering this upon what preceded, and the meaning is: once you have avoided associating partners with god, devote worship to god alone — that is, single him out for worship. this is what the people of the spiritual path call divesting before adorning. divesting requires ridding oneself of associating partners with god; adorning requires taking on and being characterised by the affirmation of god's oneness. so a person joins negation and affirmation together: he negates association first, and then affirms god's oneness second. these two things are what the word of oneness, "there is no god but god", contains: "there is no god" is negation, and "but god" is affirmation. for this reason he began first with the negation of association, and then ordered upon it the affirmation of oneness, in his words: *(so devote worship to him alone, exalted is he.)* …
r:
لقد أرسل الله الرسل يدعون إلى إفراد الله بالعبادة، وينهون عما يخل بذلك أو يؤدي إلى نقيضه من الشرك كتعبيد الأسماء لغير الله، والتبرك الممنوع، كما نهوا عن التمسح بالقبور والنذر لغير الله أو الذبح للأموات وغير ذلك.
وجوب إفراد الله بالعبادة:
قال: [فأفردوه جل بالعباده لا تشركوا في نوعها عباده] الفاء هنا للترتيب على ما سبق، ومعناه: إذا اجتنبتم الشرك فأفردوا الله، أي: وحدوه بالعبادة، وهذا هو الذي يسميه أهل السلوك بالتخلي قبل التحلي. فالتخلي يقتضي التخلص من الشرك. والتحلي يقتضي التحلي والاتصاف بالتوحيد. فيجمع الإنسان بين النفي والإثبات فينفي الشرك أولاً ثم يثبت التوحيد ثانياً، وهذان الأمران تضمنتهما كلمة التوحيد: لا إله إلا الله، فـ(لا إله) نفي، و(إلا الله) إثبات، فلذلك بدأ أولاً بنفي الشرك ثم رتب عليه إثبات التوحيد في قوله: (فأفردوه جل بالعبادة)...

t: Studying the Science of Creed
a: دراسة علم العقائد
b:
*[site synopsis]* among the greatest base texts in the school of malik, may god have mercy on him, is the mukhtaṣar of khalil ibn ishaq. one of the scholars put it into verse in an exquisite versification, making its opening section on the science of the creed of the early generations — of that to which imam al-ashʿari, may god have mercy on him, returned. what is before you is the commentary on the introduction to that versification.

## the merit of the science of the oneness of god

in the name of god, the all-merciful, the mercy-giving. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds, and blessing and peace upon our prophet muhammad and upon his family and his companions all together. and now, to proceed: we have already said that the science of the oneness of god (tawḥīd) is among the most excellent of the sciences — we did not say that it is the most excellent of the sciences — even though many of those who have written on it do say that it is the most excellent of the sciences, as al-maqqari said:

*and the most excellent of the sciences, taken without qualification, is a science by which the creator is known.*

but an answer is given to this: that this science is not the only one by which the creator is known. the science of qur'anic exegesis (tafsīr) is such a science too, and so is the science of the canonical readings of the qur'an (qirāʾāt), and so is the science of hadith. knowledge of the creator comes about only through these sciences taken together — as we mentioned earlier concerning the qur'an and its taking up all of these sciences. for this reason we do not assert categorically that it is the most excellent of the sciences without qualification, because these sciences, as regards what they lay upon a person (taklīf), stand at one single level: what among them is individually obligatory (farḍ ʿayn) is individually obligatory across them all, and what is communally obligatory (farḍ kifāyah) is communally obligatory across them all. it is hard for us to lay a measuring rule across them according to a gradation in merit. rather we say: it is among the most excellent of the sciences — and that suffices us, so that we do not take a risk and say of god what we do not know. for knowledge of god is not through this science only; it enters into exegesis, into the canonical readings, into hadith, into the explanation of hadith, and into many of the other sciences which we shall mention. …
r:
من أعظم المتون في مذهب مالك رحمه الله مختصر خليل بن إسحاق، وقد نظمه أحد العلماء نظماً بديعاً جعل أوله في علم العقائد السلفية مما رجع إليه الإمام الأشعري رحمه الله، وبين يديك شرح مقدمة النظم.
فضل علم التوحيد:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين، والصلاة والسلام على نبينا محمد وعلى آله وصحبه أجمعين، ثم أما بعد: فقد سبق أن قلنا: إن علم التوحيد هو من أفضل العلوم ولم نقل هو أفضل العلوم، مع أن كثيراً من الذين ألفوا فيه يقولون: هو أفضل العلوم كما قال المقري: وأفضل العلوم بالإطلاق علـم به معرفة الخـلاق لكن يجاب عن هذا: بأن هذا العلم ليس وحده هو الذي به معرفة الخلاق، بل علم التفسير كذلك، وعلم القراءات كذلك، وعلم الحديث كذلك، فمعرفة الخلاق لا تكون إلا بهذه العلوم مجتمعة، كما ذكرنا سابقاً في قضية القرآن وتناوله لكل هذه العلوم، فلذلك لا نجزم بأنه أفضل العلوم على الإطلاق؛ لأن هذه العلوم تكليفياً في مرتبة واحدة، ما يجب منها عيناً يجب في الجميع وما يجب كفاية يجب في الجميع، ويصعب علينا أن نضع مسطرة لها بحسب التفاوت في الفضل، بل نقول: هو من أفضل العلوم، ويكفينا هذا، حتى لا نجازف ونقول على الله بغير علم، فمعرفة الله ليست فقط بهذا العلم، بل تدخل في التفسير، وفي القراءات، وفي الحديث، وفي شرح الحديث، وفي كثير من العلوم الأخرى التي سنذكرها. ...

t: Bearing Witness That Muhammad Is the Messenger of God
a: شهادة أن محمداً رسول الله
b:
*[site synopsis]* the messengers are true, and the most excellent of them is the last of them, muhammad ibn abd allah, god bless him and grant him peace, whom god chose from among the arabs and whom he singled out above those before him with distinguishing features and marks of distinction, and whose religion he made the best of religions. for this reason the muslim ought to acquaint himself with aspects of this prophet's life, his lineage, his marks of distinction and what relates to these.

## the obligation upon all creation to follow muhammad, god bless him and grant him peace

in the name of god, the all-merciful, the mercy-giving. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds. i ask god's blessing and peace upon the one sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions, and upon all who have taken guidance from his guidance and followed his practice until the day of judgement. to proceed: the sheikh, may god preserve him, says: *and the messengers are true; and the arabian prophet is the seal of them, the highest of them in rank.* ......

## to deny muhammad is to deny all the messengers

after mentioning the messengers, upon them be blessing and peace, and the obligation to believe in them in summary form, he mentioned the reliance placed upon bearing witness that muhammad is the messenger of god. this is the second of the two testimonies, and the two are the two pillars of belief: the first pillar is bearing witness that there is no god but god, and everything of the particulars that has gone before falls within this testimony …
r:
الرسل حق، وأفضلهم خاتمهم محمد بن عبد الله صلى الله عليه وسلم، الذي اختاره الله من العرب وخصه على من قبله بخصائص وميزات، وجعل دينه خير الأديان، ولذلك ينبغي على المسلم أن يتعرف على جوانب من حياة هذا النبي ونسبه وميزاته وما يتعلق بذلك.
وجوب اتباع محمد صلى الله عليه و سلم على جميع الخلق:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين، وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين وعلى آله وأصحابه، ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين. أما بعد: فيقول الشيخ حفظه الله: والرسل حق والنبي العربي خاتمهم أعلاهم في الرتب ......
التكذيب بمحمد تكذيب بجميع الرسل:
بعد أن ذكر الرسل عليهم الصلاة والسلام ووجوب الإيمان بهم على سبيل الإجمال، ذكر التعويل على شهادة أن محمداً رسول الله، وهي الشهادة الثانية من الشهادتين، وهما ركنا الاعتقاد: فالركن الأول: شهادة أن لا إله إلا الله، وكل ما سبق من التفصيلات داخل في هذه الشهادة...

t: Questions Concerning Faith
a: مسائل الإيمان
b:
*[site synopsis]* among the questions the scholars discuss is the question of faith. the position of the early generations is that it is utterance, inward conviction and action, and that action is a part of faith. some of the early generations dissented as regards action, and the sheikh has set out the rank of this disagreement and what follows from it.

## the definition of faith, in the language and in technical usage

the versifier said: *[that. and faith is a whole that has comprised an assent in the heart together with utterance and action, with intention, in accordance with the sunnah; and through action it has admitted increase and, likewise, decrease.]*

his words "that" mean: know that. this is what is called abrupt transition (iqtiḍāb). he began the discussion with the oneness of god, glorified and exalted is he, which is the first of the pillars of faith — for the pillars of faith are six:

faith in god.
faith in his angels.
faith in his books.
faith in his messengers.
faith in the last day.
faith in the divine decree, its good and its ill.

the divine decree has already been discussed in passing, in the course of mentioning the attributes of god, glorified and exalted is he; and everything other than that falls within faith in god, glorified and exalted is he …
r:
من المسائل التي يتكلم فيها العلماء مسألة الإيمان، ومذهب السلف أنه قول واعتقاد وعمل، وأن العمل جزء من الإيمان، وقد خالف في العمل بعض السلف، وقد بين الشيخ مرتبة هذا الخلاف وما يترتب عليه.
تعريف الإيمان لغة واصطلاحاً:
قال الناظم: [ذلك والإيمان كل قد شمل عقداً بقلب مع قول وعمل بنية في سنة وبالعمل زيادة ونقصاً المثل احتمل] قوله: (ذلك)، أي: اعرف ذلك، وهذا يسمى الاقتضاب، فبدأ الكلام على توحيد الله سبحانه وتعالى وهو الركن الأول من أركان الإيمان؛ لأن أركان الإيمان ستة هي: الإيمان بالله. والإيمان بملائكته. والإيمان بكتبه. والإيمان برسله. والإيمان باليوم الآخر. والإيمان بالقدر خيره وشره. وقد سبق الكلام على القدر عرضاً في ذكر صفات الله سبحانه وتعالى، وكل ما سوى ذلك فهو داخل في الإيمان بالله سبحانه وتعالى...

t: Knowing God
a: معرفة الله
b:
*[site synopsis]* the scholars gave such care to knowledge that they composed versifications of it, easy to memorise and whose content is easy to understand. here the sheikh explains some lines from a versification on the articles of creed, in which he sets out the knowledge of god in respect of its being obligatory and of the way it is attained.

## the end and purpose of studying the science of creed

in the name of god, the all-merciful, the mercy-giving. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds. i ask god's blessing and peace upon the one sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions, and upon all who have taken guidance from his guidance and followed his practice until the day of judgement. to proceed: god has favoured us with the completion of the commentary on the sheikh's versification of the articles of creed. the sheikh, may god preserve him, left some questions without detailed treatment, relying on the detail he gave in his versification of khalil's jāmiʿ — for the original of the book was a versification of the mukhtaṣar of khalil on maliki jurisprudence, and at its end he likewise versified the jāmiʿ of khalil himself. this jāmiʿ is a book that brings together the articles of creed, the proprieties, the moral qualities the law enjoins, and a great many of the rulings that bear on conduct generally. the sheikh put it into verse in about five hundred lines; and the section of it dealing with creed is what is before us today — a small number of lines which add some particulars to what has gone before …
r:
لقد اهتم العلماء بالعلم حتى ألفوا فيه منظومات يسهل حفظها وفهم مضمونها، والشيخ هنا يشرح بعض أبيات من منظومة في العقائد، بين فيها معرفة الله من جهة وجوبها وطريقة تحصيلها.
الغاية والهدف من دراسة علم العقائد:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين، وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين. أما بعد: فقد من الله علينا بإكمال شرح نظم الشيخ المتعلق بالعقائد، وقد ترك الشيخ حفظه الله تعالى التفصيل في بعض المسائل اعتماداً على تفصيل ذكره في نظمه لجامع خليل ، فإن أصل الكتاب كان نظماً لمختصر خليل في الفقه المالكي، وكذلك نظم في آخره الجامع لـخليل نفسه. هذا الجامع كتاب يجمع العقائد والآداب والأخلاق الشرعية، وكثيراً من الأحكام المتعلقة بالسلوك عموماً، قد نظمه الشيخ في حوالي خمسمائة بيت، والمبحث العقدي منه بين أيدينا اليوم، وهو أبيات قليلة تضيف بعض التفصيلات لما سبق...

t: Some of the Distinguishing Features of the Chosen One, God Bless Him and Grant Him Peace
a: من خصائص المصطفى صلى الله عليه وسلم
b:
*[site synopsis]* no one — after god — has laid upon us a favour like that of this noble prophet, since by him god guided us to the straight path and shielded us from the heat of the fire of hell. god singled him out with mighty distinguishing features and great merits, among them that he is the possessor of the praised station, for which all creatures will praise him, even the prophets.

## intercession in the hereafter

the sheikh said: *so too, among the things for which he was chosen, intercession for the people of the standing-place was chosen for him.*

the messenger of god, god bless him and grant him peace, was ennobled with a number of things above everyone else, among them the greatest intercession, concerning which a number of reports have come. among them are his words, god bless him and grant him peace: "i have been given five things that no prophet before me was given"; and in the other report: "and i have been given six things that no prophet before me was given." among those he mentioned: that a prophet used to be sent to his own people in particular, whereas he was sent to people at large; that the earth was made for him a place of prayer and a means of purification, so that whichever man is overtaken by the time of prayer, let him pray; and that the spoils of war were made lawful for him, whereas they had not been permissible for those before him. among them is the pool that is witnessed, to which people come down; it belongs to him alone, god bless him and grant him peace. and among them is the great intercession, which is one of his distinguishing features, god bless him and grant him peace. these, then, are some of the marks of distinction with which god singled out his messenger, god bless him and grant him peace, and the greatest of them is the intercession …
r:
لا منة علينا لأحد -بعد الله- مثل ما لهذا النبي الكريم، إذ هدانا الله به إلى الصراط المستقيم، ووقانا من حر نار الجحيم، وقد خصه الله بخصائص عظيمة، ومناقب كبيرة، منها أنه صاحب المقام المحمود الذي يحمده عليه جميع الخلائق حتى الأنبياء.
الشفاعة في الآخرة:
قال الشيخ: كذا من الذي اصطفي به الشفاعة لأهل الموقف قد اصطفي رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وشرف بعدة أمور عمن سواه، منها الشفاعة العظمى، وقد جاء فيها عدد من الأحاديث، منها قوله صلى الله عليه وسلم: (أوتيت خمساً لم يعطهن نبي قبلي)، وفي الحديث الآخر: (وأوتيت ستاً لم يعطهن نبي قبلي)، فذكر منهن: أنه كان النبي يبعث إلى قومه خاصة وبعث إلى الناس عامة. وأنه جعلت له الأرض مسجداً وطهوراً، فأيما رجل أدركته الصلاة فليصل. وأنه أحلت له الغنائم ولم تكن مباحة لمن سبقه. ومنها الحوض المشهود الذي يرده الناس، فهو مختص به صلى الله عليه وسلم. ومنها الشفاعة الكبرى، فهي من خصائصه صلى الله عليه وسلم. فهذه بعض الميزات التي اختص الله بها رسوله صلى الله عليه وسلم، ومن أعظمها الشفاعة...

t: The Standing-Places of the Resurrection and the Signs of the Hour
a: مواقف القيامة وأشراط الساعة
b:
*[site synopsis]* the last day is the day on which all creation is gathered together, on which the realities are laid bare, and on which every created being is recompensed with what it deserves. god has appointed signs for it by which the nearness of its coming may be known; and nothing is required of the muslim but to believe in it and to work for it.

## the meaning of the last day

in the name of god, the all-merciful, the mercy-giving. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds. i ask god's blessing and peace upon the one sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions, and upon all who have taken guidance from his guidance and followed his practice until the day of judgement. to proceed: the sheikh, may god preserve him, says: *[and the last day, and what it has comprised of the gathering and of the presentation of deeds, is true; so too the weighing and what is attached to it; and the fire is true, and likewise the garden is true.]*

among the pillars of faith is faith in the last day. "day" in this world is the familiar unit of time, and it was applied to the hereafter in view of its being continuous and unbroken, so that it is as though it were a single day, even if its measure is thousands of years: {and indeed a day with your lord is as a thousand years of what you count} (sūrat al-ḥajj 22:47) …
r:
اليوم الآخر هو اليوم الذي يجتمع فيه جميع الخلق، وتنكشف فيه الحقائق، ويجازى كل مخلوق بما يستحق، وقد جعل الله له علامات يعرف قرب وقوعه بها، فما على المسلم إلا الإيمان به والعمل له.
معنى اليوم الآخر:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين، وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين. أما بعد: فيقول الشيخ حفظه الله تعالى: [واليوم الاخر وما قد اشتمل عليه من حشر وعرض لعمل حق كذا الوزن وما به التحق والنار حق وكذا الجنة حق] من أركان الإيمان الإيمان باليوم الآخر، واليوم في الدنيا هو الوحدة الزمنية المعروفة، وأطلق على الآخرة باعتبار اتصاله وعدم انقطاعه، فكأنه يوم واحد وإن كان قدره آلاف السنين: وَإِنَّ يَوْمًا عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ كَأَلْفِ سَنَةٍ مِمَّا تَعُدُّونَ [الحج:47]...

t: Questions [1]
a: الأسئلة [1]
b:
## some of the poetry of the jinn, and how far it is soundly established

**the question:** the scholars record poems of the jinn in their books. how were these poems transmitted, and how did they come to know that they were soundly established?

**the answer:** as regards the poems and the utterances reported from the jinn and transmitted in the books of the prophet's biography (sīrah) — many of these old books have authors of whom lying is not to be thought, such as muhammad ibn ishaq, who is very close in time to the events, since he is among the senior successors of the successors. he met a great number of the successors and his period is near, so these reports are transmitted from the companions.

some of their poems have been soundly established among what is transmitted in ṣaḥīḥ al-bukhari, such as their weeping over umar ibn al-khattab, and such as their poems at the time of the emigration — for some of them were muslims whom the messenger of god, god bless him and grant him peace, did not know at that time. among them is the crier whom the people of mecca heard, making known the affair of umm maʿbad:

*may god reward on our behalf — and the reward is of his bounty — two companions who alighted at the two tents of umm maʿbad. they came down with the truth and departed with it; so how fortunate is he who has become the companion of muhammad.* …
r:
ذكر بعض أشعار الجن ومدى صحتها:
السؤال: يذكر العلماء أشعاراً للجن في كتبهم، فكيف رويت هذه الأشعار، وكيف اطلعوا على صحتها؟
الجواب: بالنسبة للأشعار والمقامات الواردة عن الجن والمروية في كتب السير، فإن كثيراً من هذه الكتب القديمة لا يظن بأهلها الكذب مثل محمد بن إسحاق فهو حديث عهد جداً؛ لأنه من كبار أتباع التابعين، فقد لقي عدداً كبيراً من التابعين وعهده قريب، فهي مروية عن الصحابة. وقد صح من أشعارهم بعض ما روي في صحيح البخاري مثل بكائهم على عمر بن الخطاب ، ومثل أشعارهم في وقت الهجرة، فقد كان بعضهم من المسلمين لم يعرفهم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم إذ ذاك، ومنهم الصارخ الذي سمعه أهل مكة ينوه بـأم معبد : جزى الله عنا والجزاء بفضله ** رفيقين حلا خيمتي أم معبد/ هما نزلا بالحق وارتحلا به ** فيا سعد من أمسى رفيق محمد/...

t: Questions [2]
a: الأسئلة [2]
b:
## obsessive misgiving is obedience to satan

**the question:** i find obsessive misgiving (waswasah) in the full ritual washing (ghusl), so that i spend thirty or forty-five minutes at it. a great deal of time is wasted, and every time i have washed a limb it seems to me that i have not washed it, so i go back to it — and the same with the hair of the head, or the beard — and a great deal of time is wasted in it.

**the answer:** this person is afflicted with obsessive misgiving, and it is of satan's doing. he must beware of giving satan a way against him. he must not obey satan while knowing that he is his enemy; rather he must obey god, and keep away from satan's doing. and when satan tells him that he has not done a thing, let him rub satan's nose in the dust and abandon what has been cast upon him.

accordingly, whoever feels obsessive misgiving must take often to seeking refuge with god from the accursed satan, truthful in his heart; and he must not follow satan's promptings. so when he has washed a limb, let him pass on from it and wash another; and if satan makes it seem to him that he has not finished, let him not go back over himself in that, nor look at it — because satan may make him see that he has not yet washed …
r:
الوسوسة طاعة للشيطان.
السؤال: أجد وسوسة في الغسل فأمضي ثلاثين دقيقة أو خمساً وأربعين دقيقة وأنا في الغسل، فيضيع الكثير من الوقت وكلما غسلت عضواً يخيل إلي أنني لم أغسله، فأرجع إليه، وكذلك شعر الرأس أو اللحية، فيضيع فيه الكثير من الوقت؟
الجواب: هذا الإنسان مصاب بوسوسة، وهي من عمل الشيطان، فعليه أن يحذر أن يجعل للشيطان عليه سبيلاً، وعليه ألا يطيع الشيطان وهو يعلم أنه عدوه، بل عليه أن يطيع الله، وأن يجتنب عمل الشيطان، وإذا أخبره الشيطان بأنه لم يفعل، فليرغم أنف الشيطان وليترك ما ألقى عليه. ومن هنا، فالذي يشعر بالوسوسة عليه أن يكثر من التعوذ بالله من الشيطان الرجيم، صادقاً بقلبه، وعليه ألا يتبع وساوس الشيطان، فإذا غسل عضواً تجاوزه وغسل غيره، وإذا خيل إليه الشيطان أنه لم ينته فلا يراجع نفسه في ذلك، ولا ينظر إليه، لأنه قد يريه الشيطان أنه لم يغسل بعد...

t: The Women's Questions
a: الأسئلة النسائية
b:
## the ruling on sewing sheer garments

praise belongs to god, and blessing and peace upon the messenger of god, god bless him and his family and his companions and grant them abundant peace. to proceed: i say to the sisters that the questions you have put are before me. what i do not know, the answer to it will be "i do not know"; and as for what i do know, giving a considered legal opinion (fatwā) on it falls under the poet's words:

*by your father's life, al-muʿallā was never ascribed generosity while there was a generous man in the world; but when the lands turn bleak and their herbage withers away, then the dry stubble is grazed.*

**the question:** is it permissible for a person who has dependents to sew sheer garments, given that he needs the price of them and there is nothing but the sheer kind for him to sew?

**the answer:** it has come from amr ibn murrah that he came to the messenger of god, god bless him and grant him peace, and said: "messenger of god, i have been deprived, and i do not see myself provided for except from my tambourine with my hand — will you permit me that?" he said: "i will not permit you, and no honour to you. had i come to you beforehand, i would have beaten you painfully, and shaved your head as a disfigurement, and declared your property free to the people of medina."

for god, mighty and majestic, has made provision ample from what is lawful, and has made the ways to it ample. whoever wishes god to make his provision ample for him, let him not resort to what god has forbidden him. for sewing sheer garments, and selling them to one who will use them in a way that is not permissible, is part of cooperating in sin and transgression, which god has forbidden. …
r:
حكم خياطة الرقيق من الثياب.
الحمد لله والصلاة والسلام على رسول الله صلى الله عليه وعلى آله وصحبه وسلم تسليماً كثيراً. أما بعد: فأقول للأخوات: إن ما تقدمن به من الأسئلة بين يدي، وما لا أعلمه فسيكون الجواب فيه بلا أدري، وما أعلمه أيضاً فإنما الإفتاء فيه من باب قول الشاعر: لعمر أبيك ما نسب المعلا إلى كرم وفي الدنيا كريم ولكن البلاد إذا اقشعرت وصوح نبتها رعي الهشيم./
السؤال: هل يجوز لشخص عنده عيال خياطة الرقيق من الثياب مع العلم أنه محتاج إلى ثمنه ولا يوجد سوى الرقيق يخيطه؟.
الجواب: ورد عن عمرو بن مرة أنه جاء إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال: (يا رسول الله! حرمت فما أُراني أرزق إلا من دفي بكفي فهل تأذن لي في ذلك؟ فقال: لا آذن لك ولا كرامة، ولو كنت تقدمت إليك لأوجعتك ضرباً ولحلقت رأسك مثلة، ولأبحت مالك لأهل المدينة)، فإن الله عز وجل قد وسع في الأرزاق من الحلال، ووسع السبل إلى ذلك، ومن أراد أن يوسع الله عليه في رزقه فلا يعمد إلى ما حرم الله عليه، فإن خياطة الرقيق من الثياب وبيعه لمن يستعمله استعمالاً لا يجوز من التعاون على الإثم والعدوان الذي نهى الله عنه. ...

t: Disagreement and Splitting Apart
a: الاختلاف والتفرق
b:
*[site synopsis]* god, glorified and exalted is he, and his messenger, god bless him and grant him peace, warned against splitting apart, against forming factions and against partisanship, and called the believers to hold fast all together to the rope of god. they set out the causes of splitting apart, of disagreement and of mutual strife, and that it is obligatory upon the muslim to cast them off and to keep away from them. and there are matters over which disagreement arose among the companions and among those after them; these are exercises of independent legal reasoning (ijtihād), which ought not to be a cause of splitting apart, and one who exercises such reasoning in them ought to be excused on account of his reasoning, as the messenger of god, god bless him and grant him peace, excused him.

## god's warning, and his messenger's, against splitting apart and disagreement

praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds. i ask god's blessing and peace upon the one sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions, and upon all who have taken guidance from his guidance and followed his practice until the day of judgement. to proceed: god, glorified and exalted is he, warned against discord and splitting apart in his book in a number of verses, and made it incompatible with mercy in his words, exalted is he: {and they will not cease to differ, except those on whom your lord has mercy} (sūrat hūd 11:118-119) …
r:
لقد حذر الله سبحانه وتعالى ورسوله صلى الله عليه وسلم من الفرقة والتحزب والتشيع، ودعا المؤمنين إلى الاعتصام بحبل الله جميعاً، وبين أسباب الفرقة والاختلاف والتناحر، وأنه يجب على المسلم نبذها واجتنابها. وهناك أمور وقع الاختلاف فيها بين الصحابة فمن بعدهم، وهي اجتهادات ينبغي ألا تكون سبباً للفرقة، وأن يعذر المجتهد فيها باجتهاده كما عذره رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم.
تحذير الله سبحانه ورسوله من الفرقة والاختلاف:
الحمد لله رب العالمين وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين، أما بعد: فإن الله سبحانه وتعالى حذر من الشقاق والفرقة في كتابه في العدد من الآيات، وجعله منافياً للرحمة في قوله تعالى: وَلا يَزَالُونَ مُخْتَلِفِينَ* إِلَّا مَنْ رَحِمَ رَبُّكَ [هود:118-119]...

t: Knowledge Is Our Lamp
a: العلم سراجنا
b:
*[site synopsis]* knowledge is a light by which those travelling toward god, mighty and majestic, find their way. for this reason the scholars are the people of awe, of fear and of watchfulness before god, mighty and majestic; and as has been said: whoever knows god better fears god more. so it is obligatory (wājib) upon every muslim man and every muslim woman to learn what matters to him of the affair of his religion, and what enables him to worship god with clear sight.

## the merit of knowledge and of the scholars

in the name of god, the all-merciful, the mercy-giving. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds. i ask god's blessing and peace upon the one sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions, and upon all who have taken guidance from his guidance and followed his practice until the day of judgement. to proceed: god, mighty and majestic, has described himself by knowledge, and has praised the scholars among his servants, and has called the scholars to bear witness to the greatest testimony of all — after he had borne witness to it himself and had his angels bear witness to it. he, exalted is he, said: {god bears witness that there is no god but he, and so do the angels and those possessed of knowledge, upholding justice. there is no god but he, the mighty, the wise} (sūrat āl ʿimrān 3:18). and he informed us that the scholars alone are the ones who fear him as he ought to be feared, for he, exalted is he, said: {it is only those of his servants possessed of knowledge who fear god} (sūrat fāṭir 35:28) …
r:
العلم نور يستضيء به السائرون إلى الله عز وجل، ولهذا كان العلماء هم أهل الخشية والخوف والمراقبة لله عز وجل، وكما قيل: من كان بالله أعرف كان لله أخوف. فيجب على كل مسلم ومسلمة أن يتعلم ما يهمه من أمر دينه، وما يستطيع أن يعبد الله به على بصيرة.
فضل العلم والعلماء:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين، وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه، ومن اهتدى بهديه واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين. أما بعد: فإن الله عز وجل قد وصف نفسه بالعلم، وأثنى على العلماء من عباده، واستشهد العلماء على أعظم شهادة بعد أن شهد بها وأشهد بها ملائكته، فقال تعالى: شَهِدَ اللَّهُ أَنَّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَالْمَلائِكَةُ وَأُوْلُوا الْعِلْمِ قَائِمًا بِالْقِسْطِ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ [آل عمران:18] ، وأخبر أن العلماء وحدهم هم الذين يخشونه حق خشيته، فقال تعالى: إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى اللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ الْعُلَمَاءُ [فاطر:28]...

t: Woman Between Islam and Westernisation
a: المرأة بين الإسلام والتغريب
b:
*[site synopsis]* god honoured woman and gave her rights that she enjoys. he ennobled her by placing her maintenance and her upkeep upon the man, and safeguarded her by her remaining in her house, by the covering (ḥijāb) and by her not mixing with men. then came the ignorance of the west, which made of woman a commodity to be sold, and of her chastity a trade and a means of corruption and of spreading vice. this makes it incumbent upon the muslim who calls people to god to enlighten the community and to remind it of the goodness of islam and of its safeguarding of woman, and of the vice and the indecencies that the callers of the west stand upon.

## the honouring of woman, between the age of ignorance and islam

praise belongs to god, and blessing and peace upon the messenger of god. to proceed: the subject of woman has become one of the subjects that men and women ought to concern themselves with in this age of ours in particular, because of the fabrications that the enemies of islam have spread about it and the specious arguments they have promoted in it — of which the world had no need, but for this tendentious promotion. for woman is not distinguished from the rest of god's creation, exalted is he, except by a simple physiological distinction, the one that made her a woman. and this distinction does not require that she be singled out for a discourse of her own, or singled out for a thinking of her own, or that she have a standing of her own; for she is of god's creation, exalted is he …
r:
كرم الله المرأة وأعطاها حقوقاً تتمتع بها، وشرفها بأن جعل نفقتها ومؤنتها على الرجل، وصانها بالبقاء في بيتها، وبالحجاب وعدم الاختلاط بالرجال، ثم جاءت جاهلية الغرب فاتخذت من المرأة سلعة تباع، ومن عفافها تجارة ووسيلة للإفساد ونشر الرذيلة، وهذا مما يوجب على الداعية المسلم أن ينورالأمة ويذكرها بخيرية الإسلام وصيانته للمرأة، وما عليه دعاة الغرب من الرذيلة والفواحش.
تكريم المرأة بين الجاهلية والإسلام:
الحمد لله، والصلاة والسلام على رسول الله، أما بعد: فإن موضوع المرأة أصبح من الموضوعات التي ينبغي أن يهتم بها الرجال والنساء في عصرنا هذا خصوصاً، لما أشاعه أعداء الإسلام فيه من الافتراءات وما روجوا فيه من الشبهات التي كان العالم في غنى عنها لولا هذه الترويجات المغرضة. وذلك أن المرأة لا تتميز على غيرها من خلق الله تعالى إلا تميزاً بسيطاً فسيولوجياً هو الذي جعلها امرأة، وهذا التميز لا يقتضي أن تفرد بكلام، أو أن تفرد بتفكير، أو أن يكون لها وضع مستقل، فهي من خلق الله تعالى...

t: Method in the Seeking of Knowledge
a: المنهجية في طلب العلم
b:
*[site synopsis]* knowledge is the best thing in which lifetimes are spent, and the best thing in which the righteous compete. for this reason god appointed for the scholars a towering rank and a high standing, and honoured them with what he did not honour others with. the student of knowledge has proprieties, essential elements and wings which he ought to know and to observe while he is seeking and occupied with knowledge; and he must likewise concern himself with the ordering of priorities, and with putting what is more important before what is important.

## the merit of knowledge and of the scholars

in the name of god, the all-merciful, the mercy-giving. praise belongs to god, lord of the worlds. i ask god's blessing and peace upon the one sent as a mercy to the worlds, and upon his family and his companions, and upon all who have taken guidance from his guidance and followed his practice until the day of judgement. peace be upon you, and god's mercy and his blessings. to proceed: god, glorified and exalted is he, magnified the standing of knowledge, and had the scholars bear witness to the greatest testimony of all, after he had borne witness to it himself and had his angels bear witness to it. he, exalted is he, said: {god bears witness that there is no god but he, and so do the angels and those possessed of knowledge} (sūrat āl ʿimrān 3:18). and he judged them to be more excellent than everyone else, and said: {say: are those who know and those who do not know equal?} (sūrat al-zumar 39:9) …
r:
العلم خير ما تفنى فيه الأعمار، وأفضل ما يتنافس فيه الأبرار، ولذلك جعل الله للعلماء منزلة سامقة، ومكانة عالية، وأكرمهم بما لم يكرم به غيرهم، ولطالب العلم آداب وأركان وأجنحة ينبغي له معرفتها ومراعاتها في حال طلبه وانشغاله بالعلم، كما أن عليه أن يهتم بترتيب الأولويات، وتقديم الأهم على المهم.
فضل العلم والعلماء:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم الحمد لله رب العالمين، وأصلي وأسلم على من بعث رحمة للعالمين، وعلى آله وأصحابه، ومن اهتدى بهديه، واستن بسنته إلى يوم الدين. السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته. أما بعد: فإن الله سبحانه وتعالى عظم شأن العلم، فأشهد العلماء على أعظم شهادة بعد أن شهد بها وأشهد بها ملائكته، فقال تعالى: شَهِدَ اللَّهُ أَنَّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَالْمَلائِكَةُ وَأُوْلُوا الْعِلْمِ [آل عمران:18] . وحكم بفضلهم على من سواهم، فقال: قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي الَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَالَّذِينَ لا يَعْلَمُونَ [الزمر:9]...

t: The History of the Call to Islam in Mauritania
a: تاريخ الدعوة الإسلامية في موريتانيا
b:
*[site synopsis]* this religion spread until it reached every quarter of the world, and the credit for that — after god — belongs to those who strove in his path from among the people of knowledge, of merit and of righteousness. the conquerors opened the lands of the arab maghreb; then these lands came apart and became statelets at each other's throats, in which the strong devoured the weak — and so colonialism came upon it as an easy morsel, and swallowed it.

## god is the one who gives victory to his religion

in the name of god, the all-merciful, the mercy-giving. praise belongs to god. we praise him and seek his help, and we take refuge with god from the evils of our own selves and from the ill of our deeds. whomever god guides, none can lead astray; whomever he leads astray, none can guide. i bear witness that there is no god but god alone, who has no partner, and i bear witness that muhammad is his servant and his messenger, whom he sent with guidance and the religion of truth in advance of the hour, as a bearer of good news and a warner, as one calling to god by his leave and as an illuminating lamp. to proceed: the best of speech is the book of god, and the best guidance is the guidance of muhammad, god bless him and grant him peace; and every newly introduced matter is an innovation in religion (bidʿah), and every innovation is an error, and every error is in the fire.

believing brothers! peace be upon you, and god's mercy and his blessings. this religion is god's religion and not the religion of people. god, mighty and majestic, is the one who gives his religion victory, who makes it prevail and who gives it might — whether through the abasement of one abased or through the might of one mighty …
r:
انتشر هذا الدين حتى وصل إلى كل أنحاء العالم، وكان الفضل في ذلك -بعد الله- للمجاهدين في سبيله من أهل العلم والفضل والصلاح. وقد فتح الفاتحون بلدان المغرب العربي، ثم تحللت هذه البلدان، وأصبحت دويلات متناحرة يأكل القوي منها الضعيف، فجاء الاستعمار وهي لقمة سائغة فابتلعها.
الله ناصر دينه:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم إن الحمد لله، نحمده ونستعينه، ونعوذ بالله من شرور أنفسنا، ومن سيئات أعمالنا، من يهده الله فلا مضل له، ومن يضلل فلا هادي له، وأشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، وأشهد أن محمداً عبده ورسوله، أرسله بالهدى ودين الحق بين يدي الساعة بشيراً ونذيراً، وداعياً إلى الله بإذنه وسراجاً منيراً. أما بعد: فإن خير الحديث كتاب الله، وخير الهدي هدي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، وكل محدثة بدعة، وكل بدعة ضلالة، وكل ضلالة في النار. أيها الإخوة المؤمنون! السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته. إن هذا الدين دين الله، وليس دين الناس، فالله عز وجل ناصر دينه ومظهره ومعزه، بذل ذليل أو بعز عزيز...
