the default rule is that it be divided according to the division god set out in his book: { and know that whatever spoils you take, a fifth of it belongs to god and to the messenger, and to the near of kin, the orphans, the poor and the wayfarer, if you believe in god and in what we sent down upon our servant on the day of distinction, the day the two hosts met; and god has power over all things } (sūrat al-anfāl 8:41). this requires that a fifth be taken from it, that fifth being god's, and that four fifths be divided among the fighters who conquered it — all of that by the considered judgement of the leader and of those who bind and loose among the muslims.

but the commander of the faithful, umar ibn al-khattab (may god be pleased with him), held that these spoils were confined to movable property and the like and did not include real property, and he held that real property remains an endowment (waqf) for the muslims, because he did not wish to deprive coming generations of it. he did not hold that it belonged exclusively to the fighters; yet its reward is theirs, because they were the ones who conquered it, so that it is an endowment for them until the day of resurrection. the companions agreed with him in this, and so he made the cultivated land of iraq and the land of syria and egypt an endowment for the muslims. the companions who had conquered them undertook their endowment, foremost among them the commander of the faithful, umar ibn al-khattab (may god be pleased with him), and so this land became an islamic endowment until the day of resurrection — and like it all the countries that were opened by force, such as constantinople, which is istanbul, and what lies around it; for it was opened by force, and so its land and everything in it became an endowment for the muslims until the day of resurrection.

as for hagia sophia in particular, it was not a church in the religious sense known among christians — the sense that is distinct from politics — at the time of the conquest of constantinople. it was rather a sacred building belonging to the church, in which the crown of the king was hung, in which kings were enthroned and in which political decisions were taken; the emperor's kingship was contracted only inside this building, and they regarded it as a blessed and sacred building. this is so even though, as a matter of the ruling in sharia, it makes no difference whether a building situated in land opened by force is a church or not a church.

it is well known that sultan mehmed the conqueror (may god almighty have mercy on him) bought it at the time of the conquest from the christians who had charge of it, and did not wish to take it from them by force — although he had the right to do so, since the land had been opened by force and so became owned by the muslims, with its churches and everything in it. but he preferred to deal kindly, and so bought it from them. that is like the purchase of churches today in the lands of the west, for many of them are left and abandoned by their own people and are put up for sale, and western law in most countries lays down that a religious building may not be put to worldly uses but must remain a religious building; hence they can be bought and made into a mosque, for instance, which is the case with many mosques in europe today: they were churches and were bought from their people. so too with this building, if sultan mehmed the conqueror (may god have mercy on him) bought it — whether it was a church or something else — out of his own money, and did not make it a charge on the wealth of the muslims, because it was not obligatory upon them; for this was only dealing kindly with the christians and being gentle with them, and it was for that reason that he left them all their other churches, which have not been altered to this day.

from that time hagia sophia became the first mosque prayed in within the walls of istanbul, and the first prayer prayed in it was the asr prayer, after the contract of sale had been concluded with the christians, the money handed over to them and they had left it. from that time it remained a mosque for close to five centuries, until atatürk converted it into a museum — he did not convert it into a church. we knew it as a museum, containing byzantine antiquities and what relates to them, and it was a state museum which people entered for a fee.

the decision now taken by the court, annulling this law that atatürk enacted, is a decision that is correct in sharia, because the decision to convert a mosque into a museum is a decision that is forbidden (ḥarām) in sharia by the consensus of the muslims, and it is not lawful to convert any mosque into anything else, because the mosques belong to god. god almighty said: { and the places of worship belong to god, so call upon no one alongside god } (sūrat al-jinn 72:18); and he attributed them to himself by way of honouring them, saying: { and who does greater wrong than one who prevents god's places of worship from his name being remembered in them, and strives for their ruin? those — it was not for them to enter them except in fear. for them in this world is disgrace, and for them in the hereafter a great punishment } (sūrat al-baqarah 2:114). this mosque was ruined and remained this long period, more than seventy years, as a museum; and this is forbidden by consensus, no law sanctions it, and it is an assault upon the sanctities of god and upon a mosque of god. so it is obligatory (wājib) upon the muslims, whenever they are able, to restore it as a mosque as it was, and it remains an endowment for the one who endowed it, sultan mehmed the conqueror (may god have mercy on him), who bought it out of his own money and endowed it as a mosque in which the muslims pray; and that is incumbent upon the state. the supreme court in turkey has done this by its judicial ruling, which is effective in sharia, in conformity with the islamic sharia, and which no one of the schools of law contradicts. the consensus is settled upon the obligatoriness of this ruling, and whoever disagrees with it has disagreed with the book of god, because god almighty says: { and who does greater wrong than one who prevents god's places of worship from his name being remembered in them, and strives for their ruin? those — it was not for them to enter them except in fear. for them in this world is disgrace, and for them in the hereafter a great punishment } (sūrat al-baqarah 2:114).

accordingly we congratulate all the muslims, and turkey — president, government and people — and the people of istanbul, on this well-directed judicial ruling, which conforms to the law of god, and upon which the consensus is settled, restoring matters to their proper place. those who denounce this, from among the ignorant and the mouthpieces, proceed only from a defeatist position or from hostility to the government of turkey; and these political positions are, for the most part, not bound by the law of god. there is no disagreement that converting a museum into a mosque involves no objection in sharia, nor in law, nor in morals, so the denunciation is out of place. nor can those who take this decision today be put on a par with the one who took the first decision more than five hundred years ago, and there is no scope for putting sultan mehmed the conqueror (may god have mercy on him) on trial now.

and they did not denounce the conversion of all the mosques in andalusia and in other countries into churches.

for the great mosque of seville, the great mosque of cordoba, the mosque of the alhambra in granada, the great mosque of toledo and others in many countries were converted into churches — as were the mosques in greece and elsewhere — and not one of the muslims denounced that, even though the consensus is settled to the contrary. and god is the one whose help is sought.

we ask god to grant us and you success in every good.

peace be upon you, and the mercy of god and his blessings.

muhammad al-hasan al-dedew
r:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

الحمد لله والصلاة والسلام على رسول الله

السلام عليكم ورحمة الله و بركاته

بيان حكم رد آيا صوفيا إلى مسجد:

تنقسم الأرض التي فتحها المسلمون إلى قسمين: إلى أرض صلح وأرض عَنوة

القسم الأول: أرض الصلح هي الأرض التي ضر أهلها المسلمين أو وقفوا في وجه هذه الدعوة أو قاتلوا المسلمين و أصبحوا يمثلون تهديدا للدولة والأمة الإسلامية، فقاتلهم المسلمون، فلما حاصروهم نزلوا على الصلح لأن المسلمين شرع لهم قبل شن الغارة أن يعرضوا على العدو إما أن يصالحوهم ويدفعوا لهم الجزية ويكونوا من رعايا الدولة الإسلامية، أو أن يقاتلوهم فمن رضي بالصلح فالصلح مقدم على الحرب في الإسلام وإذا قبلوا الصلح فإنهم سيقرون على أملاكهم وديارهم وكنائسهم وبِيَّعِهم ومعابدهم فتبقى لهم لا يتدخل لهم فيها المسلمون ولا يغيرونها، وحينئذ يمكن تجديدها. واختلف هل يمكنهم بناء كنيسة جديدة أو معبد جديد في مكان لم يكن من قبل مكانا دينيا لأن الأرض لهم وقد أصبحوا من رعايا الدولة الإسلامية، والدولة الإسلامية تضمن لهم حرياتهم بما في ذلك حرية التدين بالدين الذي يرونه، وحينئذ ستبقى كنائسهم تحت أيديهم وتساعدهم الدولة ـ ككل مواطنيهاـ بما تستطيع في كل أمورهم بما فيها حمايتهم كما هو من واجبات الدولة وكذلك حماية أموالهم ومعابدهم وتجاراتهم داخل الدولة الإسلامية وخارجها لا يعتدى عليهم ولا يذمون ولا يسبون ولا يُتَعرض لهم بأي أذى لأنهم صالحوا المسلمين صلحا والمسلمون ملزمون بالوفاء به سواء أبرموه مع إمام المسلمين أو مع أي فرد من أفراد الأمة الإسلامية من الرعايا التابعين للإمام لأن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: (ذمة المسلمين واحدة) وقال: (ويقوم بذمتهم أدناهم).

القسم الثاني : الأرض المفتوحة عَنوة هي الأرض التي قاتل أهلها المسلمين وشكلوا تهديدا للدولة الإسلامية ووقفوا في وجه الدعوة فغزاهم المسلمون وقاتلوهم وأصروا على الاستمرار على القتال حتى فتحت بلادهم عَنوة من غير صلح كالقسطنطينية التي هي اسطنبول فإن أهلها أصروا على القتال ولم يصالحوا المسلمين حتى فتحت عنوة.

والأرض المفتوحة عَـنوة كبلاد العراق وأكثر بلاد الشام وأكثر بلاد مصر ونحوها فتحت عَـنوة لذلك أصبحت ملكا للمسلمين.

والأصل أن تقسم التقسيم الذي بينه الله في كتابه: {وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّمَا غَنِمۡتُم مِّن شَيۡءٖ فَأَنَّ لِلَّهِ خُمُسَهُ وَلِلرَّسُولِ وَلِذِي ٱلۡقُرۡبَىٰ وَٱلۡيَتَٰمَىٰ وَٱلۡمَسَٰكِينِ وَٱبۡنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ إِن كُنتُمۡ ءَامَنتُم بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَىٰ عَبۡدِنَا يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفُرۡقَانِ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡتَقَى ٱلۡجَمۡعَانِۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ}[الأنفال ٤١]. وهذا يقتضي أن تخمس، فخمسها لله، وأربعة أخماس تقسم بين المجاهدين الفاتحين الذين فتحوها، وكل ذلك باجتهاد الإمام وأهل الحل والعقد من المسلمين.

لكن أمير المؤمنين عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه رأى أن هذه الغنائم تقتصر على الأموال ونحوها ولكنها ولا تشمل العقارات، ورأى أن العقارات تبقى وقفا على المسلمين لأنه لم يُرِد أن يَحرِم الأجيال القادمة منها، ولم ير أنها تختص بالمجاهدين فقط و لكن لهم أجرها لأنهم الذين فتحوها فتكون وقفا لهم إلى يوم القيامة، ووافقه الصحابة على ذلك، فجعل سواد العراق و أرض الشام و مصر وقفا على المسلمين، وتولى وقفها الصحابة الذين فتحوها وعلى رأسهم أمير المؤمنين عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه، فأصبحت هذه الأرض وقفا إسلاميا إلى يوم القيامة، ومثلها كل البلاد التي فتحت عَـنوة كالقسطنطينية التي هي اسطنبول وما حولها، فقد فتحت عنوة فأصبحت أرضها و كل ما فيها وقفا للمسلمين إلى يوم القيامة.

و بالنسبة لآيا صوفيا بالخصوص لم تكن كنيسة بالمعنى الديني المعروف عند المسيحيين -المتباين مع السياسة- وقت فتح القسطنطينية وإنما كانت مبنى مقدسا تابعا للكنيسة يعلق فيه تاج الملك و ينصب فيه الملوك وتتخذ فيه القرارات السياسية، فلا يعقد الملك لقيصر إلا في داخل هذا المبنى، وكانوا يرونه مبنى مباركا ومقدسا، مع أنه لا فرق في الحكم الشرعي بين أن يكون المبنى الذي هو في الأرض المفتوحة عنوة كنيسة أو غير كنيسة.

وقد اشتهر أنه اشتراه السلطان محمد الفاتح رحمه الله تعالى من القائمين عليه من النصارى وقت الفتح ولم يرد أن ينتزعه منهم بالقوة -مع أنه له الحق في ذلك – لأن الأرض قد فتحت عَـنوة فأصبحت مملوكة للمسلمين بكنائسها وكل ما فيها، لكنه فَضَّل إحسان المعاملة فاشتراه منهم، وذلك مثل شراء الكنائس اليوم في بلاد الغرب فإن كثيرا منها يتركها أهلها ويهجرونها فتباع، والقانون الغربي في أغلب البلدان ينص على أن المبنى الديني لا يمكن استغلاله في الأمور الدنيوية بل لا بد أن يبقى مبنى دينيا لذلك يمكن أن تشترى و تجعل مسجدا مثلا، وهو حال كثير من المساجد الآن في أوروبا فقد كانت كنائس واشتريت من عند أهلها فكذلك هذا المبنى إذا كان اشتراه السلطان محمد الفاتح رحمه الله -سواء كان كنيسة أو غيرها- من حر ماله و لم يجعل ذلك من مال المسلمين لأنه ليس واجبا عليهم؛ لأن هذا إنما هو إحسان معاملة للنصارى و لطف بهم فلذلك ترك لهم كل كنائسهم الأخرى ولم تغير إلى الآن.

ومنذ ذلك الوقت أصبحت آيا صوفيا أول مسجد صلي فيه داخل أسوار اسطنبول، وأول صلاة صليت فيه صلاة العصر بعد عقد البيع مع النصارى وتسليم المال لهم وخروجهم منها ومنذ ذلك الوقت بقيت مسجدا على مدى قريب من خمسة قرون حتى حولها أتاتورك إلى متحف و لم يحولها إلى كنيسة ونحن أدركناها متحفا فيه آثار البيزنطيين وما يتعلق بذلك وكان متحفا تابعا للدولة يدخله الناس بأجرة.

والقرار الذي اتخذته المحكمة الآن بإبطال هذا القانون الذي سنه أتاتورك قرار صائب شرعا لأن قرار تحويل مسجد إلى متحف قرار محرم شرعا بإجماع المسلمين ولا يحل تحويل أي مسجد إلى أي أمر آخر لأن المساجد لله قال تعالى: {وَأَنَّ ٱلۡمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدۡعُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٗا}[المزمل ١٨]، وأضافها إلى نفسه إضافة تشريف فقال تعالى: {وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّن مَّنَعَ مَسَٰجِدَ ٱللَّهِ أَن يُذۡكَرَ فِيهَا ٱسۡمُهُۥ وَسَعَىٰ فِي خَرَابِهَآۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ مَا كَانَ لَهُمۡ أَن يَدۡخُلُوهَآ إِلَّا خَآئِفِينَۚ لَهُمۡ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا خِزۡيٞ وَلَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٞ}[البقرة ١١٤]، وقد خُرِّب هذا المسجد وبقي هذه المدة الطويلة التي زادت على سبعين سنة وهو متحف، وهذا حرام بالإجماع، لا يقره شرع، وهو اعتداء على حرمات الله وعلى مسجد الله، فيجب على المسلمين متى ما قدروا أن يعيدوه مسجدا كما كان ويبقى وقفا لواقفه السلطان محمد الفاتح رحمه الله الذي اشتراه من حر ماله ووقفه مسجدا يصلي فيه المسلمون، وذلك متعين على الدولة، وقد قامت المحكمة العليا في تركيا بذلك بحكمها القضائي النافذ شرعا الموافق للشريعة الإسلامية والذي لا يخالفه مذهب من المذاهب. فالإجماع منعقد على وجوب هذا الحكم ومن خالف فيه فقد خالف كتاب الله لأن الله تعالى يقول: {وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّن مَّنَعَ مَسَٰجِدَ ٱللَّهِ أَن يُذۡكَرَ فِيهَا ٱسۡمُهُۥ وَسَعَىٰ فِي خَرَابِهَآۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ مَا كَانَ لَهُمۡ أَن يَدۡخُلُوهَآ إِلَّا خَآئِفِينَۚ لَهُمۡ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا خِزۡيٞ وَلَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٞ}[البقرة ١١٤]

وعلى هذا فنحن نبارك للمسلمين جميعا ولتركيا رئيسا وحكومة وشعبا ولأهل اسطنبول هذا الحكم القضائي الموفق الذي هو موافق لشريعة الله، والإجماع منعقد عليه بإعادة الأمور إلى نصابها، والذين يستنكرون هذا من الجهال و من الأبواق إنما ينطلقون من موقف انهزامي أو عدائي لحكومة تركيا، وهذه المواقف السياسية ليست في أغلبها متقيدة بشرع الله، ولا خلاف أن تحويل متحف إلى مسجد لا حرج فيه شرعا ولا قانونا ولا خلقا، فالاستنكار في غير محله، كما لا يمكن الجمع بين متخذي هذا القرار اليوم ومتخذ القرار الأول قبل أكثر من خمسمائة عام، ولا مجال لمحاكمة السلطان محمد الفاتح رحمه الله الآن.

وهم لم يستنكروا تحويل كل المساجد في الأندلس و غيرها من البلدان إلى كنائس.

فمسجد إشبيلية الكبير ومسجد قرطبة الكبير ومسجد الحمراء في غرناطة ومسجد طليطلة الكبير وغيرها في كثير من البلدان حولت إلى كنائس، وكالمساجد في اليونان و غيرها و لم يستنكر ذلك أحد من المسلمين مع أن الإجماع منعقد على خلاف ذلك والله المستعان.

نسأل الله أن يوفقنا و إياكم لكل خير.

و السلام عليكم ورحمة الله و بركاته

محمد الحسن الددو

t: The Ruling on Refraining from Cutting the Hair and Nails During the Ten Days of Dhu al-Hijjah
a: حكم الكف عن قص الشعر و الأظافر في عشر ذي الحجة
b:
as for one who has no eid sacrifice (uḍḥiyah), and for the members of a household on whose behalf the one who supports them will be sacrificing, it is permissible for them to cut their hair and their nails whenever they wish, by the agreement of the scholars.

as for one who intends to perform the sacrifice himself, the jurists have differed over him between forbiddenness, dislikedness and permissibility:

the hanbalis and some of the shafi'is held that it is forbidden (ḥarām) for him to cut his hair or his nails until he has slaughtered his sacrificial animal.

the hanafis held that it is permissible (jāʾiz) for him to do so, without its being disliked.

the malikis and the shafi'is held that it is disliked (makrūh) for him, and that refraining from cutting the hair and the nails is recommended (mandūb) and not obligatory (wājib).

the basis of this is what imam muslim narrated from umm salamah (may god be pleased with her), that the prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: "when you see the crescent of dhu al-hijjah, and one of you intends to sacrifice, let him refrain from his hair and his nails"; and in another narration: "let him not cut any hair nor clip any nail."

this is a prohibitive command, and a prohibitive command, when it does not entail forbiddenness, is taken to convey dislikedness. sheikh khalil said: "and it is recommended (nadb) for one who is to sacrifice to leave off shaving and clipping during the ten days of dhu al-hijjah." it is recommended only in order to resemble the pilgrim.

the malikis and the shafi'is argued that the prohibition conveys dislikedness and not forbiddenness by what imam malik and the two sheikhs [al-bukhari and muslim] narrated from aisha (may god be pleased with her), who said: "i plaited the garlands of the messenger of god's sacrificial camels with my own hands; then he marked them and garlanded them, then sent them to the house while he himself stayed in medina, and nothing that had been lawful for him became forbidden to him"; and in another narration: "then he (peace and blessings be upon him) sent them with my father" — that is, with abu bakr (may god be pleased with him), in the ninth year of the hijrah.

its meaning is: nothing of the prohibited acts of the consecrated state of pilgrimage (iḥrām) became forbidden to him — not women, nor perfume, nor removing dishevelment, nor shaving the hair, nor clipping the nails, nor anything else of what god has made lawful…

and god knows best.
r:
بالنسبة لمن لا أضحية له و لأفراد الأسرة الذين سيضحي عنهم كافلهم يجوز لهم أن يأخذوا من الشعر و الأظفار متى شاءوا باتفاق العلماء.

أما بالنسبة لمن يريد أن يضحي بنفسه فقد اختلف الفقهاء فيه بين الحرمة والكراهة والإباحة:

فرأى الحنابلة وبعض الشافعية أنه يحرم عليه الأخذ من الشعر و الأظافر حتى يذكي أضحيته

و رأى الحنفية أنه يجوز له ذلك من غير كراهة

و رأى المالكية والشافعية أنه يكره له ذلك وأن ترك الأخذ من الشعر و الأظافر مندوب وليس بواجب ،

والأصل في ذلك ما روى الإمام مسلم عن أم سلمة -رضي اللَّه عنها- أنَّ النبيَّﷺ قال: «إذا رأيتم هلاَلَ ذي الحجة، وأرادَ أحَدُكم أَنْ يَضَحِّيَ فَلْيُمْسكْ عن شَعرِه وأظْفَارهِ»، وفي رواية: «فَلاَ يَأْخُذَنَّ شَعرا وَلاَ يَقْلِمَنَّ ظُفرا»

وهذا نهي والنهي إذا لم يقتض التحريم حمل على الكراهة قال الشيخ خليل: "و(ندب) ترك حلق وقلمٍ لِمُضَحٍّ عشرَ ذي الحجة"، وإنما ندب للتشبه بالحاج،

واستدل المالكية والشافعية على أن النهي للكراهة وليس للتحريم بما روى الإمام مالك والشيخان عن عائشة -رضي اللَّه عنها- قالت: «أنا فَتَلْتُ قلائد بُدْنِ رسول اللهﷺ بِيَدَىَّ، ثم أشعرها وقلدها، ثم بعث بها إلى البيت وأقام بالمدينة، فما حرم عليه شيء كان له حِلاًّ»، وفي رواية: «ثم بعث بهاﷺ مع أبي»؛ أي مع أبي بكر رضي الله عنه في السنة التاسعة من الهجرة

ومعناه: فما حرم عليه شيء من محظورات الإحرام؛ من النساء، والطيب، وإزالة الشعث، وحلق الشعر، وتقليم الأظفار، وغير ذلك مما أحله الله...

والله أعلم

t: The International Union of Muslim Scholars Receives the Afghan Negotiating Delegation in Doha
a: الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين يستقبل الوفد الأفغاني المفاوض في الدوحة
b:
his eminence sheikh muhammad al-hasan took part today, 1 october 2020, together with dr ahmad al-raysuni, president of the international union of muslim scholars, and its secretary-general dr ali al-qaradaghi, in receiving the delegation of the taliban movement taking part in the doha talks between the movement, the government of afghanistan and the united states.

at the meeting the sheikh spoke of the need to stop the shedding of blood and to work within what is held in common, for the good of building the state of afghanistan, and to let the logic of wisdom prevail, without this involving any submissiveness or humiliation.

he recalled the blood of the ummah being shed in many places, and the campaign against the religion of islam and its people, and what those who are zealous ought to strive for by way of standing against these attacks with what is within their power and capacity, without excess and without negligence.

he closed with the importance of the role of scholarly bodies, foremost among them the international union of muslim scholars, in reuniting and bringing together the word of all parties in the state of afghanistan and in the other lands of the muslims.
r:
شارك فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن اليوم 01 اكتوبر 2020م رفقة كل من الدكتور احمد الريسوني رئيس الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين و أمينه العام الدكتور علي القرة داغي في استقبال وفد حركة طالبان المشارك في حوار الدوحة بين الحركة وحكومة أفغانستان والولايات المتحدة

وقد تحدث الشيخ في اللقاء عن ضرورة حقن الدماء والعمل ضمن المشترك في صالح بناء دولة أفغانستان وتغليب منطق الحكمة دون أن يكون في ذلك خنوع أو إذلال

وذكر بدماء الأمة النازفة في شتى البقاع والحملة على الدين الإسلامي وأهله وما ينبغي أن يسعى له الغيورون من وقوف في وجه الهجمات بالمستطاع والممكن دون إفراط ولا تفريط

وختم بأهمية دور الهيئات العلمائية وعلى رأسها الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين في لم شمل وجمع كلمة كل الأطراف في دولة أفغانستان وغيرها من بلاد المسلمين.

t: Near in Spite of Distance, I Am Close to You
a: قريب على بعد أنا منك
b:
[verse. rendered as prose, line by line; the arabic is the operative text.]

*near in spite of distance, i am close to you — here among the captives, in a barren desert waste strewn with the carcasses of beasts broken by the road.*

*my condition and yours put me in mind of a line of the knight of hamdan, who endured captivity:*

*"shall a captive laugh while a free woman weeps?" so be patient: hardship keeps ease in its company.*

*in time past you used to dread a co-wife — and the harsher co-wife turned out to be the police station.*

*we dwell in a house made ready for degradation: we wear filth for clothing and spread out the dust for a bed.*

*its frogs are as many in number as its mosquitoes, and its dahis, at the gallop, outstrips al-ghabra.*

*and yet in it we found our intimacy with our lord, and so attained a gladness of which you will never encompass any knowledge.*

*our happiness under injustice, for our lord's sake, surpasses many times over every other happiness of ours.*

*and the bracelets in which some of us are shackled surpass those that chosroes used to wear.*

*we have a precedent in the mountain pass and in the well; our cells, reckoned so, we count as a palace.*

*the book of god surges up from every room, when night lets down a veil from its tresses.*

*and through the hours of the day you hear recitation — you hear it measured (tartīl) and you hear it swift (ḥadr).*

*you hear, all about you, something of every sura; you hear it in the seven and you hear it in the ten.*

*we notch the verses of the remembrance to the string in the face of the aggressor, and the aggressor sees them as tawny rudayni spears.*

*we draw them as white, keen-edged blades whose light turns the aggressor's own cutting swords back upon him, cut for cut.*

*how many a clear proof of god is in them, and how many a doubt raised among people they drive utterly off.*

*by his promise that is yet to come we renew our resolve, and from the stories of those who went before we draw our patience.*

*in it we read the disgraces of the sons of zion, and so we grow in hatred for those who defiled the place of the night journey,*

*and their brethren, those who play the hypocrite: we see the whole of their affair before our eyes, coming to pass just as it is read.*

*if they hasten towards them, we hasten towards a garden and a forgiveness — for which we hope in the hereafter.*

*they have no such hope; my lord only defers them for his greater onslaught.*

*and whatever the ignorant may want of us — we are firm: we fear neither violence nor treachery,*

*lions from among the lions of the overseer (al-muhaymin), seeking from god in the hereafter reward and recompense,*

*on a straight course whose way is neither extremism nor pliancy before threat, pressure and inducement.*

*we walk the way of the prophet muhammad, under a pledge of faith the breaking of which we hold to be unbelief.*

*to god we have sold souls that will not be brought low, at a great profit, in which he has multiplied the price for us.*

*with our bodies we pay the ransom and we give our religion its victory; we spread it abroad as light and grasp it as live coal.*

*and we defend it until we are struck down in its defence, and our bodies are sawn asunder with the saw.*

*we pay no heed to those who forsake us: they are weak, and we, without them, look for victory.*
r: قريبٌ على بُعدٍ أنا منكِ في الأسرى بدوية قفر بها جيف الحسرى .. يذكرني حالي وحالك قولةً بفارس حمدان الذي كابد الأسرى .. أيضحك مأسور وتبكي طليقة فصبرا فإن العسر يستصحب اليسرى .. وفيما مضى قد كنت تخشين ضرة .. فكانت بدار الشرطة الضرة العسرى .. نقيم بدار للهوان معدة فنلبس أوساخا ونفترش الغبرا .. ضفادعها في العد مثل بعوضها .. وداحسها في عدوه يسبق الغبرا .. ولكننا فيها أنسنا بربنـــا فنلنا سرورا لن تحيطوا به خبرا .. سعادتنا بالضيم في ذات ربنا .. تفوق بأضعافٍ سعادتنا الأخرى .. وأسورة فيها يصفد بعضنا .. تفوق التي قد كان يلبسها كسرى .. وإن لنا في الشعب والجب أسوة .. زنازننا إذ ذاك نحسبها قصرا .. يثور كتاب الله من كل غرفة .. إذا الليل أرخي من غدائره سترا .. وتسمع آناء النهار تلاوة .. فتسمع ترتيلا وتسمعها حدرا .. وتسمع في الأنحاء من كل سورةٍ .. وتسمعه سبعة وتسمعه عشرا .. نفوق آي الذكر في وجه من بغى .. فيبصرها الباغي الردينية السمرا .. ونصلتها بيضاً قواطع نورها .. يرد علي الباغي بواتره بترا .. فكم حجة لله فيها مبينة .. وكم شبهة للناس تدحرها دحرا .. بموعوده الآتي نجدد عزمنا .. ومن قصص الماضين نستلهم الصبرا .. مخازي بني صهيون نقرؤها به .. فنزداد بغضا للآلي دنسوا المسرى .. وإخوانهم من نافقوا كل أمرهم .. نراه عيانا واقعا بعد ما يقرا .. فإن سارعوا فيهم نسارع لــ جنة .. ومغفرة نرجوهما نحن في الأخرى .. وليس لهم ذاك الرجاء وإنما .. يؤخرهم ربي لبطشته الكبرى .. وما يبتغي الجهال منا فإننا .. أشداء لا بطشاً نخاف ولا غدرا .. أسود من آساد المهيمن تبتغي .. من الله في الأخرى المثوبة والأجرا .. بنهج قويم لا التطرف شأنه .. ولا اللين للتهديد والضغط والإغرا .. نسير على نهج النبي محمد .. ببيعة إيمان نرى نكثها كفرا .. ولله قد بعنا نفوسا أبية .. بربح عظيم فيه أربي لنا السعرا .. بأجسامنا نفدي وننصر ديننا .. وننشره نورا ونقبضـه جمرا .. ونمنعه حتى نصرع دونه .. وتنشر بالمنشار أجسامنا نشرا .. ولسنا نبالي خاذلينا فإنهم .. ضعاف وإنا دونهم نرتجي النصرا

t: The Interrogator Said to the Prisoner ... | A Poem by Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, Written in Prison before His Release
a: قال المحقق للسجين ... | شعر الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو كتبه في السجن قبل أن يطلق سراحه
b:
[verse. rendered as prose, line by line; the arabic is the operative text.]

**the interrogator said to the prisoner:**

*where did you get those costly shoes of yours? and where did your robe come from? do not be like the corrupt, the treacherous, who take from the gulf, from the left and from the right,*

*to whom the funding comes from every land, year upon year — even from the afghans, land of misery, den of the wretched: for there is a base there for terrorism, which aids those who sit idle.*

*they have turned the mosques into banks, thronging with investors. say what you like, but do not distort: we have the report for certain.*

*your wife's jilbāb, which she lets down — best of witnesses — where did it come from? was it not an odd thing among the local people?*

**the prisoner said, without pausing:**

*and where would i get this oxygen of mine from? the good things of my land — you are the ones who plundered them, you plunderers,*

*and withheld them from their own people, the poor and the oppressed; and you wanted to withhold the good things of the lord of the worlds.*

*why did you not question those who embezzle, the plunderers, the despoilers? why did you not question the debauched, the depraved, the corrupters?*

*why did you not question the men of the banks, the luxurious, the prodigal? why did you not question the grasping, the covetous, the fearful?*

*why did you not question the women who are clothed yet naked, and all that goes with it?*

*i do not steal, nor do i pilfer from the treasury and its stores. i do not plunder the projects meant for the weak and the hungry.*

*i have taken nothing but what i came by from the sweat of my brow. i am one who rejects injustice; i loathe the ruinous deeds of the oppressors.*

**the interrogator said: enough.**

*for we have other men, of your own religion, who accept all of this and endorse it, and who ground it in the very text (naṣṣ) of the school of malik and of al-ash'ari.*

**the prisoner said:**

*by the school of the phoenix and the heron! malik and al-ash'ari and their companions are no hypocrites.*

*do you want me to become like those lost men, who sell religion for the world to every buyer,*

*who proclaim their loyalty to the oppressors, the transgressors; who know the playing of every player and every dancer;*

*ignorant, denying the word of the best of the messengers; who run ahead of injustice with excuses for it, defending it;*

*cowards when it comes to making plain the right of god and the manifest truth, yet bold in reviling the sincere and truthful callers to god;*

*merciful to the unbelievers and the dissolute, but not to the muslims; promoters of everything the leader says and wants,*

*and of every law that runs counter to the way of the guide, the trustworthy; attacking the mosques, the institutes and the traditional schools (maḥāẓir),*

*striving for their ruin, barring teaching in them; you see them in every field applauding the tyrants,*

*hastening into the company of the unbelievers, normalising with the jews; repelling people from chastity, from the veil and from modesty;*

*mocking the people of the sunnah from the television screen; you never cease to hear their talk on the radio as they while away the night.*

*did they ever denounce a wrong? were they ever bidders of what is right? fie on them — what libertines! these are no reformers.*

*they have set right no matter of this world, nor any matter of religion. upon them, then, be the wrath of the overseer (al-muhaymin): they are the party of the accursed one.*

t: Sheikh al-Dedew’s Commendation of the Book Irshad al-Maharah fi Asanid al-Mahdarah by the Learned Shaykh Muhammad Yahzih ibn Muhammad Ali
a: تقريظ  الشيخ الددو لكتاب إرشاد المهرة  في أسانيد المحضرة للشيخ العلامة محمد يحظيه بن محمد عالي
b:
sheikh al-dedew's commendation of the book *irshad al-maharah fi asanid al-mahdarah* by the learned shaykh muhammad yahzih ibn muhammad ali.

the commendation of the eminent sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew of the book *irshad al-maharah fi asanid al-mahdarah*, by the eminent and learned shaykh muhammad yahzih ibn muhammad ali ibn muhammad fal ibn naam al-abd al-majlisi.

[verse. rendered as prose, line by line; the arabic is the operative text.]

*a noble book, exalted in the world of books, which broke new ground in the history of the western flank,*

*and closed a gap that stood in our libraries, by joining up the chains of transmission (asānīd) of the traditional schools and of the books,*

*and spread out again what the long passage of time had folded away and buried of the traces of its conquering lions,*

*and guided the skilled and the rightly directed to the most profitable ways of travelling in the track of the caravan.*

*by it the shaykh, the imam, brought to light wonders at which one marvels — wonders that guide, and that cure a man of marvelling.*

*muhammad yahzih, the noble, is our lamp, first past the post in the race of knowledge across the wide and open waste,*

*the halting-place where students unload their mounts, one practised at laying the tar-salve exactly where the mange is,*

*such that in him knowledge, understanding and god-consciousness (taqwā) stand side by side with generosity and good character,*

*together with an elevated literary art, finely turned verse, and a refined taste that never strays from the road —*

*all of it joined to a lineage of towering honour and glory, risen from noble stock by the steep ascent.*

*abu ahmad, the noble and ready man, was their father; glory has been passed down from him, ready man to ready man.*

*their breasts were created as vessels for understanding, and their lifetimes for occupation with the obligatory (farḍ) and the recommended (nadb);*

*their feet for outstripping others on the paths of eminence, and their hands for giving, for enquiry and for writing.*

*in glory, honour and eminence they have reached the furthest ranks, not to be approached even by the noblest of men;*

*and in the awe-inspiring assembly of learning they took the middle place, at a forefront where they stood as the heart stands.*

*at the dome of islam is the stronghold of their honour, under a lucky star and in a spacious dwelling.*

*so too the house of naam al-abd have been a blessing to people, level-spread in their hospitality, like a sweet watering place:*

*obeyed in the thick of battle, lamps in the darkness, keys to what is locked, deliverers from distress.*

*and this shaykh follows his father in his qualities, matching him in every title to glory, or surpassing him.*

*time has begrudged the world the like of his writings; their precedence is assured, far and near.*

*it is as though abu hayyan meant his books by the lines he spoke in al-bahr wa-l-darb:*

*"easterly risings of lights that shone forth at ceuta — and what a wonder, that the risings should appear in the west!"*

*a fertile pasture amid the barrenness of its lands — marvel, then, at fertility in the place of drought!*

*for regions have no merit except through their men; failing that, no soil has any merit over soil.*
r: تقريظ الشيخ الددو لكتاب إرشاد المهرة في أسانيد المحضرة للشيخ العلامة محمد يحظيه بن محمد عالي تقريظ فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو لكتاب إرشاد المهرة في أسانيد المحضرة لفضيلة الشيخ العلامة محمد يحظيه بن محمد عالي بن محمد فال بن نعم العبد المجلسي كتاب جليل جل في عالم الكتب و جدد في التاريخ في المنكب الغربي و سد فراغا كان في مكتباتنا بوصل أسانيد المحاضر و الكتب و أنشر ما قد كان طول المدى طوى و أقبر من آثار آسادها الغلب و أرشد أصحاب المهارة و الهدى لأنفع طرق السير في أثر الركب و أبدى به الشيخ الإمام عجائبا بها عجب يهدي و يشفي من العجب محمد يحظيه الكريم سراجنا مجلي سباق العلم في السبسب السهب محط رحال الدارسين مجرب لوضع الهناء في مواضع ذي النقب بحيث يقاني العلم و الفهم و التقى مع الجود و الأخلاق جنبا إلى جنب مع الأدب الراقي و شعر مهذب و ذوق رفيع لا يحيد عن الدرب إلى نسب في العز و المجد باذخ ترقى من الأعياص في المرتقى الصعب أبو أحمد الندب الكريم أبوهمُ تناقل عنه المجد ندب إلى ندب و قد خلقت للفهم ظرفا صدورهم و أعمارهم للشغل بالفرض و الندب و أرجلهم للسبق في سبل العلى و أيديهمُ للبذل و البحث و الكتب لقد بلغوا في المجد و العز و العلى مراتب قصوى لا تقرب بالنجب و في مجلس العلم المهيب توسطوا بصدر به كانوا بمنزلة القلب لدى قبة الإسلام معقل عزهم على الطائر الميمون و المنزل الرحب كما آل نعم العبد للناس نعمة موطأة الأكناف كالمنهل العذب مطاعين في الهيجا مصابيح في الدجى مفاتيح أغلاق مفاريج للكرب و ذا الشيخ يقفو من أبيه شمائلا يساويه في كل المفاخر أو يربي تآليفه ضن الزمان بمثلها لها السبق مضمون على البعد و القرب كأن أبا حيان يقصد كتبه بأبياته إذ قال في البحر و الضرب مشارق أنوار تبدت بسبتة فواعجبا تبدو المشارق بالغرب و مرعى خصيب في جديب ربوعها ألا فاعجبوا للخصب في موضع الجدب فما فضل الأرجاء إلا رجالها و إلا فلا فضل لترب على ترب

t: A Welcome to Mauritania’s Guest, al-Sayyid al-Mustafa ibn al-Imam al-Shafiʻi
a: ترحيب بضيف موريتانيا السيد المصطفى بن الإمام الشافعي
b:
[verse. rendered as prose, line by line; the arabic is the operative text.]

*my country bids welcome to the noble and beneficent one, al-mustafa, son of the imam al-shafi'i,*

*to the eloquent one, the valiant and resolute champion, the well-pleasing, possessed of honour and of high and far-spread renown,*

*the close companion of manliness, of noble deeds and high aspiration, of open-handedness and of fine and splendid character;*

*one who comes to the aid of the wronged without hesitation, and looses the bonds of the abject soul who calls for help.*

*in his favours and his gifts he makes no distinction between the importunate and the chaste and contented man:*

*each receives his share of his bounty, with a cheerful face, with affection and with humility.*

*he inherited these noble qualities from forefathers of honour, whose eminence spread through the widest reaches.*

*the noble ones of the line of jakar have hedged their titles to glory about with a broad edifice;*

*their present state points back to their past, and their past points forward to this present state.*

*they are the buyers of every noble quality and every height, and they bid the price up high for the seller.*

*knowledge is in them, and courage, and right guidance, and generosity, together with a widely known nobility of soul —*

*an inheritance passed down through the length of time, its hardships and all, from the one followed to the one who follows.*

*jakan are the pillars of the sciences, the qiblah of the wronged, his place of safety and the honour of the lowly.*

*their honour is inviolable and guarded, and their goods are apportioned out like things held in trust.*

*in every age they raise up for our people a banner of knowledge, pointed to like a shining star.*

*so may god grant them victory, and keep your memory alive, and make their favour endure in unbroken good.*
r: وطني يرحب بالكريم النافع المصطفى نجل الإمام الشافعي بالمصقع البطل الهمام المرتضى ذي العز و الذكر الرفيع الذائع خدن المروءة و المكارم و العلى و الجود و الخلق الجميل الرائع من ينصر المظلوم دون تردد و يفك أسر المستغيث الخانع لا فرق في أفضاله و نواله بين اللجوج و ذي العفاف القانع كل ينال نصيبه من سيبه ببشاشة و تحبب و تواضع ورث المكارم عن أبين أعزة شاعت علاهم في الفضاء الشاسع إن الأكارم من سلالة جاكر حاطوا المفاخر بالبناء الواسع فيدل واقعهم على ماضيهمُ و يدل ماضيهم على ذا الواقع هم مشترو كل المكارم و العلى يغلون في أثمانها للبائع فالعلم فيهم و الشجاعة و الهدى و الجود معْ شرف النفوس الشائع إرث يورثه على طول المدى و صعابه متبوعهم للتابع جاكان أركان العلوم و قبلة ال مظلوم مأمنه و عز الخاضع أعراضهم معصومة محفوظة و عروضهم مقسومة كودائع في كل عصر يظهرون لشعبنا علما يشار له كنجم ساطع فالله ينصرهم و يبقي ذكركم و يديم نعمتهم بخير تتابع

t: Sheikh al-Dedew Visits the Learned Dr Yusuf al-Qaradawi — may God the Exalted preserve them both
a: الشيخ  الددو يزور العلامة الدكتور يوسف القرضاوي - حفظهما الله تعالى
b:
sheikh al-dedew visits the learned dr yusuf al-qaradawi — may god the exalted preserve them both.

on the morning of today, wednesday 4 november 2020, the eminent sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew paid a fraternal visit to the eminent and learned dr yusuf al-qaradawi — may god the exalted preserve them both. the two shaykhs took up the concerns of the ummah and the events it is passing through, what it is obligatory (wājib) for the scholars to do in the face of those events, and the ways of coming to the prophet's aid (peace and blessings be upon him). his eminence closed the visit by asking the shaykh for his prayers.
r: الشيخ الددو يزور العلامة الدكتور يوسف القرضاوي - حفظهما الله تعالى أدى صباح اليوم الاربعاء 04 نوفمبر 2020م فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو زيارة أخوية لفضيلة العلامة الدكتور يوسف القرضاوي - حفظهما الله تعالى و قد تناول الشيخان هموم الأمة و ما تمر به من أحداث و ما يجب على العلماء فعله تجاه تلك الاحداث و سبل نصرة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم و ختم فضيلته الزيارة بالتماس الدعاء من الشيخ.

t: Act Before It Is Too Late!! | The Eminent Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew
a: بادر قبل فوات الأوان !! | فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو
b:
be diligent in discharging the rights owed by you before it is too late. these liabilities are what hold a person back from acts of obedience and keep him from the high stations; hasten to render them back before the hour of death comes.

**1 — the right of the parents.** their right is very great indeed. attend to them every day. try to do good to them, in compliance with god's command, with some fresh kindness on every day the sun rises. vary the kinds of good you do them, so that you may attain dutifulness towards them and draw near to them. do not be one of those who confine themselves to the dutifulness they grew used to in childhood, so that their dutifulness stops short at that limit. try to be a person of invention: every day you have some new kindness that they have not known from you before. as they advance in years, let them find in you such dutifulness and such gentleness that they speak of it with praise — as the man said, describing his son:

*i saw a tethered steed when his youth had come to its fullness and my own youth had turned away; in his dutifulness there is nothing to reproach.*

*towards us there is a side of him that softens, and a side heavy upon his enemies, hard to ride.*

*he tells me what i have asked of him in speech made easy, neither rough in its words nor idle.*

*he does not seek safety for himself while the companion of his journey is in fear, when his companion's side is pressed close to his own.*

*a thrill takes hold of him at the call of noble deeds, as the green bough quivers beneath the hot wind.*

try to be one who does good to your parents, whether they are among the living or among the dead. in the case of the dead, your inventiveness lies in finding some new way each day of keeping ties with their kin and joining their relations; in performing every righteous deed they used to perform; in executing their will; in praying for them and giving charity (ṣadaqah) on their behalf. all of that is inventiveness in dutifulness to them after death.

**2 — likewise, rendering the right of the wife and of the husband.** god the exalted enjoined care for them both, saying: {… and the companion at your side …} (sūrat al-nisāʾ 4:36). "the companion at your side" is the husband and the wife. so there must be inventiveness in discharging one's liabilities and rendering what is due, for each of the two has a right over the other, as god the exalted said: {and they have rights similar to those due from them, according to what is right; and men have a degree over them} (sūrat al-baqarah 2:228). so those rights and liabilities must be discharged, and one must strive for inventiveness in the good conduct god has commanded.

**3 — likewise the neighbours.** "gabriel kept on urging me concerning the neighbour, until i thought he would make him an heir." many of us today do not know our nearest neighbours, take no interest in what concerns them, do not hope their hopes, and feel no pain at their pains. the neighbour's right is great: if he is a believer he has two rights, and if he is an unbeliever he has one.

**4 — then after that, rendering the rights of near relatives,** whom god has commanded us to treat well, even to the point of making a bequest to them: {it is prescribed for you, when death approaches one of you and he leaves behind wealth, that he make a bequest to parents and near relatives according to what is right — a duty upon the god-conscious} (sūrat al-baqarah 2:180). what relates to the parents has been abrogated (mansūkh), but what relates to near relatives remains.

and when abu talha al-ansari (may god be pleased with him) came to the prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) and mentioned that he had heard the word of god the exalted, {you will not attain righteousness until you spend of what you love; and whatever you spend, god knows it} (sūrat āl ʿimrān 3:92), and that he owned no property dearer to him than bayruha, the prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) ordered him to place it among his relatives, and he distributed it among them.

this is the keeping of kinship ties, which is a great right. when god had decreed the creation of creation, the womb rose and clung to the leg of the throne, and said: "my lord! this is the station of one who seeks refuge with you from severance." he said: "are you not content that i should join whoever joins you, and cut off whoever cuts you off?" it said: "i am content." and god the exalted has said: {would you then, if you turned away, spread corruption in the land and sever your ties of kinship? (22) those are the ones whom god has cursed, so he made them deaf and blinded their eyes} (sūrat muhammad 47:22–23).

and al-bukhari (may god the exalted have mercy on him) said: "keeping ties of kinship is to give one's relatives a share in whatever kinds of good a person has been given." if he has been given knowledge, he teaches them; if he has been given an answered prayer, he prays for them; if he has been given wealth, he gives to them; if he has been given standing, he intercedes for them; and so on.

so let a person strive to keep ties with them, because worldly obligations hold a person back from the high stations. a person's back may be weighed down by the sheer quantity of debts and dues he has taken upon himself, so that he is not granted success in acts of obedience and in the great stations; but once he is rid of those liabilities he is able to move swiftly along the road, and to be among those who go ahead, of whom god said: {and among them is one who goes ahead in good deeds by god's leave; that is the great bounty} (sūrat fāṭir 35:32).

[translator's note: renderings of qur'anic verses here are interpretive and are not a substitute for the arabic.]
r: احرص على أداء الحقوق التي عليك قبل فوات الأوان و هذه التبعات التي تقعد بالإنسان عن الطاعات و تقعد به عن المنازل العالية بادر بردها قبل أن تحين ساعة الأجل. 1- حق الوالدين حقهما عظيم جدا، تعاهدهما في كل يوم ، حاول أن تحسن إليهما امتثالا لأمر الله في كل يوم تطلع فيه الشمس بإحسان جديد نوع أنواع الإحسان إليهما حتى تنال برهما و حتى تتقرب منهما، لا تكن من الذين يقتصرون على ما تعودوا عليه من البرور في الصبا فيكون برورهم قاصرا عند ذلك الحد، حاول أن تكون صاحب إبداع ، كل يوم لديك إحسان جديد لم يعهداه منك من قبل. كلما تقدم بهما العمر وجدا فيك من البر و لين الجانب ما ينوهان به كما قال الرجل في وصف ولده رأيت رباطاً حين تم شبابه .. وولي شبابي ليس في بره عتب لنا جانب منه يلين وجانب ... ثقيلٌ على الأعداء مركبه صعب يخبرني عما سألت بهين ... من القول لا جافي الكلام ولا لغب ولا يبتغي أمناً وصاحب رحله ... بخوفٍ إذا ما ضم صاحبه الجنب وتَأخذهُ عِندَ الْمكارمِ هــــــــــــــزَةٌ ... كَما اهتزَ تَحتَ الْبارِحِ الْفننُ الرَّطبُ حاول أن تكون محسنا إلى والديك سواء كانا في الأحياء أو في الأموات، ففي الأموات إبداعك كل يوم في التفنن في صلة أرحامهما ووصل قراباتهما و القيام بكل عمر صالح كانا يقومان به و إنفاذ وصيتهما و الدعاء لهما و الصدقة عنهما كل ذلك يكون إبداعا في برهما بعد الممات؛ 2- كذلك أداء حق الزوجة و الزوج فقد أوصى الله تعالى بهما فقال " { .. وَالصَّاحِبِ بِالْجَنبِ .. } الصاحب بالجنب الزوج و الزوجة فلا بد من الإبداع في أداء التبعات و أداء الحق ، فكل واحد منهما له حق على الآخر كما قال الله تعالى : { وَلَهُنَّ مِثْلُ الَّذِي عَلَيْهِنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَلِلرِّجَالِ عَلَيْهِنَّ دَرَجَةٌ } فلا بد من أداء تلك الحقوق و التبعات و السعي للإبداع في الإحسان الذي أمر الله به . 3- كذلك الجيران ما زال جبريل يحثني على الجار حتى ظننت أنه سيورثه ، و كثير منا الآن لا يعرف جيرانه الأقربين و لا يهتم باهتماماتهم و لا يؤمل آمالهم ولا يتألم بآلامهم و الجار حقه عظيم فإن كان مؤمنا فله حقان و إن كان كافرا فله حق 4- ثم بعد ذلك أداء حقوق الأقربين الذين أمر الله بالإحسان إليهم حتى بالوصية لهم { كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ إِن تَرَكَ خَيْرًا الْوَصِيَّةُ لِلْوَالِدَيْنِ وَالْأَقْرَبِينَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ ۖ حَقًّا عَلَى الْمُتَّقِينَ } ما يتعلق بالوالدين نسخ لكن بقي ما يتعلق بالأقربين؛ و النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم لما أتاه أبو طلحة الأنصاري رضي الله عنه فذكر أنه سمع قول الله تعالى : { لَن تَنَالُوا الْبِرَّ حَتَّىٰ تُنفِقُوا مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَ ۚ وَمَا تُنفِقُوا مِن شَيْءٍ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ بِهِ عَلِيمٌ } و أنه لا يملك مالا هو خير من بيرحاء فأمره النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أن يجعلها في قرابته فوزعها بينهم؛ هذه صلة الرحم التي هي حق عظيم لما قضى الله خلق الخلق قامت الرحم فتعلقت بساق العرش، فقالت: يا رب! هذا مقام العائذ بك من القطيعة، فقال:( أما ترضين أن أصل من وصلك وأقطع من قطعك ) قالت رضيت و قد قال الله تعالى : { فَهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ أَنْ تُفْسِدُوا فِي الأرْضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوا أَرْحَامَكُمْ (٢٢) أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ فَأَصَمَّهُمْ وَأَعْمَى أَبْصَارَهُمْ } و قد قال البخاري رحمه الله تعالى : ( صلة الرحم إشراك القرابات فيما أوتي الإنسان من أنواع الخيرات ) إذا أوتي علما يعلمهم ، إذا أوتي دعوة صالحة يدعو لهم، إذا أوتي مالا يعطيهم، إذا أوتي جاها يشفع لهم و هكذا. فيسعى الإنسان لصلتهم لأن الحقوق الدنيوية تقعد بالإنسان عن المقامات العالية ، قد يثقل ظهر الإنسان بكثرة ما تحمله من الديون و الحقوق فلا يوفق للطاعات و المقامات الكبيرة، لكن إذا تخلص من تلك التبعات استطاع الاسراع على الطريق و كان من السابقين الذينقال الله فيهم ( وَمِنْهُمْ سَابِقٌ بِالْخَيْرَاتِ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْكَبِيرُ .. }

t: Sheikh al-Dedew’s Elegy for Shaykh al-Din ibn Muhammad Ali ibn Takrur
a: مرثية الشيخ الددو للشيخ الدين بن محمد علي ابن تكرور
b:
[verse. rendered as prose, line by line; the arabic is the operative text.]

*is it truly al-din whose death you have announced — he of religion and right guidance, of knowledge and character, of glory and open-handedness;*

*he of the well-pleasing way, and of those sunnah practices for which he held a chain of transmission going back to the messenger of god;*

*defending them, repudiating every innovation in religion (bidʿah), and no faint-heart, however many the enemies grew;*

*he who among us took the lead in understanding and in quickness of mind, and who among us ran the whole course in his noble deeds;*

*who put knowledge and mastery into the hands of generations, and so accustomed them to it that it became their habit;*

*who was a ready man, eloquent of speech, foremost in place, honoured, firmly established, a chief among his clan,*

*high-minded, upright, his honour never to be slighted; a doer, a speaker, upholding what is right.*

*if al-din has departed from us, following after his companions, and has left a numbing grief in our souls —*

*then he has not died who has left his sons and his household behind him, and he has not died who has left a praise that endures.*

*so take patience, noble sons of musa, our shaykhs and our masters: may every one of us be your ransom.*

*may you never cease to be a wellspring of religion and knowledge, and a watering place of generosity, character and honour.*

*our beloved ones, o house of amina, be patient: al-din among you is not one man — he is many.*

*you remain for us a cave of refuge, a strength and a haven, and for religion, character and knowledge a root stock.*

*may my lord lodge al-din in the noblest of lodgings, and place his record in his right hand tomorrow,*

*and settle him in the highest garden as a neighbour to his forefather, the messenger of guidance — how true a seat is that!*

*and may my god bless his sons and their mother, and his two daughters; and may he keep them, honour them and give them happiness.*

*and may he send blessings upon the best of mankind, and upon his family, his companions, and the rightly guided who followed them.*
r: أحقا نعيتَ الدين ذا الدين و الهدى و ذا العلم و الأخلاق و المجد و الندى و ذا السَّنن المرضي و السُّنن التي لها عن رسول الله قد كان مسندا ينافح عنها منكرا كل بدعة و ليس بهياب و لو كثر العدى و من حاز فينا السبق في الفهم و الذكا و من جاز فينا في مكارمه المدى و من أكسب الأجيال علمًا و سؤددا و عودهم من ذاك ما قد تعودا و من كان ندبًا مصقعا متصدرًا عزيزًا مكينًا في العشيرة سيدا نبيها نزيها لا يضام جنابه فعولا قؤولا للصواب مؤيدا لئن سار عنا الدين إثر رفاقه وخلف حزنًا في النفوس تبلدا فما مات من أبقى بنيه و آله و ما مات من أبقى ثناء مخلدا و صبرا بني موسى الكرام شيوخنا و سادتنا إنا لكم كلنا فدا فلا زلتم للدين و العلم مصدرًا و للجود و الأخلاق و العز موردا أحبتنا يا آل آمنة اصبروا فما الدين فيكم واحد بل تعددا بقيتم لنا كهفا و عزا و موئلًا و للدين و الأخلاق و العلم محتدا و أنزل ربي الدين أكرم منزل و أعطاه باليمني صحيفته غدا و أسكنه الفردوس جارا لجده رسول الهدى يا صدق ذلك مقعدا و بارك إلهي في بنيه و أمهم و بنتيه و احفظهم و أكرم و أسعدا و صل على خير الأنام و آله و أصحابه و التابعين ذوي الهدى

t: A Delegation from the Leadership of the Islamic Resistance Presents Eid Greetings to His Eminence the Sheikh at His Residence
a: وفد من قيادة المقاومة الإسلامية يقدم تهنئة العيد لفضيلة الشيخ في محل إقامته
b:
on the evening of today, tuesday 20 july 2021, a delegation from the political bureau of the islamic resistance movement, hamas, paid a visit to his eminence sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew at his residence in doha. the delegation included the leader ismail haniyeh, head of the movement's political bureau, and dr khalil ismail ibrahim al-hayya.

his eminence the sheikh received his honoured guests in the manner due to them, thanking them for their efforts in defending the land of the night journey and the ascension, and setting out the need for the efforts of the ummah to be joined together so that the muslims' land may be recovered and their homelands freed.

the honoured delegation for its part expressed to his eminence the sheikh its gratitude to the mauritanian people for the warmth of their reception and the generosity of their hospitality, and valued the mauritanians' steadfast positions on the palestinian cause.

the honoured delegation also addressed the role of the scholars and their efforts in making the ummah aware of its foremost cause and acquainting it with it, particularly in these circumstances, in which the occupier and his helpers expend vast sums to tarnish the resistance and its figures and to promote the idea of political, cultural and religious normalisation.
r:
أدى مساء اليوم الثلاثاء 20يوليو 2021 م وفد من المكتب السياسي لحركة المقاومة الإسلامية حماس زيارة لفضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو في محل إقامته في الدوحة، و ضم الوفد كلا من القائد اسماعيل هنية رئيس المكتب السياسي للحركة و د.خليل إسماعيل إبراهيم الحية

و استقبل فضيلة الشيخ ضيوفه الكرام بما هم أهل له، شاكرا جهودهم في الدفاع عن أرض الإسراء و المعراج، مبينا ضرورة تضافر جهود الأمة من أجل استعادة أرض المسلمين و تحرير أوطانهم؛

الوفد الكريم من جهته أعرب لفضيلة الشيخ عن امتنانه للشعب الموريتاني على حفاوة الاستقبال و كرم الضيافة، مثمنا مواقف الموريتانيين الثابتة من القضية الفلسطينية،

كما تناول الوفد الكريم دور العلماء و جهودهم في توعية الأمة و تعريفها بقضيتها الأولى، خاصة في هذه الظرفية التي يبذل فيها المحتل و أعوانه أموالا طائلة لتشويه المقا ومة و رموزها و ترويج فكرة التطبيع السياسي و الثقافي و الديني .

t: Sheikh al-Dedew's Prayer for the Recovery of His Eminence the Learned Sheikh Muhammad Mahmud Ahmad Yura al-Rabbani
a: استشفاء الشيخ الددو لفضيلة الشيخ العلامة محمد محمود أحمد يورة الرباني
b:
o our lord, heal our sheikh muhammad

mahmud, who has traversed the farthest reach in excellence,

of the line of ahmad yura, who stood alone

in knowledge and in character, and so was without peer,

the most radiant of face and the most noble of descent,

the most truthful in speech and the most open-handed,

the finest in conduct and the highest in chain of transmission,

the purest of heart and the most exacting in purpose.

he has built a glory for the two forefathers, long inherited,

clothed in generosity, the imams of guidance.

lord, grant him what he seeks and what he aims at,

preserve him and help him with a strengthening help,

and in his sons let what has been customary continue,

that they stand, one master after another.

grant maryam the wish that will make her happy,

answer this supplication, and subdue the enemies.
r:
يا ربنا اشف شيخنا محمدا

محمودا الجائز في الفضل المدى

سلسل أحمد يورة من تفردا

في العلم والخلق فكان الأوحدا

أنور وجها وأجل محتدا

أصدق لهجة وأكرم يدا

أحسن سيرة وأعلى سندا

أطهر قلبا وأدق مقصدا

قد شاد مجدا للأبين أتلدا

في حلة الجود أئمة الهدى

رب أنله المبتغى والمقصدا

وأبقه وانصره نصرا أيدا

وفي البنين أبق ما تعودا

يقفون ذاك سيدا فسيدا

و أعط مريم مناها المسعدا

و استجب الدعاء و اكبت العدى

t: Does a Judge Incur Sin If He Rules by a Law That Contradicts the Islamic Sharia? | Fatwas of Sheikh al-Dedew
a: هل يأثم القاضي إذا حكم  بقانون مخالف للشريعة الإسلامية؟  | فتاوى الشيخ الددو
b:
[heading as the cms carries it:] does a judge incur sin if he rules by a law that contradicts the islamic sharia? | fatwas of sheikh al-dedew

did the term "the people who bind and loose" (ahl al-ḥall wa-l-ʿaqd) occur in the noble qur'an or in the purified sunnah?

the answer:

the term "the people who bind and loose" did not occur in the book, nor in the sunnah. it came rather from the noble companions and those after them, and became widely current in the days of the successors (tābiʿūn) and those who followed them,

because the age of the prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) was not one of binding and loosing: god, glorified and exalted, had given him charge of the affairs of the muslims and had made him closer to them than their own selves, and no one could withdraw his confidence from him, nor oppose him. { it is not for a believing man or a believing woman, when god and his messenger have decided a matter, that they should have any choice in their affair. and whoever disobeys god and his messenger has strayed into manifest error } (sūrat al-aḥzāb 33:36) { but no, by your lord, they will not believe until they make you judge in what is in dispute between them, then find within themselves no discomfort at what you have decided, and submit in full submission } (sūrat al-nisāʾ 4:65)

the people who bind and loose were needed only after his death (peace and blessings be upon him), since he did not bequeath the caliphate to anyone and did not designate anyone for this matter, so that the muslims needed to choose from among themselves the people who bind and loose.

at the outset they had clear means to hand, because they had a group whom god declared upright in his book and with whom he was pleased, so that no evil deed of theirs falls except that it is forgiven: these were the people of badr and the people of the pledge of ridwan — may god be pleased with them all.

and after all of these had died, the muslims needed criteria by which to choose the people who bind and loose.

his eminence sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew al-shinqiti
r:
هل يأثم القاضي إذا حكم بقانون مخالف للشريعة الإسلامية؟ | فتاوى الشيخ الددو 

هل ورد مصطلح أهل الحل و العقد في القرآن الكريم أو السنة المطهرة؟

الجواب:

لم يرد مصطلح أهل الحل و العقد في الكتاب و لا السنة، و إنما جاء عن الصحابة الكرام و من بعدهم و اشتهر كثيرا في أيام التابعين و أتباعهم، 

لأن عصر النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ليس في حل و لا عقد، لأنه صلى الله عليه وسلم ولاه الله سبحانه و تعالى أمر المسلمين، و جعله أولى بهم من أنفسهم، و لا يمكن أن ينزع أحد منه الثقة، و لا أن يخالفه [ وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ وَلَا مُؤْمِنَةٍ إِذَا قَضَى اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَمْرًا أَن يَكُونَ لَهُمُ الْخِيَرَةُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ ۗ وَمَن يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَلَالًا مُّبِينًا ] [ فَلَا وَرَبِّكَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ حَتَّىٰ يُحَكِّمُوكَ فِيمَا شَجَرَ بَيْنَهُمْ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُوا فِي أَنفُسِهِمْ حَرَجًا مِّمَّا قَضَيْتَ وَيُسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا ] 

و إنما احتيج إلى أهل الحل و العقد بعد وفاته صلى الله عليه وسلم حيث لم يوص بالخلافة لأحد، و لم يعين أحدا لهذا الأمر، فاحتاج المسلمون إلى أن يختاروا منهم أهل الحل و العقد ،

ففي البداية كانت لديهم وسائل واضحة لأن لديهم طائفة زكاها الله في كتابه و رضي عنها فلا تقع سيئاتهم إلا مغفورة، وهم أهل بدر و أهل بيعة الرضوان فقد رضي الله عنه أجمعين، 

و بعد أن مات هؤلاء جميعا احتاج المسلمون إلى معايير يختارون بها أهل الحل و العقد.

فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو الشنقيطي

t: The Ruling on Selling Imported Food Before It Reaches the Merchant's Warehouses | Fatwas of Sheikh al-Dedew
a: حكم بيع الطعام المستورد قبل وصوله مخازن التاجر | فتاوى الشيخ الددو
b:
a questioner asks about the ruling on selling imported food before it reaches the merchant's warehouses, and whether this falls under the prohibition of selling food before taking possession of it (qabḍ); and, on that basis, if he sells it and its price rises before it arrives, whether the seller may rescind the sale or raise the price.

and upon you be peace, and the mercy of god and his blessings.

as to selling food before it arrives: if it has already entered the seller's ownership and his liability (ḍamān), so that it is owned by him and is no longer owned by the company from which he bought it — as where it was he who shipped it by sea and he who insured it — then it is permissible for him to sell it, because it has come into his ownership and his possession, even if it has not reached the market, even if it has not reached the country at all, and even if it is loaded on board at sea; before it reaches the port it is permissible for him to sell it. and once he has sold it, it is not lawful for him to go back on his sale, because the sale has already taken effect, even if the price rises afterwards. for god, glorified and exalted, says: { o you who believe, fulfil your contracts } (sūrat al-māʾidah 5:1); and he says: { and those who fulfil their covenant when they make a covenant } (sūrat al-baqarah 2:177); and the glorified and exalted says: { and fulfil the covenant of god when you have made a covenant } (sūrat al-naḥl 16:91). it is established as sound from the prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) that he said: "the signs of the hypocrite are three: when he speaks he lies, when he promises he breaks his promise, and when he is entrusted he betrays the trust" — narrated by al-bukhari. and it is established as sound from him (peace and blessings be upon him) that he said: "four traits: whoever has them in him is a pure hypocrite, and whoever has one of them has in him a trait of hypocrisy until he abandons it — when he is entrusted he betrays the trust, when he speaks he lies, when he makes a covenant he acts treacherously, and when he disputes he behaves depravedly" — narrated by al-bukhari.

may god protect us and you from hypocrisy, from discord and from bad character, and may he make what he has made lawful suffice us and you, so that we have no need of what he has forbidden.

and peace be upon you, and the mercy of god and his blessings.

fatwas of his eminence sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew al-shinqiti
r:
سائل يسأل عن حكم بيع الطعام المستورد قبل وصوله مخازن التاجر وهل يدخل ضمن حرمة بيع الطعام قبل قبضه و على ذلك إذا باعه فارتفع سعره قبل وصوله فهل للبائع فسخ البيع أو رفع السعر .

عليكم السلام ورحمة الله وبركاته

بيع الطعام قبل وصوله إذا كان قد دخل في ملك البائع و ضمانه فكان مملوكا له ولم يعد مملوكا للشركة التي اشتراه منها، بأن كان هو الذي شحنه في البحر وهو الذي أمَّن عليه فإنه يجوز له بيعه لأنه أصبح في ملكه وحوزه ولو لم يصل إلى السوق ولو لم يصل إلى البلد أصلا ولو كان مشحونا في البحر وقبل أن يصل إلى الميناء يجوز له بيعه، وإذا باعه لا يحل له التراجع عن بيعه، لأن البيع قد مضى ولو ارتفع السعر بعد ذلك فإن الله سبحانه وتعالى يقول: { يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا أَوْفُوا بِالْعُقُودِ } و يقول : { وَالْمُوفُونَ بِعَهْدِهِمْ إِذَا عَاهَدُواْ } و يقول سبحانه وتعالى{ وَأَوْفُوا بِعَهْدِ اللَّهِ إِذَا عَاهَدتُّمْ } وقد صح عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال: « آيَة المنافقِ ثلاث: إذا حَدَّث كَذَبَ، وإذا وعد أخلف، وإذا اؤتمن خان » رواه البخاري و صح عنه صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال : « أربع من كن فيه كان منافقا خالصا، ومن كانت فيه خصلة منهن كانت فيه خصلة من النفاق حتى يدعها: إذا اؤْتُمنَ خان، وإذا حدَّث كذب، وإذا عاهد غدر، وإذا خاصم فجر » رواه البخاري .

أجارنا الله و إياكم من النفاق و الشقاق و سوء الأخلاق و أغنانا و إياكم بحلاله عن حرامه.

و السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته

فتاوى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو الشنقيطي

t: His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew Congratulates Sheikh Muhammad Sidiya (al-Nawawi) Ould Sulayman Ould Ajdud on the Welcome of His Beloved Son Abdullah — May God Almighty Preserve Them Both
a: قال فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو مهنئا الشيخ محمد سيديا (النووي) ولد سليمان ولد اجدود ترحيبا بابنه الغالي عبد الله، حفظهما الله تعالى
b:
his eminence sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew said, congratulating sheikh muhammad sidiya (al-nawawi) ould sulayman ould ajdud in welcome of his beloved son abdullah — may god almighty preserve them both:

o abdullah, live out an age that is praiseworthy,

noble, honoured, dutiful and happy.

be like your father, a scholar of every discipline,

and one who restores the sunnah practices that have fallen into disuse.

hold fast to the upright way and guard it,

and you will never swerve from the middle of the road.

recite the qur'an measuredly; that was their constant practice,

the practice of the forefathers, their long-inherited way.

may god give you of what he gave them,

and increase you in elevation and in further guidance.

be a shade for the sheikh, and gather what he has

gathered for the students, and so be of benefit.

hasten to acts of nobility and to high things,

and live in his shade a life of ease.

strive for the victory of the truth, and be brave

like your noble family, and die a martyr.
r:
قال فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو مهنئا الشيخ محمد سيديا (النووي) ولد سليمان ولد اجدود ترحيبا بابنه الغالي عبد الله، حفظهما الله تعالى

أعبد الله عش قرنا حميدا

كريما مكرما برا سعيدا

و كن كأبيك عالم كل فن

و للسنن المماتة مستعيدا

و للنهج القويم الزمْ و صنه

فعن وسط المحجة لن تحيدا

و للقرآن رتّل ذاك دأب

للابا كان دأبهم التليدا

حباك الله مما قد حباهم

و زادك رفعة و هدى مزيدا

و كن للشيخ ظلا و احو ما قد

حوى للطالبين فكن مفيدا

و سارع للمكارم و المعالي

و عش في ظله عيشا رغيدا

لنصر الحق فاسع و كن شجاعا

كأهليك الكرام و مت شهيدا

t: Sheikh al-Dedew's Congratulation to His Eminence Sheikh al-Nawawi, and the Reply of His Eminence Sheikh Abdullah Ajdud, "al-ʿAbbad"
a: تهنئة الشيخ الددو لفضيلة الشيخ النووي و جواب فضيلة الشيخ عبد الله اجدود " العباد *
b:
his eminence sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew said, congratulating sheikh muhammad sidiya (al-nawawi) ould sulayman ould ajdud in welcome of his beloved son abdullah — may god almighty preserve them both:

o abdullah, live out an age that is praiseworthy,

noble, honoured, dutiful and happy.

be like your father, a scholar of every discipline,

and one who restores the sunnah practices that have fallen into disuse.

hold fast to the upright way and guard it,

and you will never swerve from the middle of the road.

recite the qur'an measuredly; that was their constant practice,

the practice of the forefathers, their long-inherited way.

may god give you of what he gave them,

and increase you in elevation and in further guidance.

be a shade for the sheikh, and gather what he has

gathered for the students, and so be of benefit.

hasten to acts of nobility and to high things,

and live in his shade a life of ease.

strive for the victory of the truth, and be brave

like your noble family, and die a martyr.

the answer and reply of his eminence sheikh abdullah "al-ʿabbad" ibn sulayman ibn ajdud, adviser to the minister of endowments and islamic affairs in the state of qatar, to his eminence sheikh al-dedew's congratulation to the learned al-nawawi — may god almighty preserve them — was as follows:

peace be upon you, and the mercy of god and his blessings.

may god greet you, his eminence the sheikh, and preserve you and keep you.

from the moment the limpid and splendid piece of verse reached me, which you sent me as a congratulation and a supplication for our blessed son — god almighty willing — abdullah, i have been in the utmost delight and joy at it.

it has taken a place with all of us that none knows but god almighty, and we count it among the glories of this world for us, and we hope it will be among that by which the treasure of the hereafter is attained.

i have composed some verses, despite how long it has been since i last wrote poetry — perhaps more than thirty years, praise be to god — and i do not think they do it justice, nor match it in form or in meaning, nor rise to its measure. the verses are:

o abdullah, your good fortune admits of no addition

beyond what it is, so be glad and happy with it.

vaunt yourself before the gatherings of the young, since

sheikh al-dedew has prayed that you become a master.

he went to the utmost in congratulating you, and adorned

your kin with a matchless necklace of eminence.

so reward him, lord, with a good recompense, and multiply

for him, on our behalf, his reward, and add to it.

and grant him, lord, all that he hopes for,

removing from him every harm, far away.

o sheikh of sheikhs, and pride of an age

that god favoured with your glorious rising —

i forsook poetry long ago, and it is now

a duty upon me that my return to it be praiseworthy.
r:
قال فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو مهنئا الشيخ محمد سيديا (النووي) ولد سليمان ولد اجدود ترحيبا بابنه الغالي عبد الله، حفظهما الله تعالى

أعبد الله عش قرنا حميدا

كريما مكرما برا سعيدا

و كن كأبيك عالم كل فن

و للسنن المماتة مستعيدا

و للنهج القويم الزمْ و صنه

فعن وسط المحجة لن تحيدا

و للقرآن رتّل ذاك دأب

للابا كان دأبهم التليدا

حباك الله مما قد حباهم

و زادك رفعة و هدى مزيدا

و كن للشيخ ظلا و احو ما قد

حوى للطالبين فكن مفيدا

و سارع للمكارم و المعالي

و عش في ظله عيشا رغيدا

لنصر الحق فاسع و كن شجاعا

كأهليك الكرام و مت شهيدا

فكان جواب و رده فضيلة الشيخ عبد الله " العباد " بن سليمان بن اجدود مستشار وزير الأوقاف و الشؤون الإسلامية بدولة قطر على تهنئة فضيلة الشيخ الددو للعلامة النووية - حفظهم الله تعالى

السلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته

حياكم فضيلة الشيخ وحفظكم وأبقاكم

منذ وصلتني القطعة الشعرية الرائقة الرائعة التي أرسلتم لي تهنئة ودعاء لابننا المبارك - إن شاء الله تعالى - عبد الله وأنا في غاية السرور والابتهاج بها.

وقد وقعت منا جميعا موقعا لا يعلمه إلا الله تعالى، وإننا لنعتبرها لنا من مفاخر الدنيا ونرجو أن تكون مما ينال به مدخر الآخرة.

وقد قلت أبياتا رغم تقادم عهدي بقرض الشعر، - ربما يكون ذلك أزيد من ثلاثين سنة لله الحمد - وأعتقد أنها لا توفيها حقها، ولا تكافئها في مبناها ومعناها، ولا تساميها في قدرها. والأبيات هي:

أعبد الله حظك لا مزيدا

عليه فكن به جذلا سعيدا

وباهِ محافل الولدان لما

دعا الشيخ الدَّوَوْ لك أن تسودا

وبالغ فيك تهنئة وحلى

ذويك من العلا عقدا فريدا

فجازه رب صالحة وضاعف

له عنا مثوبته وزيدا

وأعطه رب ما يرجوه طرا

مزيحا عنه كل أذى بعيدا

أيا شيخ الشيوخ وفخر عصر

حباه الله مطلعك المجيدا

هجرتُ الشعر مذ زمن وحق

علي الآن عودته حميدا.

t: Sheikh al-Dedew's Commendation of the Book The Genealogical Tree of the Idrisids of Sidi Yahya, by the Noble Sayyid Sheikh Muhammad al-Mukhtar ibn Ahmad ibn Abd al-Da'im, May God Preserve Him
a: تقريظ الشيخ الددو لكتاب ( شجرة الأدارسة سيدي يحيى ) للسيد الشريف الشيخ محمد المختار بن أحمد بن عبد الدائم حفظه الله
b:
i said, in commendation of the book the genealogical tree of the idrisids of sidi yahya, by the noble sayyid, sheikh muhammad al-mukhtar ibn ahmad ibn abd al-da'im, may god preserve him:

muhammad al-mukhtar, possessor of knowledge and excellence,

of righteousness, kindness, generosity and open-handed giving;

possessor of a high and noble lineage, and of god-consciousness (taqwā),

of the most exemplary traits and of an easy disposition.

his forefathers bequeathed him every excellence,

and through his maternal uncles it was perfected, excellence upon excellence:

from the family of abd al-da'im he gained eminence,

and from the righteous family of al-zuwayn, people of nobility.

he has books that hold precious treasures,

beautiful in their arrangement, sound in what they transmit.

he has set out from the genealogies a detailed volume

that helps those of us who are kin to keep the ties of kinship.

he has given the lives of notable figures, verified attributions of descent,

made homelands clear, and enumerated the offspring.

it holds a clear account of the genealogies of tanwajiw

for their descendants, so that like is joined to like.

and he traces the branches of the pole (quṭb) sidi yahya back

to sidi idris, of original nobility,

to his father idris, of glory and eminence,

to the excellent abdullah, of merit and justice,

to al-hasan the excellent, al-muthanna, who rose to

the summits of might, of divine enabling, of forbearance and of sound judgement,

to al-hasan the grandson, son of haydara the well-pleasing,

through fatimah al-zahra, to the master of the messengers —

upon him be god's blessings without ceasing, and upon his family,

and the purest peace, joining the branch to the root.

written by muhammad al-hasan ibn al-dedew.
r:
قلت في تقريظ كتاب ( شجرة الأدارسة سيدي يحيى ) للسيد الشريف الشيخ محمد المختار بن أحمد بن عبد الدائم حفظه الله

محمدٌ المختار ذو العلم و الفضل

و ذو البر و الإحسان و الجود و البذل

و ذو النسب العالي الشريف و ذو التقى

و ذو الشيم المثلى و ذو الخلق السهل

قد اورثه الآباء كل فضيلة

و كمل بالأخوال فضلا على فضل

فمن آل عبد الدائم اكتسب العلى

و آل الزوين الصالحين ذوي النبل

له كتب تحوي كنوزا ثمينة

جميلة ترتيب مصححة النقل

أبان من الأنساب سفرا مفصلا

يعين ذوي الأرحام منا على الوصل

و ترجم أعلاما و حقق نسبة

و بين أوطانا و عدد للنسل

لأنساب تنواجيو يحوي مبينا

لأحفادهم فالشكل ينضم للشكل

و للقطب سيدي يحي ينهي فروعه

إلى سيِّدي إدريس ذي الشرف الأصلي

لوالده إدريس ذي المجد و العلى

إلى الندب عبد الله ذي الفضل و العدل

إلى الحسن الندب المثنى من ارتقى

ذرى العز و التوفيق و الحلم و العقل

إلى الحسن السبط ابن حيدرة الرضا

لفاطمة الزهرا إلى سيد الرسل

عليه صلاة الله تترى و آله

و أزكى سلام يجمع الفصل بالأصل

كتبه محمد الحسن بن الددو

t: “Unity Is the Basis of Liberation” — Sheikh al-Dedew Takes Part in the Muslim Scholars' Summit in Kuala Lumpur
a: الوحدة أساس للتحرير .. الشيخ الددو يشارك في قمة علماء المسلمين في كوالالمبور
b:
his eminence sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew took part this morning, friday 20 may 2022, in the opening of the summit of muslim scholars hosted by the malaysian capital, kuala lumpur, under the title:
unity is the basis for the liberation of palestine.
the summit is organised jointly by the malaysian myaqsa, the malaysian islamic call foundation (yadim), the international union of muslim scholars, and the global coalition for jerusalem and palestine (gcqp),
and the summit aims to unite the word of the muslims and their views, and to urge them to close ranks in preparation for confronting the enemies of the ummah and liberating its sanctuaries,
this in addition to discussing the affairs of the holy city, particularly after the repeated assaults by the zionists.

those assembled were of one accord that supporting al-aqsa and liberating palestine, and supporting its people and standing by them in their ordeal until the land is liberated and the country is independent, is obligatory (wujūb).
the summit continues for three days, in which those assembled discuss the affairs of the ummah and the challenges facing it, and how palestine is to be helped and the aqsa mosque liberated.
r:
شارك صباح اليوم الجمعة 20 مايو 2022م فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو في افتتاح قمة علماء المسلمين التي تحتضنها العاصمة الماليزية كوالالمبور تحت عنوان:
الوحدة أساس لتحرير فلسطين.
و تنظم القمة بالتعاون بين ماي أقصى الماليزية MyAQSA ومؤسسة الدعوة الإسلامية الماليزية YADIM والاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين والتحالف الدولي لأجل القدس وفلسطين GCQP ،
و تهدف القمة إلى توحيد كلمة المسلمين وآراهم وحثهم على وحدة الصف تحضيرا لمواجهة أعداء الأمة و تحرير مقدساتها
هذا بالإضافة إلى مناقشة قضايا المدينة المقدسة خاصة بعد الاعتداءات المتكررة من الصهاينة

وقد أجمع المجتمعون على وجوب نصرة الأقصى وتحرير فلسطين و دعم أهلها و مؤازرتهم في محنتهم حتى تتحرر الأرض و تستقل البلاد.
و تستمر القمة ثلاثة أيام يناقش فيها المجتمعون قضايا الامة و التحديات التي تواجهها، كيفية نصر فلسطين و تحرير المسجد الأقصى.

t: Taking In Public Lectures, Classes and Fatwa Sessions — Sheikh al-Dedew on a Da'wah Tour to the Mauritanian Region of Dakhlet Nouadhibou
a: تشمل إقامة محاضرات ودروس وحلقات إفتاء.. الشيخ الددو في رحلة دعوية إلى ولاية داخلت انواذيبو الموريتانية
b:
his eminence sheikh muhammad al-hasan al-dedew — head of the centre for the formation of scholars, president of the al-mustaqbal association, and a member of the board of trustees of the international union of muslim scholars — delivered a scholarly lecture entitled "the factors of the ummah's strength", as part of a series of lectures and classes hosted by mauritania's economic capital, the region of dakhlet nouadhibou, which lies 470 km from the capital nouakchott.

this event comes as part of a da'wah tour in the region organised by the al-mustaqbal association for da'wah, culture and education on 25 and 26 june of this month; the tour takes in a series of lectures, classes and fatwa sessions.

these are the principal lectures, in chronological order:

in the district of chami:

* the first lecture: "lawful earning", at the al-furqan congregational mosque in the district of chami, which opened the da'wah tour.

* a fatwa session specifically for gold prospectors and those working in prospecting, in which sheikh al-dedew answered the questions of those present.

and in the district of nouadhibou:

* a lecture at the quba mosque on "coming to the prophet's aid, god bless him and grant him peace, and what that requires".

* a lecture entitled "how do we pray the prayer of the prophet, god bless him and grant him peace?", at the al-ridwan mosque. — organised by the al-furqan association for culture and upbringing.

* a lecture entitled "the factors of the ummah's strength", at the abu bakr al-siddiq congregational mosque.

* "the merit of the ten days of dhu al-hijjah", organised by the women's association for combating poverty and illiteracy.

* the duty of the muslim young woman in coming to the aid of the prophet, god bless him and grant him peace — organised by the al-fatat association for awareness and upbringing.
r:
ألقى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء و رئيس جمعية المستقبل وعضو مجلس أمناء الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين محاضرة علمية بعنوان: "عوامل قوة الأمة"، ضمن سلسلة محاضرات ودروس تحتضنها العاصمة الاقتصادية لموريتانيا ولاية داخلت نواذيبو التي تبعد عن العاصمة انواكشوط 470 كلم.

وتأتي هذه الفعالية ضمن رحلة دعوية في الولاية نظمتها جمعية المستقبل للدعوة والثقافة والتعليم يومي 25 و 26 يونيو الجاري، وتشمل الرحلة إقامة سلسلة من المحاضرات والدروس وحلقات الإفتاء.

وهذه أبرز المحاضرات حسب التسلسل الزمني :-

ففي مقاطعة الشامي:

* المحاضرة الأولى: "الكسب الحلال" في جامع الفرقان بمقاطعة الشامي التي كانت مفتتح الرحلة الدعوية.

* حلقة إفتاء خاصة بالمنقبين عن الذهب والعاملين في مجال التنقيب، حيث أجاب الشيخ الددو على أسئلة الحضور.

وفي مقاطعة انواذيبو:

* محاضرة في مسجد قباء عن "نصرة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ومقتضياتها".

* محاضرة بعنوان: "كيف نصلي صلاة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم؟" في مسجد الرضوان. - الجهة المنظمة جمعية الفرقان للثقافة والتربية.

* محاضرة بعنوان: "عوامل قوة الأمة" في جامع أبي بكر الصديق.

* "فضل عشر ذي الحجة" الجهة المنظمة الجمعية النسوية لمكافحة الفقر والأمية.

* واجب الفتاة المسلمة في نصرة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم - الجهة المنظمة جمعية الفتاة للتوعية والتربية.

t: From Muhammad al-Hasan ibn al-Dedew to Every Muslim Whom This Reaches
a: من محمد الحسن بن الدَّدَوْ إلى كل من يصل إليه من المسلمين
b:
peace be upon you, and the mercy of god and his blessings.

to proceed: among the best seasons of good in the year is this season with which god has favoured you in these days of merit, which are the best days of the year. the group narrated — except muslim and al-nasa'i — from the hadith of ibn abbas, may god be pleased with them both, who said: the messenger of god, god bless him and grant him peace, said: «there are no days in which righteous deeds are more beloved to god, mighty and majestic, than these days» — meaning the ten days of dhu al-hijjah. and ahmad and others narrated from the hadith of ibn umar, may god be pleased with them both, who said: the messenger of god, god bless him and grant him peace, said: «there are no days greater in the sight of god, glorified is he, nor in which deeds are more beloved to him, than these ten days; so do much in them of declaring god's oneness, of declaring his greatness and of praising him.» so exert yourselves in righteous deeds in these days, and especially in the following:
